blocks.text: {اَذْكُرْكُمْ: Main tumhein yaad karunga.} Allah Ta'ala ita'at se yaad karne walon ko apni maghfirat ke saath, shukr ke saath yaad karne walon ko apni nemat ke saath, aur muhabbat ke saath yaad karne walon ko apne qurb ke saath yaad farmata hai. Bukhari Shareef mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala irshaad farmata hai: Main apne bande ke us gumaan ke mutaabiq hota hoon jo woh mere baare mein rakhta hai. Jab woh mera zikr karta hai to main us ke saath hota hoon. Agar banda mujhe apne dil mein yaad karta hai to main bhi use apne paas yaad karta hoon, aur agar woh mujhe kisi majlis mein yaad karta hai to main us se behtar majlis mein use yaad karta hoon. Agar woh ek baalisht mere qareeb hota hai to main ek gaz us se qareeb ho jaata hoon, aur agar woh ek gaz mere qareeb hota hai to main dono haathon ke phailaao ke baraabar us se qareeb ho jaata hoon. Agar woh meri taraf chal kar aata hai to main us ki taraf daud kar jaata hoon. Yani Allah Ta'ala ki shaan ke laaiq, ya is se muraad yeh hai ke Allah ki rehmat us ki taraf zyada tezi se mutawajjah hoti hai. (بخاری، کتاب التوحید، باب قول اللہ تعالی: ویحذرکم اللہ نفسہ، ۴ / ۵۴۱، الحدیث: ۷۴۰۵)

blocks.text: {وَ اشْكُرُوْا لِیْ: Aur mera shukr karo.} Jab kufr ka lafz shukr ke muqaable mein aaye to us ka matlab na-shukri hota hai, aur jab Islam ya imaan ke muqaable mein aaye to us ka matlab be-imaani hota hai. Yahan kufr se muraad na-shukri hai.

blocks.text: Shukr Ki Tareef

runs.text: Shukr Ki Tareef

blocks.text: Shukr ka matlab yeh hai ke kisi ke ehsaan aur nemat ki wajah se zubaan, dil ya aaza ke zariye us ki ta'zeem ki jaaye. Hazrat Moosa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne arz ki: Ya Allah! Main tera shukr kaise ada karoon, jab mera shukr karna bhi teri ek nemat hai? Allah Ta'ala ne irshaad farmaya: Jab tumne yeh jaan liya ke har nemat meri taraf se hai aur tum us par raazi rahe, to yahi shukr ada karna hai. (احیاء علوم الدین، کتاب الصبر والشکر، الشطر الثانی، بیان طریق کشف الغطاء ۔۔۔ الخ، ۴ / ۱۰۵)

blocks.text: Hazrat Ka'b رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: Allah Ta'ala duniya mein kisi bande ko nemat de, phir woh Allah ke liye us nemat ka shukr ada kare aur us nemat ki wajah se Allah ke liye aajizi ikhtiyaar kare, to Allah Ta'ala duniya mein use is nemat se faida deta hai aur is ki wajah se Aakhirat mein us ke darje buland farmata hai. Aur jis par Allah Ta'ala ne duniya mein nemat ki aur us ne na shukr ada kiya na Allah ke liye aajizi ikhtiyaar ki, to Allah Ta'ala duniya mein us se is nemat ka faida rok leta hai aur us ke liye Jahannam ka ek tabqah khol deta hai. Phir agar Allah chahe to use Aakhirat mein azaab de ya us se darguzar farmaye. (رسائل ابن ابی الدنیا، التواضع والخمول، ۳ / ۵۵۵، رقم: ۹۳)

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Ae imaan walo! Sabr aur namaaz se madad maango, be-shak Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: Pichhli aayaat mein zikr aur shukr ka bayaan hua aur is aayat mein sabr aur namaaz ka zikr kiya ja raha hai, kyunke Musalman ki zindagi zikrullah, sabr aur shukr se hi kaamil hoti hai. Sabr se madad maangne ka matlab yeh hai ke ibaadat ada karne, gunaahon se bachne aur nafs ki khwahishon ko poora na karne par sabr kiya jaaye. Namaaz tamaam ibaadaton ki asal, ahl-e-imaan ki miraaj aur sabr karne mein behtareen madadgaar hai. Is liye in dono se madad maangne ka hukm diya gaya. blocks.text: Quran-o-hadees aur buzurgon ke aqwaal mein sabr ke be-shumaar fazaail bayaan hue hain. Targheeb ke liye un mein se das fazaail ka khulaasa yeh hai:

runs.text: Quran-o-hadees aur buzurgon ke aqwaal mein sabr ke be-shumaar fazaail bayaan hue hain. Targheeb ke liye un mein se das fazaail ka khulaasa yeh hai:

blocks.text:
1. Allah Ta'ala sabr karne walon ke saath hai. (پ ۱۰، الانفال: ۴۶)
2. Sabr karne wale ko us ke amal se behtar ajr milega. (پ۱۴، النحل: ۹۶)
3. Sabr karne walon ko be-hisaab ajr milega. (پ۲۳، الزمر: ۱۰)
4. Sabr karne walon ka badla dekh kar Qiyamat ke din log hasrat karenge. (معجم الکبیر، ۱۲ / ۱۴۱، الحدیث: ۱۲۸۲۹)
5. Sabr karne wale Rab-e-Kareem عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki taraf se durood, hidaayat aur rehmat paate hain. (پ۲، البقرۃ: ۱۵۷)
6. Sabr karne wale Allah Ta'ala ko mehboob hain. (پ۴، آل عمران: ۱۴۶)
7. Sabr aadha imaan hai. (مستدرک، کتاب التفسیر، الصبر نصف الایمان، ۳ / ۲۳۷، الحدیث: ۳۷۱۸)
8. Sabr Jannat ke khazaanon mein se ek khazaana hai. (احیاء علوم الدین، کتاب الصبر والشکر، بیان فضیلۃ الصبر، ۴ / ۷۶)
9. Sabr karne wale ki khataaein mita di jaati hain. (ترمذی، کتاب الزہد، باب ما جاء فی الصبر علی البلاء، ۴ / ۱۷۹، الحدیث: ۲۴۰۷)
10. Sabr har bhalaai ki kunji hai. (شعب الایمان، السبعون من شعب الایمان، فصل فی ذکر ما فی الاوجاع۔۔۔ الخ، ۷ / ۲۰۱، رقم: ۹۹۹۶)

runs.text: Ghair Khuda Se Madad Maangna Shirk Nahin

blocks.text: Is aayat se yeh bhi maaloom hua ke ghair-e-Khuda se madad maangna shirk nahin. A'la Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Khudaara insaaf! Agar aayat-e-kareema ’’اِیَّاكَ نَسْتَعِیْنُ‘‘ mein har tarah ki madad ko zaat-e-Ilahi جَلَّ وَعَلَا ke saath khaas karna maqsood ho, to kya sirf Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام se madad maangna shirk hoga? Kya yahi ghair-e-Khuda hain aur baaqi sab log aur cheezein Wahabiyon ke nazdeek Khuda hain? Ya aayat mein khaas unhi ka naam le diya gaya hai ke un se shirk auron se jaaiz hai? Hargiz nahin. Jab har tarah ki madad ko sirf zaat-e-Ahadiyyat ke saath khaas karna aur ghair se madad ko shirk maanna thehra, to kisi bhi ghair-e-Khuda se kisi bhi tarah ki madad lena hamesha shirk hogi, chahe insaan hon ya be-jaan cheezein, zinda hon ya wafaat-yafta, zaat hon ya sifaat, af'aal hon ya haalaat. Ab is aayat ka kya jawaab hai jahan Rab جَلَّ وَعَلَا farmata hai:

runs.text: وَ لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ قُتِلُوْا فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ اَمْوَاتًاؕ-بَلْ اَحْیَآءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ یُرْزَقُوْنَ (ال عمران:۱۶۹)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur jo Allah ki raah mein shahid kiye gaye hargiz unhein murda khayaal na karna, balki woh apne Rab ke paas zinda hain, unhein rizq diya jaata hai.

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala shuhada ko wafaat ke baad zindagi ata farmata hai. Un ki arwaah par rizq pesh kiya jaata hai, unhein aaraam diya jaata hai, un ke aamaal jaari rehte hain aur un ka ajr-o-sawaab badhta rehta hai. Hadees Shareef mein hai ke shuhada ki roohain sabz parindon ke badan mein Jannat ki sair karti aur wahan ke phal aur nematein khaati hain. (شعب الایمان، السبعون من شعب الایمان، ۷ / ۱۱۵، الحدیث: ۹۶۸۶)

blocks.text: Hazrat Anas bin Maalik رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Jannatiyon mein se ek shakhs ko laaya jaayega. Allah Ta'ala us se farmayega: Aye ibn-e-Aadam! Tumne apni manzil aur maqam ko kaisa paaya? Woh arz karega: Aye mere Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ! Bahut achhi manzil hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Maango aur koi tamanna karo. Woh arz karega: Main tujh se itna sawaal karta hoon ke mujhe duniya ki taraf lauta de aur main teri raah mein das martaba shahid kiya jaaun. Woh yeh tamanna shahadat ki fazeelat dekh lene ki wajah se karega. (سنن نسائی، کتاب الجہاد، ما یتمنی اہل الجنۃ، ص۵۱۴، الحدیث: ۳۱۵۷)

blocks.text: Shahid Ki Tareef Aur Us Ke Ahkaam

runs.text: Shahid Ki Tareef Aur Us Ke Ahkaam

blocks.text: Shahid woh Musalman, mukallaf aur taahir shakhs hai jo tez hathiyaar se zulman maara gaya ho aur us ke qatl se maal bhi waajib na hua ho, ya ma'arkah-e-jang mein murda ya zakhmi paaya gaya ho aur us ne koi aaraam na paaya ho. Duniya mein us ke ahkaam yeh hain ke use ghusl na diya jaaye, kafan na diya jaaye, usi kapdon mein rakha jaaye, us par namaaz padhi jaaye aur isi haalat mein dafn kiya jaaye. (بہار شریعت، شہید کا بیان،۱ / ۸۶۰)

blocks.text: Baaz shuhada aise hain jin par duniya ke yeh ahkaam jaari nahin hote, lekin Aakhirat mein un ke liye shahadat ka darjah hota hai. Jaise doob kar, jal kar, deewaar ke neeche dab kar marne wala, talab-e-ilm ya safar-e-Hajj mein, aur Allah ki raah mein marne wale. Yeh sab shahid hain. Ahadees mein aise shuhada ki tadaad chaalees se zyada bayaan hui hai. Mukammal tafseel ke liye Bahar-e-Shariat chautha hissa mulaahazah karein.

blocks.text: Aazmaish Aur Sabr

runs.text: Aazmaish Aur Sabr

blocks.text: Yaad rakhein ke zindagi mein qadam qadam par aazmaaishein hain. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko kabhi beemaari se, kabhi jaan-o-maal ki kami se, kabhi dushman ke khauf se, kabhi kisi nuqsaan se, kabhi aafaat-o-baliyaat se aur kabhi naye naye fitnon se aazmaata hai. Raah-e-Deen aur tableegh-e-Deen to khaas taur par woh raasta hai jis mein qadam qadam par aazmaaishein hain. Isi se farmabardaar aur na-farmaan, muhabbat mein sachche aur sirf daawa karne walon mein farq hota hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Nooh عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام par aksar qaum ka imaan na laana, Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka aag mein daala jaana aur apne farzand ko qurbaan karna, Hazrat Ayyub عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko beemaari mein mubtala kiya jaana aur un ki aulaad aur maal ka khatam ho jaana, Hazrat Moosa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka Misr se Madyan jaana aur phir Misr se hijrat karna, Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka sataaya jaana aur Ambiya-e-Kiraam عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka shahid kiya jaana, yeh sab aazmaish aur sabr ki misaalein hain. In muqaddas hastiyon ki aazmaaishein aur sabr har Musalman ke liye namoona hain.

In muqaddas hastiyon ki aazmaaishein aur sabr har Musalman ke liye namoona hain.

blocks.text: Is liye jab bhi kisi Musalman par museebat aaye, woh kisi takleef ya aziyyat mein mubtala ho, to sabr kare, Allah Ta'ala ki raza par raazi rahe aur be-sabri na dikhaaye. Sadr-ush-Shariah Mufti Amjad Ali A'zami رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Har shakhs yeh baat jaanta hai ke koi kitna hi ghaafil ho, jab use takleef ya museebat pahunchti hai ya woh beemaari mein mubtala hota hai to kitna Allah ko yaad karta aur taubah-o-istighfaar karta hai. Yeh bade rutbe walon ki shaan hai ke woh takleef ka bhi isi tarah istaqbaal karte hain jaise aaraam ka. Hum kam az kam itna to karein ke museebat ya takleef aaye to sabr-o-isteqlaal se kaam lein aur jaza-o-faza, yaani rona-peetna karke milne wala sawaab haath se na jaane dein. Be-sabri se museebat door nahin hogi. Ahadees mein bayaan kiye gaye bade sawaab se mehroomi dohari museebat hai. (بہار شریعت، کتاب الجنائز، بیماری کا بیان، ۱ / ۷۹۹)

runs.text: Ahadees mein museebat ke waqt ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ parhne ke bahut fazaail bayaan hue hain. Un mein se paanch yeh hain:

blocks.text:
1. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umm-e-Salamah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا farmati hain: Main ne Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ko farmate suna ke jis Musalman par museebat aaye aur woh Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ke mutaabiq ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ padhe aur yeh dua kare: ’’اَللّٰہُمَّ أْجُرْنِیْ فِیْ مُصِیْبَتِیْ وَاَخْلِفْ لِیْ خَیْرًا مِّنْہَا‘‘, yaani Aye Allah! Meri is museebat par mujhe ajr ata farma aur mujhe is ka behtar badal ata farma, to Allah Ta'ala use is se behtar badal ata farmayega. Hazrat Umm-e-Salamah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا farmati hain: Jab Hazrat Abu Salamah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ wafaat pa gaye to main ne socha ke Musalmanon mein Abu Salamah se behtar kaun hoga? Woh pehle ghar walon mein se the jinhon ne Huzoor Pur Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki taraf hijrat ki. Main ne yeh dua kar li. Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Salamah ke badle mujhe Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ata farma diye, jo Abu Salamah se bahut behtar the. (مسلم، کتاب الجنائز، باب ما یقال عند المصیبۃ، ص۴۵۷، الحدیث: ۳(۹۱۸))
2. Hazrat Imam Husain bin Ali رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Huzoor Pur Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Jis Musalman mard ya aurat par museebat aaye aur woh use yaad karke ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ kahe, agarche museebat ka zamaana lamba ho gaya ho, to Allah Ta'ala use naya sawaab ata farmata hai aur wahi sawaab deta hai jo museebat ke din diya tha. (مسند امام احمد، حدیث الحسین بن علی رضی اللہ تعالٰی عنہ، ۱ / ۴۲۹، الحدیث: ۱۷۳۴)
3. Ek martaba Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ka charaagh bujh gaya to aap ne ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ padha. Arz ki gayi: Kya yeh bhi museebat hai? Farmaya: Haan, aur har woh cheez jo momin ko aziyyat de us ke liye museebat hai aur us par ajr hai. (در منثور، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۱۵۶، ۱ / ۳۸۰)
4. Ek aur hadees mein hai ke museebat ke waqt ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ parhna rehmat-e-Ilahi ka sabab hota hai. (کنز العمال، کتاب الاخلاق، قسم الاقوال، ۲ / ۱۲۲، الجزء الثالث، الحدیث: ۶۶۴۶)
5. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما se riwaayat hai ke Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Meri ummat ko aisi cheez di gayi hai jo pehli ummaton mein se kisi ko nahin di gayi. Woh museebat ke waqt ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ parhna hai. (معجم الکبیر، ۱۲ / ۳۲، الحدیث: ۱۲۴۱۱)

blocks.text: Museebat par sabr ke kai aadaab hain. Un mein se chaar yeh hain jinhein Allaamah Ibn Qudaamah Maqdisi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne apni kitaab ’’Mukhtasar Minhaaj-ul-Qaasideen‘‘ ke safha 277 par bayaan kiya:

runs.text: Museebat par sabr ke kai aadaab hain. Un mein se chaar yeh hain jinhein Allaamah Ibn Qudaamah Maqdisi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne apni kitaab ’’Mukhtasar Minhaaj-ul-Qaasideen‘‘ ke safha 277 par bayaan kiya:

blocks.text:
1. Museebat pahunchte hi sabr-o-isteqlaal se kaam liya jaaye. Hazrat Anas bin Maalik رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Sabr sadme ki ibtida mein hota hai. (بخاری، کتاب الجنائز، باب زیارۃ القبور، ۱ / ۴۳۳، الحدیث: ۱۲۸۳)
2. Museebat ke waqt ’’اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ‘‘ padha jaaye. Hazrat Umm-e-Salamah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ne apne shohar ki wafaat par yahi padha tha.
3. Museebat ke waqt zubaan aur doosre aaza se aisa kalam ya kaam na kiya jaaye jo shariat ke khilaaf ho, jaise Allah Ta'ala ki baargah mein shikayat ke alfaaz kehna, seena-peetna aur garebaan chaak karna.
4. Sabr ki behtareen soorat yeh hai ke museebat-zadah par museebat ke asraat zaahir na hon. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Anas bin Maalik رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Hazrat Umm-e-Sulaim رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ke batan se Hazrat Abu Talhah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka ek beta wafaat pa gaya. Hazrat Umm-e-Sulaim ne ghar walon se kaha ke Abu Talhah ko un ke bete ki wafaat ki khabar us waqt tak na dena jab tak main khud na bata doon. Abu Talhah aaye to unhon ne shaam ka khaana pesh kiya. Unhon ne khaana khaaya aur paani piya. Phir Umm-e-Sulaim ne pehle se behtar banaao-singaar kiya. Abu Talhah ne un se zawji ta'alluq qaayam kiya. Jab Umm-e-Sulaim ne dekha ke woh ser ho gaye aur apni fitri khwahish poori kar chuke, to kaha: Aye Abu Talhah! Agar kuchh log kisi ko koi cheez amaanat ke taur par dein, phir apni cheez waapas le lein, to kya woh unhein rok sakte hain? Unhon ne kaha: Nahin. Umm-e-Sulaim ne kaha: To apne bete ke baare mein bhi yahi samjhein ke woh Allah Ta'ala ki amaanat tha jo us ne waapas le li, yaani us ka inteqaal ho gaya. (مسلم، کتاب فضائل الصحابۃ، باب من فضائل ابی طلحۃ الانصاری رضی اللہ تعالی عنہ، ص۱۳۳۳، الحدیث: ۱۰۷(۲۱۴۴))

blocks.text: Hazrat Isma'eel عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام bahut chhoti umr ke the. Unhein pyaas lagi aur jab pyaas bahut zyada badh gayi to Hazrat Haajirah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا be-chain hokar Koh-e-Safa par gayin. Wahan bhi paani na mila to neeche utar kar maidaan mein daudti hui Marwah tak pahunchin. Is tarah unhon ne saat chakkar lagaaye. (صاوی، ابراہیم، تحت الایۃ: ۳۷، ۳ / ۱۰۲۷-۱۰۲۸)

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ne ’’اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ‘‘, yaani Allah Ta'ala sabr karne walon ke saath hai, ka jalwah is tarah zaahir farmaya ke ghaib se Zamzam ka chashmah zaahir kar diya. Un ke sabr aur ikhlaas ki barkat se in dono pahaadon ke darmiyan daudne walon ko apni baargah mein maqbool qarar diya aur in pahaadon ko dua ki qabooliyat ka maqam bana diya. Is waaqie ka zikr Surah Ibrahim ki aayat 13 mein bhi hai.

blocks.text: Is waaqie se maaloom hua ke jis cheez ko saaliheen se nisbat ho jaaye woh azeem ban jaati hai. Safa aur Marwah Hazrat Haajirah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ke qadmon ki barkat se Allah Ta'ala ki nishaani ban gaye. Yeh bhi maaloom hua ke muqaddas cheezon ki ta'zeem-o-tauqeer Deen mein shaamil hai. Isi liye Safa aur Marwah ki sa'i Hajj ka hissa bani.

blocks.text: {فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَیْهِ: To us par koi harj nahin.} Zamana-e-Jaahiliyyat mein Safa aur Marwah par do but rakhe the. Safa par rakhe but ka naam Usaaf aur Marwah par rakhe but ka naam Naailah tha. Kuffaar Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'i karte hue in buton ko ta'zeeman haath lagaate. Islam ke zamaane mein yeh but tod diye gaye, lekin kyunke yahan kuffaar ka mushrikaana amal hota tha is liye Musalmanon ko Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'i karna bhaari lagta tha. Aayat mein unhein itminaan dilaaya gaya ke tumhari niyyat khalis ibaadat-e-Ilahi ki hai, is liye mushabahat ka andesha nahin karna chahiye. (تفسیر کبیر، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۱۵۸، ۲ / ۱۳۸)

Aayat mein unhein itminaan dilaaya gaya ke tumhari niyyat khalis ibaadat-e-Ilahi ki hai, is liye mushabahat ka andesha nahin karna chahiye. (تفسیر کبیر، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۱۵۸، ۲ / ۱۳۸)

Is wajah se us ke azaab mein yeh kami hai ke jis ungli ke ishaare se us ne use azaad kiya tha, us se use kuchh seeraab kiya jaata hai. blocks.text: Aasman aur zameen ki takhleeq, aasman ki bulandi, us mein chamakte sitaare, baghair sutoon ke us ka qaayam rehna, sooraj aur chaand, aur sitaaron se us ki zeenat, sab Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ki nishaaniyaan hain. Zameen ki wus'at, us mein pahaad, ma'diniyaat aur jawahiraat, rawaan samandar, darya aur chashme, us se ugne wale darakht, sabzah, phal, phool aur nabataat, raat aur din ka aana jaana, din aur raat ka chhota-bada hona, bhaari bojh ke bawajood samandar mein kashtiyon ka tairna, logon ka un par sawar hona, samandari ajaaib, hawaon ka chalna, samandar ke zariye mashriq-o-maghrib mein tijaarat, samandar se bukhaaraat ka uthna aur baarish ki soorat mein barasna, baarish se khushk zameen ka hara-bhara ho jaana, aur paani aur us ke phalon se zindagi mein baagh-o-bahaar aana, yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ke ilm, hikmat, qudrat aur wahdaniyyat par badi daleelein hain.

blocks.text: Yeh sab sirf ijmaali bayaan hai. Agar in cheezon mein se har ek par alag ghaur-o-fikr kiya jaaye to Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ke aise hairatangez karishme nazar aate hain ke insaani aqal dang reh jaati hai. Kainaat mein bahut zyada paayi jaane wali hawa par hi ghaur kar lein. Is mein na jaane kitni gaisein, kitne asraat aur insaani zarooriyat ki kitni bunyaadi cheezein hain. Sirf itna dekh lein ke agar hawa na ho to tamaam insaan das minute ke andar mar jaayen aur zameen par aur hawa mein rehne wale jaanwaron ki zindagi khatam ho jaaye. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ki sirf ek qisam ka ek asar hai, jabke qudrat-e-Ilahi ki kharbon se zyada qisamon mein har cheez ke karoron ajaaib hain.

blocks.text: Saainsi Uloom Bhi Ma'rifat-e-Ilahi Ka Zariya Hain

runs.text: Saainsi Uloom Bhi Ma'rifat-e-Ilahi Ka Zariya Hain

blocks.text: Is aayat aur is ki tafseer se yeh bhi maaloom hua ke saainsi uloom Allah Ta'ala ki ma'rifat ka zariya bante hain. Jitna saainsi ilm zyada hoga, utni hi Allah Ta'ala ki azmat aur qudrat ki pehchaan zyada hogi. Is liye agar koi Islam ki khidmat aur Allah Ta'ala ki ma'rifat ki niyyat se saainsi uloom seekhe to yeh bhi badi ibaadat hai. Allah Ta'ala ne kainaat mein ghaur-o-fikr ka jo hukm diya hai, us ki ta'meel bhi is se hoti hai.

blocks.text: Arabic: وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ یَّتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَنْدَادًا یُّحِبُّوْنَهُمْ كَحُبِّ اللّٰهِؕ-وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اَشَدُّ حُبًّا لِّلّٰهِؕ-وَ لَوْ یَرَى الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْۤا اِذْ یَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَۙ-اَنَّ الْقُوَّةَ لِلّٰهِ جَمِیْعًاۙ-وَّ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ شَدِیْدُ الْعَذَابِ (165)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur kuchh log Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana lete hain. Unhein Allah ki tarah mehboob rakhte hain, aur imaan wale sab se zyada Allah se muhabbat karte hain. Aur agar zaalim dekhte jab woh azaab ko aankhon se dekhenge ke saari quwwat Allah hi ki hai aur Allah sakht azaab dene wala hai.

blocks.text: {اِذْ تَبَرَّاَ الَّذِیْنَ اتُّبِعُوْا: Jab peshwa bezaar honge.} Qiyamat ke din mushrik aur un ke peshwa, jinhon ne unhein kufr ki taraf bulaya tha, ek jagah jama honge aur azaab ko aata hua dekhenge. Phir ek doosre se nafrat aur bezaari ka izhaar karenge. Pairavi karne wale kahenge: Aye Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ! Hum ne apne in sardaaron ki pairavi ki aur inhon ne hamein gumraah kiya, to inhein dugna azaab de aur in par badi la'nat kar. Peshwa apne pairavi karne walon se nafrat aur bezaari ka izhaar karenge. Yeh mazmoon Quran-e-Pak mein kai jagah bayaan hua hai, jaise Surah Ahzaab ki aayaat 66 se 68 aur Surah Saba ki aayaat 31 se 33 mein.

blocks.text: {وَ تَقَطَّعَتْ بِهِمُ الْاَسْبَابُ: Aur sab rishte naate kat jaayenge.} Qiyamat ke din kaafiron ke woh tamaam ta'alluqaat khatam ho jaayenge jo duniya mein un ke darmiyan the, chahe woh dostiyaan hon, rishtedaariyan hon ya baahmi mail-jol. blocks.text: {لَوْ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً: Agar hamein ek martaba laut kar jaana mil jaata.} Kaafir tamanna karenge ke kaash unhein ek baar duniya mein lautne ka mauqa mil jaaye. Woh pehle apne peshwaon aur baatil maboodon se bezaari ka izhaar karenge, phir imaan la kar nek amal karenge. Maut ke waqt bhi kaafiron ki aisi hi tamanna hoti hai. Surah Mu'minun ki aayaat 99 aur 100 mein hai ke kaafir kahega: Aye mere Rab! Mujhe wapas bhej de taake main kuchh neki kar loon. Surah Zumar ki aayat 58 mein bhi hai ke kaafir kahega: Kaash mujhe ek baar wapsi mil jaaye taake main neki kar loon. Para 24 mein Surah Zumar aur Surah Mu'min mein yeh mazmoon bahut baar aaya hai.

blocks.text: Nek Aamaal Ki Hasrat Karne Wale Log

runs.text: Nek Aamaal Ki Hasrat Karne Wale Log

blocks.text: Imaan aur nek aamaal ki asli hasrat kaafir ko hogi, lekin Musalman bhi nekiyon ki kami aur gunaahon mein mubtala hone par hasrat karenge. Hadees Shareef mein hai: Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Har marne wale ko afsos aur nadaamat hogi. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ne arz ki: Ya Rasool Allah! صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ, kis baat ki nadaamat hogi? Farmaya: Agar nek hoga to zyada neki na karne par nadaamat hogi aur agar gunahgaar hoga to gunaahon se baaz na aane par nadaamat hogi. (ترمذی، کتاب الزہد، ۵۹-باب، ۴ / ۱۸۱، الحدیث: ۲۴۱۱)

blocks.text: Allah Ki Halaal Ki Hui Cheez Ko Haraam Kehna

runs.text: Allah Ki Halaal Ki Hui Cheez Ko Haraam Kehna

blocks.text: Is se maaloom hua ke Allah Ta'ala ki halaal ki hui cheezon ko haraam kehna us ki Razzaaqiyyat se baghaawat hai. Muslim Shareef ki hadees mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Jo maal main apne bandon ko deta hoon woh un ke liye halaal hai. Isi hadees mein hai: Main ne apne bandon ko baatil se door paida kiya, phir un ke paas shayaateen aaye. Unhon ne logon ko Deen se bhatka diya aur jo main ne un ke liye halaal kiya tha use haraam thehra diya. (مسلم، کتاب الجنۃ وصفۃ نعیمہا واہلہا، باب صفات التی یعرف بہا فی الدنیا اہل الجنۃ واہل النار، ص۱۵۳۲، الحدیث: ۶۳(۲۸۶۵))

blocks.text: Halaal Aur Tayyib Rizq Se Kya Muraad Hai?

runs.text: Halaal Aur Tayyib Rizq Se Kya Muraad Hai?

blocks.text: Halaal aur tayyib se muraad woh cheez hai jo apni zaat mein bhi halaal ho, jaise bakre ka gosht, sabzi aur daal, aur hamein jaaiz zariye se mili ho. Woh chori, rishwat ya dakaity ke zariye haasil na hui ho.

blocks.text: Ahadees mein halaal rizq ki bahut fazeelat aur haraam rizq ki bahut mazammat bayaan hui hai. Un mein se teen ahadees yeh hain:

runs.text: Ahadees mein halaal rizq ki bahut fazeelat aur haraam rizq ki bahut mazammat bayaan hui hai. Un mein se teen ahadees yeh hain:

blocks.text: 1. Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne arz ki: Ya Rasool Allah! صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ, dua farmaiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe mustajaab-ud-da'waat bana de, yaani meri har dua qabool ho. Huzoor Pur Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Aye Sa'd! Apni ghiza paak karo, mustajaab-ud-da'waat ho jaaoge. Us Zaat ki qasam jis ke qabze mein Muhammad Mustafa صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ki jaan hai, jab aadmi apne pait mein haraam luqma daalta hai to chaalees din tak us ka koi amal qabool nahin hota. Jis bande ka gosht sood aur haraam kamaai se bana ho, us ke liye aag zyada behtar hai. (معجم الاوسط، من اسمہ محمد، ۵ / ۳۴، الحدیث: ۶۴۹۵)

Hazrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai, Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Jis shakhs ne halaal maal kamaaya, phir us ne khud khaya ya us maal se libaas pehna, aur apne ghar walon ya doosre logon ko khilaaya aur pehnaaya, to yeh amal us ke liye barkat aur paakeezgi hai. blocks.text: Ek martaba Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka ghulaam aap ki khidmat mein doodh laaya. Aap ne use pee liya. Ghulaam ne arz ki: Aap pehle jab bhi koi cheez pesh ki jaati to us ke baare mein poochte the, lekin is doodh ke baare mein nahin poocha. Aap ne poocha: Yeh doodh kaisa hai? Ghulaam ne bataya ke zamana-e-Jaahiliyyat mein main ne ek mareez par jhaad-phoonk ki thi aur aaj us ne is ke badle yeh doodh diya hai. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne yeh sun kar apne galay mein ungli daali aur doodh ugal diya. Phir nihayat aajizi se Allah Ta'ala ki baargah mein arz ki: Ya Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ! Jo mere bas mein tha, main ne kar diya. Is doodh ka jo thoda-bahut hissa ragon mein reh gaya hai, use maaf farma de. (منہاج العابدین، العقبۃ الثالثۃ، تقوی الاعضاء الخمسۃ، الفصل الخامس، ص۹۷)

blocks.text: Shaitaan Ka Kaam Kya Hai?

runs.text: Shaitaan Ka Kaam Kya Hai?

blocks.text: Shaitaan ka kaam logon ko buraai ki taraf bulaana hai: kufr-o-shirk ki taraf, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ghalat aqeede mansoob karne ki taraf, Allah ke halaal ko haraam aur haraam ko halaal kehne ki taraf. Woh jhoot, gheebat, chughli, waada-khilaafi, bohtaan, ladai-jhagde, hasad, bughz-o-keena, takabbur, nafrat-o-adaawat, jang-o-jadal, zaleel karne, mazaaq udaane aur ilzaam lagaane jaise bure kaamon ki taraf bhi bulaata hai.

blocks.text: Isi tarah gaane, baaje, filmein, drama, naach, mujre, bad-nigaahi, fahash guftagu, gandi baatein, najaaiz ta'alluqaat, buri niyyat se dekhna aur chhoona, aur badkaari jaise be-hayaai ke gunaahon ki taraf bulaana bhi Shaitaan ka kaam hai. Afsos hai ke aaj in mein se bahut si buraaiyon ki taraf bulaane mein ghar walon, dost-ahbaab, ghar, bazaar, muashray aur afsaron ki madad ya targheeb hoti hai. Koi aadmi neki ki taraf aane ka soche bhi to yeh log use gunah ki taraf kheench lete hain. Kaash hamein achhi sohbat, achha mutaala'a, achha gharana aur achhe dost mil jaayen.

runs.text: Is aayat mein chaar cheezein bayan hui hain: (1) murdaar, (2) khoon, (3) khinzeer ka gosht, (4) ghairullah ke naam par zabah kiya gaya jaanwar. In ki tafseel yeh hai:

blocks.text: (1) Murdaar: Jo halaal jaanwar zabah kiye baghair mar jaaye ya use shar'i tareeqe ke khilaaf maara gaya ho, woh murdaar hai. Misal ke taur par use Musalman ya Kitaabi ke ilawa kisi ne zabah kiya ho, jaan-boojh kar takbeer padhe baghair zabah kiya gaya ho, gala ghont kar, laathi, patthar, dhele ya ghilail ki goli se maara gaya ho, bulandi se gir kar mar gaya ho, kisi jaanwar ne seeng maar kar maar diya ho ya kisi darinde ne halaak kar diya ho. Aise jaanwar ka khana haraam hai. Albatta murdaar ki dabaghat ki hui khaal kaam mein lana aur us ke baal, seeng, haddiyan aur pathon se faida uthana jaaiz hai. (تفسیرات احمدیہ، البقرۃ،تحت الآیۃ: ۱۷۳، ص۴۴)

runs.text: Khoon:

Har jaanwar ka bahne wala khoon haraam hai. Surah An'aam ki aayat 145 mein farmaya gaya: ’’ اَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوْحًا‘‘ ’’ya bahne wala khoon‘‘. Zabah ke baad gosht aur ragoon mein reh jaane wala khoon napaak nahin hota.

blocks.text: (3) Khinzeer: Khinzeer, yaani suwar, najas-ul-ain hai. Is ka gosht, khaal, baal, naakhun aur tamam ajzaa napaak aur haraam hain. In mein se kisi ko kaam mein lana jaaiz nahin. Aayat mein upar se khane ka bayan ho raha hai, is liye yahan sirf gosht ka zikr hua.

runs.text: Khinzeer:

Khinzeer, yaani suwar, najas-ul-ain hai. Is ka gosht, khaal, baal, naakhun aur tamam ajzaa napaak aur haraam hain. In mein se kisi ko kaam mein lana jaaiz nahin. Aayat mein upar se khane ka bayan ho raha hai, is liye yahan sirf gosht ka zikr hua.

blocks.text: (4) Ghairullah ke naam ka zabeeha: Is ka matlab yeh hai ke jaanwar zabah karte waqt Allah Ta'ala ke ilawa kisi aur ka naam liya jaaye. Aise jaanwar ko ghairullah ka naam lekar zabah karna haraam hai aur woh murdaar hai. Lekin agar zabah sirf Allah Ta'ala ke naam par kiya aur us se pehle ya baad mein kisi aur ki nisbat ki, jaise aqeeqe ka bakra, walime ka dumba, ya yeh kaha ke apne maa-baap ki taraf se zabah kar raha hoon, ya jin Awliya ke liye isaale-sawab maqsood ho un ka naam liya, to yeh jaaiz hai aur is mein koi haraj nahin.

blocks.text: Is amal ko haraam kehna aur aise jaanwar ko murdaar kehna bilkul jahalat hai. Zabah se pehle ya baad mein kisi ki taraf nisbat dena haraam amal nahin. Hum aam baat-cheet mein bhi kai ibaadaton ko kisi ki taraf mansoob karte hain: Zuhr ki namaaz, janaaze ki namaaz, musaafir ki namaaz, imaam ki namaaz, muqtadi ki namaaz, mareez ki namaaz, peer ka roza, oonton ki zakaat aur Ka'bah ka Hajj. Jab in nisbaton ki wajah se namaaz, zakaat aur Hajj mein kufr, shirk ya hurmat to door ki baat, halki si karaahat bhi nahin aati, to kisi Wali, buzurg ya kisi aur ki taraf mansoob karke kisi jaanwar ko falan ki bakri kehna kaise haraam ho gaya? Is nisbat ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ke halaal kiye hue jaanwar zinda hote hue murdaar aur suwar kaise ho gaye ke ab kisi surat halaal na ho saken? Jo log unhein murdaar kehte hain woh Shariat-e-Mutahharah par sakht jurrat karte hain.

blocks.text: {فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ: To jo majboor ho jaaye.} Majboor woh hai jo haraam cheez khane par majboor ho, use na khane se jaan jaane ka khauf ho aur koi halaal cheez maujood na ho. Yeh haalat bhook ya ghurbat ki wajah se ho sakti hai, ya koi shakhs haraam khane par majboor kare aur na khane ki surat mein jaan ka andesha ho. blocks.text: Yahoodiyon ke sardaar aur ulama umeed rakhte the ke aakhri Nabi صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ unhi mein mab'oos honge. Jab unhone dekha ke Sarwar-e-Do Aalam Muhammad Mustafa صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ doosri qaum mein mab'oos hue hain, to unhein khauf hua ke log Taurat aur Injeel mein Huzoor Pur Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ke ausaaf dekh kar aap ki farmabardaari ki taraf jhuk jaayenge. Is se Yahoodi sardaaron aur ulama ke nazraane, hadiye aur tohfe band ho jaayenge aur hukoomat bhi chali jaayegi. Is hasad ki wajah se unhone Taurat aur Injeel mein Huzoor اقدس صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki na'at-o-sifat aur aap ke waqt-e-nubuwwat ka bayan chhupa diya. Is par yeh aayat naazil hui. (خازن، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۱۷۳، ۱ / ۱۱۳)

blocks.text: Un ke is rawayye par farmaya gaya ke zaati faaydon, duniya ke maal aur aish-o-aaraam ke liye Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab, us ke ahkaam aur Mustafa صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki azmat-o-shaan chhupaane wale apne khazaane maal se nahin bhar rahe, balki asal mein apne pait mein Jahannam ki aag bhar rahe hain. Yeh kaam unhein Jahannam mein le jaayenge. Qayamat ke din woh Allah Ta'ala se kalaam karne ki sa'adat se mehroom honge, Allah ki rahmat un se door hogi, kufr aur gunaah ki gandagi mein doobe honge aur unhein kisi tarah gunaahon se paak nahin kiya jaayega, balki Jahannam mein daal diya jaayega.

blocks.text: Kitaab ko chhupaana yeh bhi hai ke kisi ko us ke mazmoon se waaqif na hone diya jaaye, na use padh kar sunaaya jaaye aur na dikhaaya jaaye. Ghalat taweelein karke ma'ni badalne ki koshish karna aur Kitaab ke asal ma'ni par parda daalna bhi chhupaana hai. Yahoodi har tarah ki taweelein karte the. Aaj bhi bahut se log Quran padh kar Tauheed ki ghalat tashreeh karte, Mustafa صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki azmat wali aayaat chhupaate, un ke ma'ni badalte aur parde aur sood waghera ke baare mein aayaat ke ma'ni mein tahreef karte hain. Yeh sab isi haraam amal mein daakhil hai.

blocks.text: {اَلَّذِیْنَ اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلٰلَةَ بِالْهُدٰى: Jinhon ne hidayat ke badle gumraahi khareed li.} Is ka matlab yeh hai ke jo hidayat aur maghfirat woh ikhtiyaar kar sakte the, use chhodne ko yahan is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai jaise unhone hidayat aur maghfirat ki jagah gumraahi aur azaab khareed liya. Yeh matlab nahin ke hidayat aur maghfirat un ke paas thi, phir unhone use bech diya.

Yeh matlab nahin ke hidayat aur maghfirat un ke paas thi, phir unhone use bech diya.

blocks.text: Imam Fakhruddin Raazi رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: ’’Duniya mein sab se behtareen cheez hidayat aur ilm hai aur sab se buri cheez gumraahi aur jahalat hai. Jab Yahoodi ulama ne duniya mein hidayat aur ilm chhod kar gumraahi aur jahalat pasand ki to is mein shak nahin ke woh duniya mein apni jaanon ke saath badi khayaanat kar rahe the. Aakhirat mein sab se behtareen cheez maghfirat hai aur sab se zyada nuqsaan dene wali cheez azaab hai. Jab unhone maghfirat chhod kar azaab pasand kiya to yaqeenan woh aakhirat mein sab se zyada nuqsaan uthaane wale hain. Jab un ka haal yeh hai to duniya aur aakhirat mein sab se bade nuqsaan mein bhi wahi hain.

blocks.text: Yahoodi ulama ke baare mein farmaya gaya ke unhone maghfirat ke badle azaab khareed liya, kyunke woh haq baat jaante the. Unhein yeh bhi maloom tha ke Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ke ausaaf zahir karne aur logon ke shubhaat door karne mein bada sawaab hai, aur Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki azmat chhupaane aur logon ke dilon mein shubhaat daalne mein bada azaab hai. Is ke bawajood jab unhone haq chhupaaya to yaqeenan maghfirat ke badle azaab khareed liya. (تفسیر کبیر، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۱۷۵، ۲ / ۲۰۶)

blocks.text: Arabic: لَیْسَ الْبِرَّ اَنْ تُوَلُّوْا وُجُوْهَكُمْ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ لٰـكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ الْیَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَ الْمَلٰٓىٕكَةِ وَ الْكِتٰبِ وَ النَّبِیّٖنَۚ-وَ اٰتَى الْمَالَ عَلٰى حُبِّهٖ ذَوِی الْقُرْبٰى وَ الْیَتٰمٰى وَ الْمَسٰكِیْنَ وَ ابْنَ السَّبِیْلِۙ-وَ السَّآىٕلِیْنَ وَ فِی الرِّقَابِۚ-وَ اَقَامَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰتَى الزَّكٰوةَۚ-وَ الْمُوْفُوْنَ بِعَهْدِهِمْ اِذَا عٰهَدُوْاۚ-وَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ فِی الْبَاْسَآءِ وَ الضَّرَّآءِ وَ حِیْنَ الْبَاْسِؕ-اُولٰٓىٕكَ الَّذِیْنَ صَدَقُوْاؕ-وَ اُولٰٓىٕكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ(177)

Sirf Qiblah ki taraf munh kar lena asal neki nahin, jab tak aqeede durust na hon aur dil ikhlaas ke saath Rabb-e-Qiblah ki taraf mutawajjah na ho.

blocks.text: Yeh baat bhi yaad rakhni chahiye ke farz aur zaroori aamaal ada karte hue, aur doosron ke amal ko haqeer na samajhte hue, kisi khaas amal ko zyada muhabbat aur shauq se baar-baar karna durust hai. Lekin farz aur waajib chhod kar, ya apne amal aur tareeqe ke ilawa doosron ke amal ko haqeer samajh kar kisi ek amal ko hi achha samajhna bilkul ghalat hai. Misal ke taur par jo shakhs zyada roze rakhta hai woh roze na rakhne wale ko haqeer na samjhe. Jo zikr-o-durood zyada karta hai woh Deen ki tableegh mein mashghool shakhs ko kamtar na samjhe. Jo wa'z-o-naseehat karta hai woh tehreer, tasneef aur taleem ke zariye Deen ki khidmat karne wale ko kamtar na samjhe.

Rishwat, haraam khori, sood, faisla karne mein na-insaafi, bughz-o-keena aur doosre gunaahon mein diler the. Qiblah ke masle mein haq baat maloom hone ke bawajood bila wajah jhagadte aur sirf apna khaas Qiblah rakhna kaafi samajhte the. Aayat se maloom hua ke aamaal se pehle imaan hai. blocks.text: Doosra, Qayamat par imaan laayein ke woh haq hai. Us mein bandon ka hisaab hoga, aamaal ka badla diya jaayega, Allah ki baargaah ke maqbool bande shafaa'at karenge, Huzoor Sayyid-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ sa'adatmandon ko Hauz-e-Kausar par sairaab farmayenge, Pul-Siraat se guzarna hoga aur us din ke tamam halaat jo Quran mein aaye hain ya Sayyid-ul-Anbiya صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ne bayan farmaye hain, sab haq hain.

blocks.text: (3) Miskeenon par kharch karna: Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: ’’Miskeen woh nahin jo logon mein ghoomta rahe aur ek ya do luqme ya ek ya do khajoor le kar chala jaaye. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ne arz ki: Ya Rasool Allah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ, phir miskeen kaun hai? blocks.text: (4) Musaafiron par kharch karna: Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Huzoor Anwar صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: ’’Momin ko us ke amal aur nekiyon ka sawaab us ke inteqaal ke baad bhi milta rehta hai: woh ilm jis ki us ne taleem di aur phailaaya, nek aulaad jo chhod kar gaya, woh Mushaf jo viraasat mein chhoda, woh masjid jo banaayi, musaafir ke liye woh ghar jo banaaya, woh nahar jo jaari ki, ya apni sehat aur zindagi mein apne maal se nikala hua sadaqah jo us ke inteqaal ke baad bhi use milta rahe. blocks.text: Sadr-ush-Shariah Mufti Amjad Ali A'zami رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: ’’Aaj kal ek aam museebat phaili hui hai ke tandurust log chahein to kama kar doosron ko khila sakte hain, lekin unhone apne aap ko bekaar bana rakha hai. Kaun mehnat kare aur museebat sahe? Baghair mehnat jo mil jaaye to takleef kyun uthaye? Woh najaaiz tareeqe se sawaal karte aur bheek maang kar pait bharte hain. Bahut se log mazdoori to door, chhoti moti tijaarat ko bhi sharm aur zaleel samajhte hain, lekin bheek maangna, jo asal mein un ke liye be-izzati aur be-ghairati hai, use izzat samajhte hain.

blocks.text: Bahut se logon ne bheek maangna apna pesha bana liya hai. Ghar mein hazaaron rupay hain, sood ka lena-dena karte hain, kheti-baari waghera karte hain, magar bheek maangna nahin chhodte. Jab un se kaha jaata hai to jawab dete hain: Yeh hamara pesha hai. Waah sahib waah! Kya hum apna pesha chhod dein? Haalaanke aise logon ke liye sawaal haraam hai, aur jis ko un ki haalat maloom ho us ke liye unhein dena jaaiz nahin. (بہار شریعت، حصہ پنجم، سوال کسے حلال ہے اور کسے نہیں، ۱ / ۹۴۰-۹۴۱)

blocks.text: (6) Ghulamon ko azaad karaane mein kharch karna: Gardanein chhudaane se ghulaam aur laundiyan azaad karna muraad hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ bayan karte hain ke Huzoor Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: ’’Jo Musalman mard kisi Musalman mard ko azaad karega, Allah Ta'ala ghulaam ke har uzw ke badle azaad karne wale ke har uzw ko Jahannam se azaad farmayega. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Marjaanah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ kehte hain: Jab maine yeh hadees Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se suni aur Hazrat Ali bin Husain رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما ko bataayi to unhone apne ek ghulaam ko azaad kar diya, jis ki Hazrat Abdullah bin Ja'far رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما das hazaar dirham ya ek hazaar dinaar qeemat de rahe the. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae imaan waalo! Tum par maqtoolon ke khoon ka badla lena farz kar diya gaya, azaad ke badle azaad aur ghulaam ke badle ghulaam aur aurat ke badle aurat. To jis ke liye us ke bhai ki taraf se kuchh maafi di jaaye to achhe tareeqe se mutaalabah ho aur waaris ko achhe tareeqe se adaaiygi ho. Yeh tumhare Rab ki taraf se aasaani aur rahmat hai. To is ke baad jo zyaadti kare us ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.

blocks.text: Khulaasa yeh hai ke qatl-e-amad ki surat mein qaatil par qisaas waajib hai, chahe us ne azaad ko qatl kiya ho ya ghulaam ko, mard ko qatl kiya ho ya aurat ko, kyunke aayat mein ’’قَتْلٰى‘‘ ka lafz sab ko shaamil hai. Albatta kuchh afraad is hukm se mustasna hain, jin ki tafseel fiqhi kitaabon mein dekhi ja sakti hai. Jo qatl karega wahi qatl kiya jaayega, chahe azaad ho ya ghulaam, mard ho ya aurat. Zamaana-e-Jaahiliyyat ki tarah ek ke badle do ko qatl karna, ghulaam ke badle azaad ko maarna, aurat ke badle mard ko qatl karna ya qaatil ke ilawa bahut se logon ko qatl karna mana hai.

blocks.text: {وَ لَكُمْ فِی الْقِصَاصِ حَیٰوةٌ: Khoon ka badla lene mein tumhari zindagi hai.} Qisaas mein qaumon aur logon ki zindagi hai. Jis qaum mein zaalim ki pardah-poshi aur himaayat ki jaaye woh tabaah ho jaati hai. Jahan zaalim aur mujrim ko saza di jaaye wahan jurm khud kam ho jaate hain. Mohalle se lekar poori duniya tak mujrim logon ke maamle mein yahi usool kaam karta hai. Ghor karein to maloom ho jaata hai ke jin mumalik mein jurm par sakht sazaayein naafiz hain wahan jurm kitne hain, aur jahan mujrim ko saza nahin di jaati wahan jurm kitne hain.

blocks.text: Wasiyyat ke waajib hone ka hukm mansookh ho chuka hai, lekin wasiyyat jaaiz hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما se riwaayat hai ke Rasool Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: ’’Kisi Musalman ke liye munasib nahin ke us ke paas maal ho aur woh do raat is tarah guzaare ke us ki wasiyyat us ke paas likhi hui na ho. blocks.text: Is aayat mein farmaya gaya: “Jaise tum se pehle logon par farz kiye gaye the.” Is se maloom hota hai ke roza bahut qadeem ibaadat hai. Hazrat Adam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام se lekar tamaam Shariaton mein roze farz hote chale aaye hain, agarche pichhli ummaton ke rozon ke din aur ahkaam hum se mukhtalif the. Yaad rahe ke safar se muraad teen din ki musaafat, yaani saadhe sataawan meel, yani baanwe (92km) kilometer hai. Is se kam safar ho to roza chhodne ki ijaazat nahin. (درّ مختار مع رد المحتار، کتاب الصوم، فصل فی العوارض المبیحۃ لعدم الصوم،۳ / ۴۶۲-۴۶۳)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ramazan ka mahina hai jis mein Quran naazil kiya gaya, jo logon ke liye hidaayat aur rehnumaai hai aur faisle ki roshan baaton par mushtamil hai. To tum mein jo koi yeh mahina paaye to zaroor is ke roze rakhe, aur jo beemaar ho ya safar mein ho to itne roze aur dinon mein rakhe. Allah tum par aasaani chahta hai aur tum par dushwaari nahin chahta, aur yeh aasaaniyan is liye hain taake tum rozon ki tadaad poori kar lo aur taake tum is baat par Allah ki badaai bayan karo ke Us ne tumhein hidaayat di, aur taake tum shukr-guzaar bano.

runs.text: Azmat Wali Cheez Se Nisbat Ki Barkat

blocks.text: Ramazan wahid mahina hai jis ka naam Quran-e-Paak mein aaya. Quran-e-Majeed se nisbat ki wajah se Maah-e-Ramazan ko azmat-o-sharaafat mili. Is se maloom hua ke jis waqt ko kisi sharaf-o-azmat wali cheez se nisbat ho jaaye, woh Qayamat tak sharaf wala ho jaata hai. Isi liye jis din aur ghadi ko Huzoor Pur Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ki wiladat aur Mi'raaj se nisbat hai, woh azmat-o-sharaafat wale ho gaye. Jaise Hazrat Adam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki Juma ke din paidaish ki wajah se Juma ka din azmat wala ho gaya. (مسلم، کتاب الجمعۃ، باب فضل یوم الجمعۃ، ص۴۲۵، الحدیث: ۱۷(۸۵۴))

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tumhare liye rozon ki raaton mein apni auraton ke paas jaana halaal kar diya gaya. Woh tumhare liye libaas hain aur tum un ke liye libaas ho. Allah ko maaloom hai ke tum apni jaanon ko khayaanat mein daalte the, to Us ne tumhari tauba qubool ki aur tumhein maaf farma diya. To ab un se hum-bistari kar lo aur jo Allah ne tumhare naseeb mein likha hai use talab karo, aur khaao aur piyo yahan tak ke tumhare liye fajr se safedi subah ka dhaga syaahi raat ke dhage se mumtaaz ho jaaye. Phir raat aane tak rozon ko poora karo aur auraton se hum-bistari na karo jab tum masjidon mein aitikaaf se ho. Yeh Allah ki hadein hain, to in ke paas na jao. Allah yunhi logon ke liye apni aayaat khol kar bayan farmata hai taake woh parhezgaar ho jaayen.

runs.text: Sawm-e-Wisaal Ka Hukm

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke iftaar kiye baghair agla roza rakh lena aur is tarah lagataar roze rakhna Sawm-e-Wisaal kehlaata hai. Yeh mana hain. Is ki ijaazat sirf Huzoor Pur Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko thi aur yeh Aap ki khaasiyat mein se hai.

runs.text: Aitikaaf Ke Fazaail

blocks.text: Is aayat mein aitikaaf karne wale ke baare mein ek Sharai mas'ale ka bayan hua. Isi munasibat se yahan aitikaaf ke baare mein Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ka amal-e-mubaarak, aitikaaf ke fazaail aur is se muta'alliq mazeed masaa'il bayan kiye jaate hain.

blocks.text: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain ke Huzoor Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Ramazan-ul-Mubarak ke pehle ashre mein aitikaaf kiya. Phir ek Turki khaime mein Ramazan ke darmiyani ashre mein aitikaaf kiya. Us ke darwaaze par chataai lagi hui thi. Aap ne apne haath se chataai hata kar khaime ke ek kone mein kar di, phir khaime se sar baahar nikaal kar logon se farmaya: “Main is raat, yani Shab-e-Qadr, ki talaash mein pehle ashre ka aitikaaf karta tha, phir darmiyani ashre mein aitikaaf kiya. Phir mere paas koi farishta aaya aur meri taraf wahi ki gayi ke yeh aakhri ashre mein hai. Tum mein se jis ko pasand ho woh aitikaaf kare.” Chunanche logon ne Aap ke saath aitikaaf kiya. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tum se naye chaand ke baare mein sawaal karte hain. Tum farma do, yeh logon aur Hajj ke liye waqt ki alaamatein hain. Aur yeh koi neki nahin ke tum gharon mein pichhli deewar tod kar aao. Haan asal nek to parhezgaar hota hai. Aur gharon mein un ke darwaazon se aao aur Allah se darte raho, is umeed par ke tum falaah paao.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur Hajj aur Umrah Allah ke liye poora karo. Phir agar tumhein Makkah se rok diya jaaye to Haram mein qurbani ka jaanwar bhejo jo mayassar aaye, aur apne sar na mundao jab tak qurbani apne thikaane par na pahunch jaaye. Phir jo tum mein beemaar ho ya us ke sar mein kuchh takleef hai to rozon ya khairaat ya qurbani ka fidya de. Phir jab tum itminaan se ho to jo Hajj se Umrah milaane ka faida uthaaye us par qurbani laazim hai jaisi mayassar ho. Phir jo qurbani ki qudrat na paaye to teen roze Hajj ke dinon mein rakhe aur saat roze ghar lautne par. Yeh poore das hain. Yeh us ke liye hai jo Makkah ka rehne wala na ho. Allah se darte raho aur jaan rakho ke Allah shadeed azaab dene wala hai.

Bila uzr khilaaf-warzi gunaah aur fidye ka sabab hai; majboori mein gunaah nahin, lekin fidya dena hota hai. Sadr-ush-Shariah Maulana Amjad Ali A'zami رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Beemaari, garmi, sardi, zakhm, phode ya joon ki takleef se dam wale jurm mein chhe miskeenon ko sadaqah dene, dono waqt khilaane ya teen roze rakhne ka ikhtiyaar hai. Sadaqah wale jurm mein majboori ki wajah se ek roza rakh sakte hain.” (بہار شریعت، حصہ ششم، جرم اور ان کے کفارے کا بیان، ۱ / ۱۱۶۲)

blocks.text: {فَمَنْ تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ اِلَى الْحَجِّ: To jo Hajj se Umrah milaane ka faida uthaaye.} Ek safar mein Hajj-o-Umrah karne wale par shukraane ki alag qurbani laazim hai. blocks.text: Islami Ahkaam Sab Ke Liye Baraabar Hain

runs.text: Islami Ahkaam Sab Ke Liye Baraabar Hain

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke Islami ahkaam biradari, rutbe ya maqam ki wajah se nahin badalte. Ameer-ghareeb, gora-kaala aur Arabi-Ajami sab ke liye ahkaam baraabar hain. Hazrat Aaishah Siddiqah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا farmati hain ke Quraish ek Makhzoomi aurat ki chori par pareshaan hue. Hazrat Usaamah bin Zaid رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne sifaarish ki to Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Kya tum Allah Ta'ala ki hudood ke baare mein sifaarish kar rahe ho?” Phir farmaya: “Tum se pehle log is liye halaak hue ke maaldaar chori karta to use chhod dete aur ghareeb chori karta to hadd qaem karte. Khuda ki qasam! Agar Muhammad ki beti Faatimah bhi chori karti to main us ka haath kaat deta.” (بخاری، کتاب احادیث الانبیاء، ۵۶-باب، ۲ / ۴۶۸، الحدیث: ۳۴۷۵)

blocks.text: Tareekh-e-Islam mein qaaziyon ke aise waaqiaat hain. Hazrat Sa'd bin Ibraheem رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ Khalifah Waleed bin Yazeed ki taraf se Madinah ke qaazi the. Shaam jaate hue sarhad par rok diye gaye. Ek raat masjid mein unhone Khalifah ke maamoon ko nashe mein ghoomte dekha. Pata chala ke us ne sharaab pi hai. Hazrat Sa'd رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne durrah mangwa kar farmaya: “Mujh par Sharai saza naafiz karna laazim hai, chahe yeh koi bhi ho. blocks.text: Momin ka duniya ki bhalaai maangna jaaiz hai, khaas taur par Deen ki taaeed ke liye. Lekin Aakhirat ko bhool kar sirf duniya maangna Musalman ke shayaan-e-shaan nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai:

runs.text: Momin ka duniya ki bhalaai maangna jaaiz hai, khaas taur par Deen ki taaeed ke liye. Lekin Aakhirat ko bhool kar sirf duniya maangna Musalman ke shayaan-e-shaan nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai:

blocks.text: مَنْ كَانَ یُرِیْدُ الْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهٗ فِیْهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَنْ نُّرِیْدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَۚ-یَصْلٰىهَا مَذْمُوْمًا مَّدْحُوْرًا(۱۸)وَ مَنْ اَرَادَ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَ سَعٰى لَهَا سَعْیَهَا وَ هُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓىٕكَ كَانَ سَعْیُهُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا(بنی اسرائیل:۱۸، ۱۹)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Jo jaldi wali duniya chahta hai, hum jis ke liye chahte hain us ke liye duniya mein jo chahte hain jaldi de dete hain. Phir us ke liye Jahannam hai jis mein woh mazmoom, mardood ho kar daakhil hoga. Aur jo Aakhirat chahta hai, us ke liye zaroori koshish karta hai aur imaan wala hai, us ki koshish ki qadr ki jaayegi.

Yeh duniya ki zindagi ka saamaan hai aur Allah ke paas achha thikaana hai. Ae Habeeb! Farmaao: Kya main tumhein in se behtar bata doon? blocks.text: {مَنْ یَّشْرِیْ نَفْسَهُ: Jo apni jaan bechta hai.} Shaan-e-nuzool: Hazrat Suhaib Rumi رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ Makkah Mukarramah se hijrat karke Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّى اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat mein Madinah Tayyibah ki taraf rawana hue. Quraish ke mushrikon ki ek jamaat ne aap ka peecha kiya. Aap sawaari se utar gaye, tarkash se teer nikaal kar farmaaya: “Ae Quraish! Tum mein se koi mere paas nahin aa sakta jab tak main teer maar maar kar apna poora tarkash khaali na kar doon. Phir jab tak talwaar mere haath mein rahegi, main us se maarunga. Agar tum mera maal chaahte ho jo Makkah Mukarramah mein dafan hai to main tumhein us ka pata bata deta hoon. Tum mera raasta na roko.”

blocks.text: {اُدْخُلُوْا فِی السِّلْمِ كَآفَّةً: Islam mein poore poore daakhil ho jao.} Shaan-e-nuzool: Ahle Kitaab mein se Hazrat Abdullah bin Salaam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ aur un ke saathi Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّى اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہ وَسَلَّمَ par imaan laane ke baad Shariat-e-Moosavi ke kuchh ahkaam par qayam rahe. Woh Shanivaar ke din ki ta'zeem karte, us din shikaar se zaroor bachna samajhte aur oont ke doodh aur gosht se bhi parhez karte the. Un ka khayaal tha ke Islam mein yeh cheezein sirf mubaah, yaani jaaiz hain; in ka karna zaroori nahin. Jab Tauraat mein in se bachna laazim kiya gaya hai to inhein chhorne mein Islam ki mukhaalifat bhi nahin hoti aur Shariat-e-Moosavi par amal bhi ho jaata hai.

blocks.text: Imani Kamzori Ki Alamat

runs.text: Imani Kamzori Ki Alamat

blocks.text: Yaad rakhein ke daarhi mundwana, mushrikon jaisa libaas pehenna aur apna muashra be-Deen logon jaisa banana bhi imaan ki kamzori ki alamat hai. Jab Musalman ho gaye to apni seerat o soorat, zahir o baatin, ibaadaat o muamlaat, rehne sehne, milne julne, zindagi o maut, tijaarat o mulaazmat sab mein apne Deen par amal karo.

runs.text: Yaad rakhein ke daarhi mundwana, mushrikon jaisa libaas pehenna aur apna muashra be-Deen logon jaisa banana bhi imaan ki kamzori ki alamat hai. Jab Musalman ho gaye to apni seerat o soorat, zahir o baatin, ibaadaat o muamlaat, rehne sehne, milne julne, zindagi o maut, tijaarat o mulaazmat sab mein apne Deen par amal karo.

blocks.text: Yeh bhi maaloom hua ke Musalman ka doosre mazaahib ya doosre Deen walon ki ri'aayat karna Shaitaani dhoke mein aana hai. Islam mein oont ka gosht khaana farz nahin, lekin Yahoodiyat ki ri'aayat ke liye use na khaana bahut bada jurm hai. Kaafiron ko raazi karne ke liye gaaye ki qurbaani band kar dena bhi isi mein daakhil hai. Isi tarah kisi jagah azaan band kar dena ya azaan dheemi aawaaz se dena bhi isi mein daakhil hai.

blocks.text: {زُیِّنَ لِلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوا الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَا: Kaafiron ki nigah mein duniya ki zindagi ko khushnuma bana diya gaya.} Kaafiron ke liye duniya ki zindagi saja di gayi. Unhein yahi zindagi pasand hai, woh isi ko qeemti samajhte aur isi par marte hain. Jo zindagi nafs ki khwahishaat mein guzre woh duniyaavi zindagi hai, aur jo Aakhirat ka samaan jama karne mein guzre woh Allah ke fazl se Deeni zindagi hai. Is mein Aakhirat se ghaafil log bhi shaamil hain.

blocks.text: {وَ یَسْخَرُوْنَ مِنَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا: Aur woh Musalmanon par hanste hain.} Kaafir ghareeb Musalmanon ka mazaaq udaate aur duniyaavi samaan se be-raghbati dekh kar unhein haqeer samajhte the, jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir, Hazrat Suhaib aur Hazrat Bilal رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ka mazaaq udaaya karte the. Woh duniya ke maal ke ghamand mein apne aap ko bada samajhte the. (خازن، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۲۱۲، ۱ / ۱۵۰)

blocks.text: Qayamat ke din imaan wale in kaafiron se buland honge; momin Allah ke qurb mein aur kaafir Jahannam mein zaleel honge. Is se maloom hua ke ghareeb Musalman ka mazaaq udaana ya kisi momin ko zaleel aur kamtar samajhna kaafiron ka tareeqa hai. Faasiq aur kaafir maaldaar ho tab bhi zaleel hai, aur momin ghareeb ho aur kisi bhi qaum se ho izzat wala hai, bashart-e-ke muttaqi ho.

blocks.text: Arabic: كَانَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً- فَبَعَثَ اللّٰهُ النَّبِیّٖنَ مُبَشِّرِیْنَ وَ مُنْذِرِیْنَ۪-وَ اَنْزَلَ مَعَهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ لِیَحْكُمَ بَیْنَ النَّاسِ فِیْمَا اخْتَلَفُوْا فِیْهِؕ-وَ مَا اخْتَلَفَ فِیْهِ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوْهُ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ الْبَیِّنٰتُ بَغْیًۢا بَیْنَهُمْۚ-فَهَدَى اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لِمَا اخْتَلَفُوْا فِیْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِاِذْنِهٖؕ-وَ اللّٰهُ یَهْدِیْ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ(213)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tamaam log ek Deen par the to Allah ne Ambiya bheje, khushkhabri dete aur daraate hue, aur un ke saath sachchi Kitaab utaari taake woh logon ke darmiyaan un ke ikhtilaafaat mein faisla kare. Jinhein Kitaab di gayi unhone hi baahmi bughz-o-hasad ki wajah se us mein ikhtilaaf kiya, is ke baad ke un ke paas roshan ahkaam aa chuke the. To Allah ne imaan walon ko apne hukm se us haq baat ki hidaayat di jis mein log jhagad rahe the, aur Allah jise chahta hai seedhi raah dikhaata hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Kya tumhara yeh gumaan hai ke Jannat mein daakhil ho jaoge, haalanke abhi tum par pehle logon jaisi haalat nahin aayi? Unhein sakhti aur shiddat pahunchi aur unhein zor se hila diya gaya, yahan tak ke Rasool aur un ke saath imaan wale keh uthe: Allah ki madad kab aayegi? Sun lo! Beshak Allah ki madad qareeb hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aap se Maah-e-Haraam mein jihaad ke baare mein poochhte hain. Tum farmaao: Is mahine mein ladna bada gunaah hai aur Allah ki raah se rokna, Us par imaan na laana, Masjid-e-Haraam se rokna aur us ke rehne walon ko wahan se nikaal dena Allah ke nazdeek is se bhi bada gunaah hai. Fitna qatl se bada jurm hai. Woh hamesha tum se ladte rahenge, yahan tak ke agar un se ho sake to tumhein tumhare Deen se pher dein. Tum mein jo apne Deen se phir jaaye aur kaafir hi mare, us ke sab amal duniya aur Aakhirat mein barbaad ho gaye. Woh Jahannam wale hain aur us mein hamesha rahenge.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aap se sharaab aur jooye ke baare mein poochhte hain. blocks.text: Sharaab Aur Jooye Ki Mazammat

runs.text: Sharaab Aur Jooye Ki Mazammat

blocks.text: Sharaab se aql aur ghairat khatam hoti, maa, behen aur beti mein farq nahin rehta, ibaadat se dil uktata aur us ki lazzat chali jaati hai. Jooye se dushmaniyaan paida hoti, juwaari zaleel hota, maal haar jaata, zindagi barbaad hoti aur mehnat se ji churaane ki aadat padti hai. Sharaab ka suroor aur tijaarati faida, aur jooye mein kabhi milne wala muft maal, in gunaahon ke muqaable mein kuchh nahin.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Mushrik auraton se nikaah na karo jab tak woh Musalman na ho jaayen. Musalman laundee mushrik aurat se behtar hai agarche woh tumhein pasand ho. Musalman auraton ko mushrik mardon ke nikaah mein na do jab tak woh imaan na le aayein. Musalman ghulaam mushrik se behtar hai agarche woh tumhein pasand ho. Woh Jahannam ki taraf bulaate hain aur Allah apne hukm se Jannat aur bakhshish ki taraf bulaata hai aur logon ke liye aayatein bayan karta hai taake woh naseehat haasil karein.

blocks.text: Neki Se Rukne Ki Qasam Khaane Wala Kya Kare?

runs.text: Neki Se Rukne Ki Qasam Khaane Wala Kya Kare?

blocks.text: Ek aham masla yaad rakhein: Agar koi shakhs neki se rukne ki qasam kha le to qasam poori na kare. Woh nek kaam kare aur qasam ka kaffara de. Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat Muslim Shareef ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Akram صَلَّى اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Jis shakhs ne kisi kaam par qasam khaai, phir maaloom hua ke behtari us ke khilaaf karne mein hai, to use chahiye ke woh nek kaam kare aur qasam ka kaffara de.” (مسلم، کتاب الایمان، باب ندب من حلف یمینًا۔۔۔ الخ، ص ۸۹۸، الحدیث: ۱۲(۱۶۵۰))

Yeh sakht aib ki baat hai.” (بہار شریعت، حصہ نہم، قسم کا بیان، ۲ / ۲۹۸) [1]

Agar biwiyan dene se inkaar kartin to ek saal, do saal, teen saal ya is se zyaada muddat tak un ke paas na jaane aur hum-bistari chhodne ki qasam kha lete. Is tarah auraton ko pareshani mein chhod dete: na woh bewa hotin ke kahin aur apna thikaana bana lein aur na shohar wali hotin ke shohar se sukoon haasil kar sakein. Islam ne is zulm ko mitaaya aur aisi qasam khaane walon ke liye chaar mahine ki muddat muqarrar farma di.

blocks.text: Agar koi shakhs chaar mahine ya is se zyaada, ya be-muayyan muddat tak hum-bistari chhodne ki qasam khaaye, jise ilaa kehte hain, to us ke liye chaar mahine intezaar ki mohlat hai. Is dauraan achhi tarah soch le ke biwi ko chhodna behtar hai ya rakhna. Agar rakhna behtar samjhe aur muddat ke andar rujoo kar le to nikaah baaqi rahega aur qasam ka kaffara laazim hoga. Agar is muddat mein rujoo na kiya aur qasam na todi to aurat nikaah se baahar ho jaayegi aur talaaq-e-baa'in waaqe ho jaayegi. Yeh bhi auraton par Islam ke ehsanaat aur un ke huqooq ki hifaazat ki nishaani hai. [1]

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur talaaq wali auratein apni jaanon ko teen haiz tak roke rakhein aur unhein halaal nahin ke us ko chhupaayen jo Allah ne un ke pet mein paida kiya hai agar Allah aur Qayamat par imaan rakhti hain. Aur un ke shohar is muddat ke andar unhein phair lene ka haq rakhte hain agar woh islaah ka iraada rakhte hon. Aur auraton ke liye bhi mardon par Shariat ke mutabiq aisa hi haq hai jaisa un ka auraton par hai aur mardon ko un par fazeelat haasil hai. Aur Allah Ghaalib, Hikmat wala hai.

Shariat ne talaaq dene aur biwi ko rakhne dono sooraton mein bhalaai aur khair-khwaahi ka hukm diya hai. Allah Ta'ala hidaayat ata farmaaye, Aameen.

blocks.text: {وَ لَا یَحِلُّ لَكُمْ: Aur tumhein halaal nahin.} Shohar ka apna diya hua mehr wapas lena, jab khula na ho, bilkul najaaiz aur haraam hai. Agar aurat khula le aur maal ada kare to yeh jaaiz hai. Agar zyadti mard ki taraf se ho to khula mein maal lena makrooh hai. Agar zyadti aurat ki taraf se ho to maal lena durust hai, lekin mehr se zyaada lena phir bhi makrooh hai. (فتاوی عالمگیری، کتاب الطلاق، الباب الثامن، الفصل الاول، ۱ / ۴۸۸)

blocks.text: (1) Baghair wajah aurat ka talaaq ka mutaalaba karna haraam hai. Hazrat Sauban رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Huzoor Aqdas صَلَّى اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Jo aurat apne shohar se baghair wajah talaaq ka mutaalaba kare, us par Jannat ki khushboo haraam hai.” (ابو داؤد، کتاب الطلاق، باب فی الخلع، ۲ / ۳۹۰، الحدیث: ۲۲۲۶)

blocks.text: Teen talaaq teen mahine mein di jaayen, ek mahine mein, ek din mein, ek hi majlis mein ya ek hi jumle mein, har soorat mein teenon waaqe ho jaati hain aur aurat mard par haraam ho jaati hai. Teen talaaq ke baad baghair shar'i tareeqe ke mard aur aurat ka hum-bistari waghera karna saaf haraam aur najaaiz hai. Aisi sulah ki koshish karwane wale bhi gunaah mein barabar ke shareek hain. Tafseel ke liye Ulama-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat ki kitaabon ki taraf rujoo karein.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur jab tum auraton ko talaaq do aur woh apni iddat ki ikhtitaami muddat ke qareeb pahunch jaayen to us waqt unhein achhe tareeqe se rok lo ya achhe tareeqe se chhod do aur unhein nuqsaan pahunchane ke liye na rok rakho taake tum un par zyadti karo. Aur jo aisa kare to us ne apni jaan par zulm kiya. Aur Allah ki aayaton ko thattha mazaaq na bana lo. Aur apne upar Allah ka ehsaan yaad karo aur us ne tum par jo kitaab aur hikmat utaari hai, use yaad karo. Is ke zariye woh tumhein naseehat farmata hai. Aur Allah se darte raho aur jaan rakho ke Allah sab kuchh jaanne wala hai.

blocks.text: Aayat ka khulaasa yeh hai ke jab kisi aurat ki iddat guzar jaaye aur iddat ke baad woh kisi se nikaah ka iraada kare, chahe woh koi naya aadmi ho ya wahi jis ne talaaq di thi, to agar mard aur aurat dono raazi hon to aurat ke sarparaston ko baghair wajah rokne ka haq nahin. Is hukm ki ahmiyat samjhaane ke liye farmaya gaya ke yeh us har shakhs ko naseehat hai jo Allah Ta'ala aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhta ho. Mazeed farmaya ke is hukm par amal karna tumhare liye zyaada paakizgi ka sabab hai. Kabhi pichhle ta'alluqaat ki wajah se auratein ghalat qadam utha leti hain jo baad mein sab ke liye pareshaani ka sabab banta hai. Is liye auraton ko baghair wajah dobara nikaah se na roko. Tum apni haqeeqi hikmat aur maslihat nahin jaante, Allah Ta'ala jaanta hai. Yaad rahe ke agar aurat ghair-kufu mein wali ki ijaazat ke baghair nikaah kare to wahan waliyon ka haq hota hai. Tafseel ke liye Bahar-e-Shariat, hissa 7 mein “Kufu ka bayaan” padhein.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur maaen apne bachchon ko poore do saal doodh pilaayen. Yeh hukm us ke liye hai jo doodh pilaane ki muddat poori karna chahe. Aur bachche ke baap par rivaaj ke mutabiq auraton ke khaane aur pehne ki zimmedaari hai. Kisi jaan par utna hi bojh rakha jaayega jitni us ki taaqat ho. Maa ko us ki aulaad ki wajah se takleef na di jaaye aur na baap ko us ki aulaad ki wajah se takleef di jaaye. Aur jo baap ka qaem-maqaam hai us par bhi aisa hi hukm hai. Phir agar maa-baap dono aapas ki raza-mandi aur mashware se doodh chhudaana chahein to un par gunaah nahin. Aur agar tum chaaho ke apne bachchon ko doosri auraton se doodh pilwaao to bhi tum par koi haraj nahin, jab ke jo muawza dena tum ne muqarrar kiya ho use bhale tareeqe se ada kar do. Aur Allah se darte raho aur jaan rakho ke Allah tumhare kaam dekh raha hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur tum par is baat mein koi gunaah nahin jo ishaare-kinaaye se tum auraton ko nikaah ka paighaam do ya apne dil mein chhupa rakho. Allah ko maloom hai ke ab tum un ka tazkirah karoge, lekin un se khufiya waada na rakho magar yeh ke Shariat ke mutabiq koi baat keh lo. Aur aqd-e-nikaah ko pakka na karo jab tak iddat ka likha hua hukm apni ikhtitaami muddat ko na pahunch jaaye. Aur jaan lo ke Allah tumhare dil ki jaanta hai, to us se daro. Aur jaan lo ke Allah bahut bakhshne wala, burdbaar hai.

blocks.text: {حٰفِظُوْا عَلَى الصَّلَوٰتِ: Sab namazon ki pabandi karo.} Nikaah aur talaaq ke masail bayaan karte hue namaz ki takeed farma di gayi. Goya yeh samjhaana maqsood hai ke bandon ke huqooq ada karte hue Khaliq-o-Maalik ke huqooq se ghaafil na ho jaao. Paanch waqt ki farz namazein un ke auqaat mein arkaan aur sharaait ke saath ada karte raho, kyunke Shariat ke doosre maamlaat mein Allah ke hukm par amal usi waqt hoga jab dil ki islaah hogi, aur dil ki islaah namaz ki pabandi se hoti hai.

blocks.text: {فَاِنْ خِفْتُمْ: Phir agar tum khauf ki haalat mein ho.} Yahan dushman ya darinde waghera ke khauf ki haalat mein namaz ka hukm aur tareeqa bayaan kiya gaya hai. Agar khauf ki aisi soorat ho ke ek jagah theharna mumkin na rahe to paidal chalte hue ya sawaari par jaise mumkin ho namaz padh lo. Is namaz ko dobara padhna bhi nahin padega. Jidhar ja rahe hon, udhar hi munh karke namaz padh lein; Qiblah ki taraf munh karna shart nahin. Jab aman ki haalat ho to phir mamool ke mutabiq namaz padhein. Lekin agar khauf ki aisi haalat ho jis mein theharna mumkin ho, jaise jung ke mauqe par dushman ke hamle ka dar ho lekin kisi jagah thehre hue bhi hon, to ba-jamaat namaz padhne ka tareeqa Surah Nisa ki aayat 102 mein mazkoor hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur jo tum mein faut ho jaayen aur biwiyan chhod jaayen, woh apni auraton ke liye unhein gharon se nikaale baghair ek saal tak kharch dene ki wasiyyat kar jaayen. Phir agar woh khud nikal jaayen to tum par is maamle mein koi pakad nahin jo woh apne baare mein Shariat ke mutabiq karein. Aur Allah Zabar-dast, Hikmat wala hai.

Is ek saal mein woh shohar ke ghar reh kar naana-o-nafqah paane ki mustahiq hoti thi. Phir ek saal ki iddat Surah Baqarah ki aayat 234 “یَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِاَنْفُسِهِنَّ اَرْبَعَةَ اَشْهُرٍ وَّ عَشْرًا” se mansookh hui, jis mein bewa ki iddat chaar mahine das din muqarrar farmaayi gayi. Is liye ab is wasiyyat ka hukm baaqi nahin raha.

runs.text: Maut ke dar se bhaag kar jaan nahin bachai ja sakti

blocks.text: Is waqiye se maloom hua ke aadmi maut ke dar se bhaag kar jaan nahin bacha sakta. Jo maut muqaddar hai woh zaroor aayegi, is liye bhaagna bekaar hai. Aadmi ko Allah Ta'ala ki raza par raazi rehna chahiye. Mujahideen ko bhi samajhna chahiye ke jihaad se baith rehna maut ko nahin taal sakta, is liye dil mazboot rakhna chahiye. Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aayat 168 aur Surah Ahzaab ki aayat 16 mein bhi yahi mazmoon bayaan hua hai.

Yeh Allah Ta'ala ka bahut bada karam hai, kyunke banda Allah Ta'ala ka banaya hua hai aur us ka maal bhi Allah Ta'ala ka diya hua hai. Asal Maalik Allah Ta'ala hai, jabke banda us ki ata se majazi maalik hai. Qarz kehne ka maqsad yeh hai ke jis tarah qarz dene wala mutma'in hota hai ke us ka maal zaya nahin hoga aur woh wapas milne ka mustahiq hai, isi tarah Allah ki raah mein kharch karne wale ko yaqeen rakhna chahiye ke us kharch ka badla zaroor milega. Woh bhi mamooli nahin, balki kai guna badha kar milega. Yeh badla saat sau guna aur is se bhi laakhon guna zyaada ho sakta hai, jaisa ke Surah Baqarah ki aayat 261 mein hai. Sadaqah se duniya mein maal mein barkat hoti hai aur Aakhirat mein ajr-o-sawaab milta hai. blocks.text: {وَ اللّٰهُ یَقْبِضُ وَ یَبْصُۜطُ: Aur Allah tangi deta hai aur wus'at deta hai.} Is hisse mein Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ki fazeelat bayaan hui. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aye Habeeb! Kya tum ne Bani Israeel ke ek giroh ko na dekha jo Moosa ke baad hua, jab unhone apne ek Nabi se kaha ke hamare liye ek baadshah muqarrar kar dein taake hum Allah ki raah mein ladein. Is Nabi ne farmaya: Kya aisa to nahin hoga ke agar tum par jihaad farz kiya jaaye to tum jihaad na karo? Unhone kaha: Hamein kya hua ke hum Allah ki raah mein na ladein haalanke hamein hamare watan aur hamari aulaad se nikaal diya gaya hai? Phir jab un par jihaad farz kiya gaya to un mein se thode logon ke siwa sab ne munh pher liya, aur Allah zaalim logon ko khoob jaanta hai.

blocks.text: Us zamaane mein Bani Israeel mein koi Nabi maujood na the. Khandaan-e-nubuwwat mein sirf ek aurat baaqi thi jo haamila thi. Un ke yahan beta paida hua, jiska naam Shamweel rakha gaya. Jab woh bade hue to unhein Taurait ka ilm haasil karne ke liye Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein ek buzurg aalim ke supurd kiya gaya. Woh aalim un se bahut shafqat karte aur unhein apna beta kehte. blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Taaboot Hazrat Aadam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام par naazil farmaya tha. Is mein tamaam Ambiya-e-Kiraam عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام aur un ke makaanon ki tasveerein thin. Aakhir mein Huzoor سیدالانبیاء صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ aur Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke muqaddas ghar ki tasveer ek surkh yaqoot mein thi. Is mein Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ namaaz ki haalat mein qiyaam farma rahe the aur Aap ke gird Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم maujood the.

Aap is mein Taurait aur apna khaas saamaan rakhte the. Is Taaboot mein Taurait ki takhtiyon ke tukde, Hazrat Moosa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka asa, kapde aur naalein shareefain, Hazrat Haaroon عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka amaamah aur asa, aur thoda sa mann tha jo Bani Israeel par naazil hota tha. blocks.text: Aap ke baad yeh Taaboot Bani Israeel mein chalta raha. Jab unhein koi mushkil pesh aati to woh ise saamne rakh kar dua karte aur kaamyaab hote. Jab Bani Israeel ki haalat kharaab hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne un par Amaaliqah (ek puraani taaqatwar qaum) ko musallat kiya to unhone Taaboot cheen liya. Use gandi jagahon par rakha aur be-hurmati ki. Is ki wajah se un par tarah tarah ki beemariyan aur museebatein aayin, un ki paanch bastiyan halaak ho gayin aur unhein yaqeen ho gaya ke Taaboot ki be-adabi hi barbaadi ka sabab hai. 1. Buzurgon ke tabarrukaat ki izzat aur ehteraam zaroori hai. Un ki barkat se duaein qabool hoti hain aur haajatein poori hoti hain.
2. Tabarrukaat ki ta'zeem pichhle Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام se chali aa rahi hai. Surah Yusuf mein Hazrat Yusuf عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke kurte ki barkat se Hazrat Ya'qoob عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki aankhon ki roshni theek hone ka waqia hai.

4. Jab tabarrukaat ki be-adabi gumraahi aur tabaahi hai to jin buzurg hastiyon ke tabarrukaat hon un ki be-adabi kitni sangin aur khatarnaak hogi.

blocks.text: Arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوْتُ بِالْجُنُوْدِۙ-قَالَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مُبْتَلِیْكُمْ بِنَهَرٍۚ-فَمَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَیْسَ مِنِّیْۚ-وَ مَنْ لَّمْ یَطْعَمْهُ فَاِنَّهٗ مِنِّیْۤ اِلَّا مَنِ اغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِیَدِهٖۚ-فَشَرِبُوْا مِنْهُ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًا مِّنْهُمْؕ-فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهٗ هُوَ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهٗۙ-قَالُوْا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا الْیَوْمَ بِجَالُوْتَ وَ جُنُوْدِهٖؕ-قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ یَظُنُّوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ مُّلٰقُوا اللّٰهِۙ- كَمْ مِّنْ فِئَةٍ قَلِیْلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِیْرَةًۢ بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِؕ-وَ اللّٰهُ مَعَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ(249)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Phir jab Taaloot lashkaron ko le kar shehar se juda hua to us ne kaha: Beshak Allah tumhein ek nahar ke zariye aazmaane wala hai, to jo is nahar se paani piye ga woh mera nahin aur jo na piye woh mera hai, siwaaye us ke jo apne haath se ek chullu bhar le. To un mein se thode logon ke siwa sab ne is nahar se paani piya. Phir jab Taaloot aur us ke saath wale Musalman nahar se paar ho gaye to unhone kaha: Hum mein aaj Jaaloot aur us ke lashkaron se muqaable ki taaqat nahin. Jo Allah se milne ka yaqeen rakhte the unhone kaha: Kitni hi chhoti jamaatein Allah ke hukm se badi jamaaton par ghaalib aayi hain, aur Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.

blocks.text: Nahar se pet bhar kar paani peena mana tha. Jo zyaada paani peeta woh Taaloot ki jamaat mein na rehta. Shadeed pyaas ke waqt hukm ki paabandi karne wala aage ki sakhtiyon mein bhi saabit-qadam rehta hai, jabke apni khwahish se na-farmaani karne wala aage ki mushkilaat bardaasht nahin kar sakta. Sirf ek chullu bhar chand ghoont peene ki ijaazat thi. Jab nahar aayi to aksariyat imtihaan mein naakaam ho gayi. Sirf teen sau terah afraad saabit-qadam rahe aur ek chullu par guzara kiya. Jin logon ne ji bhar kar paani piya un ke hont siyah ho gaye aur pyaas aur badh gayi. Jaaloot ka lashkar dekh kar woh kehne lage ke aaj hum is se nahin lad sakte. Allah se mulaaqaat aur Allah ki raza ke talabgaar bandon ne kaha: Aisa kitni baar hua hai ke chhota giroh Allah ke hukm se apne se bade giroh par ghaalib aa gaya. Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai. (خازن، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۲۴۹، ۱ / ۱۸۹-۱۹۰)

blocks.text:
1. Saabit-qadmi bahut kam logon ko naseeb hoti hai, kyunke yeh bahut azeem khoobi hai.
2. Jihaad se pehle aazmaish kar lena behtar hai. Aman ki haalat mein fauj ki tarbiyat aur mehnat isi maqsad ke liye hoti hai.
3. Kisi bade imtihaan se pehle chhote imtihaan se guzarna chahiye. Is se dil mein quwwat paida hoti hai. Garmiyon mein roze rakhna mushkil ho to halke garm mausam mein roze rakhte rehna chahiye taake mashq ho jaaye. Badi baaton par sabr mushkil ho to chhoti chhoti baaton par sabr ka aadi banna chahiye. Sakhawat karne ko dil na chahe to rozana thoda thoda maal sadaqah karte rehna chahiye. Yeh Quran ka ek usool hai jise ilm-e-nafsiyaat mein bhi istemaal kiya jaata hai.
4. Momin ko asbaab tayyaar karne chahiye, lekin bharosa sirf apne Rab Ta'ala par hona chahiye.

Agar ghaas na kaati jaaye to khet barbaad ho jaata hai, agar operation se kharaab maadda na nikaala jaaye to badan bigad jaata hai aur agar chor-daaku na pakde jaayein to aman barbaad ho jaata hai. Isi tarah agar jihaad ke zariye maghroor, baaghi aur sarkash logon ko na roka jaaye to nek log sukoon se nahin reh sakte. Kainaat mein Allah Ta'ala ki takveeni hikmatein jaari hain, unhein poori tarah samajhna har shakhs ke bas mein nahin.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Yeh Rasool hain, hum ne in mein ek ko doosre par fazeelat ata farmaayi. In mein kisi se Allah ne kalaam farmaaya aur kisi ko sab par darjon ki bulandi ata farmaayi. Aur hum ne Maryam ke bete Eesa ko khuli nishaniyan dein aur Paakiza Rooh se us ki madad ki. Aur agar Allah chahta to un ke baad wale aapas mein na ladte, jabke un ke paas khuli nishaniyan aa chuki thin, lekin unhone ikhtilaaf kiya. To un mein koi momin raha aur koi kaafir ho gaya. Aur agar Allah chahta to woh na ladte, magar Allah jo chahta hai karta hai.

Nabuwwat mein sab Ambiya barabar hain, aur Quran mein jahan hai ke hum un mein farq nahin karte, wahan asal-e-nubuwwat mein farq na hone ki baat hai. blocks.text: Arabic: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ-اَلْحَیُّ الْقَیُّوْمُ ﳛ لَا تَاْخُذُهٗ سِنَةٌ وَّ لَا نَوْمٌؕ-لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِؕ-مَنْ ذَا الَّذِیْ یَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖؕ-یَعْلَمُ مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْۚ-وَ لَا یُحِیْطُوْنَ بِشَیْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ-وَسِعَ كُرْسِیُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَۚ-وَ لَا یَـٴُـوْدُهٗ حِفْظُهُمَاۚ-وَ هُوَ الْعَلِیُّ الْعَظِیْمُ(255)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Allah woh hai jis ke siwa koi ma'bood nahin, woh khud zinda hai, doosron ko qaayam rakhne wala hai. Use na oongh aati hai na neend. Jo aasmanon aur zameen mein hai sab usi ka hai. Kaun us ke haan us ki ijaazat ke baghair sifaarish kare? Woh sab jaanta hai aur log us ke ilm mein se utna hi paa sakte hain jitna woh chahe. Us ki Kursi aasman aur zameen ko apni wus'at mein liye hue hai. Un ki hifaazat use thaka nahin sakti aur woh buland shaan, azmat wala hai.

Use neend aur oongh nahin aati, kyunke woh aibon se paak hai. Aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez us ki milkiyat hai, is liye kisi ko us ka shareek samajhna baatil hai. But sifaarish nahin kar sakte; sirf Allah ki ijaazat se Ambiya, farishte, Awliya aur momineen shafaa'at kar sakte hain. Allah har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai. Kisi ko us ke ilm mein se utna hi milta hai jitna woh chahe; us ke ata karne se Ambiya ko ghaib aur logon ko kaainaat ke asraar ka ilm milta hai. (خازن، البقرۃ، تحت الآیۃ: ۲۵۵،۱ / ۱۹۶)

runs.text: Aayat-ul-Kursi ke Fazaa'il

blocks.text: Is aayat ko Aayat-ul-Kursi kehte hain. (1) Yeh Quran-e-Majeed ki sab se azeem aayat hai. (مسلم، کتاب صلاۃ المسافرین وقصرہا، باب فضل سورۃ الکہف وآیۃ الکرسی، ص۴۰۵، الحدیث: ۲۵۸(۸۱۰)) (2) Jo sote waqt ise padhe, Allah Ta'ala subah tak us ki hifaazat farmaata hai aur Shaitaan qareeb nahin aa sakta. (بخاری، کتاب فضائل القرآن، باب فضل سورۃ البقرۃ، ۳ / ۴۰۵، الحدیث: ۵۰۱۰) (3, 4) Namaaz ke baad padhne par Jannat ki bashaarat aur raat ko padhne par apne aur padosiyon ke gharon ki hifaazat ki bashaarat hai. (شعب الایمان، التاسع عشر من شعب الایمان، فصل فی فضائل السور والآیات، ۲ / ۴۵۸، الحدیث: ۲۳۹۵)

runs.text: لَاۤ اِكْرَاهَ فِی الدِّیْنِ Se Maaloom Hone Wale Ahkaam

blocks.text: (1) Kisi kaafir ko zabardasti Musalman banaana jaa'iz nahin, lekin Musalman ko zabardasti Musalman rakhna zaroori hai. Kisi Musalman ko murtad hone ki ijaazat nahin di ja sakti; ya woh Islam laaye ya use qatl kiya jaayega. Bani Israeel ke murtadon se farmaya gaya tha: فَاقْتُلُوْۤا اَنْفُسَكُمْ (بقرہ: ۵۴) Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Apne aap ko qatl ke liye pesh kar do.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aye Habeeb! Kya tum ne us ko na dekha jis ne Ibrahim se us ke Rab ke baare mein is bina par jhagra kiya ke Allah ne use baadshaahi di hai? Jab Ibrahim ne farmaya: Mera Rab woh hai jo zindagi deta hai aur maut deta hai. Us ne kaha: Main bhi zindagi deta hoon aur maut deta hoon. Ibrahim ne farmaya: To Allah sooraj ko mashriq se laata hai, tu use maghrib se le aa. To us kaafir ke hosh ud gaye aur Allah zaalim logon ko hidaayat nahin deta.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: Noor walon ke peswa Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام aur taareeki walon ka peswa Namrood tha. Allah Ta'ala ne Namrood ko badi saltanat di, lekin us ne takabbur aur sarkashi ki, yahan tak ke Rab hone ka da'wa karne laga. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne Tauheed ki da'wat de kar farmaya: Mera Rab woh hai jo zindagi aur maut deta hai. Namrood ne ek aadmi ko qatl aur doosre ko riha karke apni ahmaqana baat kahi. Aap ne farmaya: Tu sooraj ko mashriq ke bajaye maghrib se nikaal de. Namrood hakka-bakka reh gaya. Is aayat se aqa'id mein munaazara ka saboot milta hai aur yeh Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki sunnat hai. Haan, takabbur aur haq qabool na karna bura hai. Imam Muhammad Ghazali رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne ’’احیاء ُالعلوم‘‘ mein farmaya: ’’Jo munaazara ghaalib aane, doosron ko laajawaab karne, apni fazeelat dikhaane, fakhr-o-takabbur aur doosron ko zaleel karne ke liye ho, woh Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek buri aadaton ka sarchashma aur Shaitaan ke nazdeek qaabil-e-ta'reef hai.‘‘ (احیاء علوم الدین، کتاب العلم، بیان آفات المناظرۃ۔۔۔ الخ، ۱ / ۶۹) Har shakhs munaazara na kare. Is ke liye ilm, mazboot yaaddaasht, maharat, tarbiyat aur haazir-jawaabi zaroori hai. Aam logon ka munaazara karna shar'an najaa'iz aur khatarnaak hai. Bahs ulama ke hawaale karein. Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne farmaya: ’’Jo tamaam funoon ka maahir aur tamaam hathiyaar rakhne wala ho, use bhi kya zaroorat hai ke bila wajah bheriyon ke jungle mein jaaye? Haan, zaroorat pad jaaye to Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ par tawakkul karke in hathiyaaron se kaam le.‘‘ (ملفوظات اعلیٰ حضرت،ص۴۳۴)

blocks.text: Arabic: اَوْ كَالَّذِیْ مَرَّ عَلٰى قَرْیَةٍ وَّ هِیَ خَاوِیَةٌ عَلٰى عُرُوْشِهَاۚ-قَالَ اَنّٰى یُحْیٖ هٰذِهِ اللّٰهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاۚ-فَاَمَاتَهُ اللّٰهُ مِائَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهٗؕ-قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَؕ-قَالَ لَبِثْتُ یَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ یَوْمٍؕ-قَالَ بَلْ لَّبِثْتَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ فَانْظُرْ اِلٰى طَعَامِكَ وَ شَرَابِكَ لَمْ یَتَسَنَّهْۚ-وَ انْظُرْ اِلٰى حِمَارِكَ وَ لِنَجْعَلَكَ اٰیَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَ انْظُرْ اِلَى الْعِظَامِ كَیْفَ نُنْشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوْهَا لَحْمًاؕ-فَلَمَّا تَبَیَّنَ لَهٗۙ-قَالَ اَعْلَمُ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ(259)
