blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Mard auraton par nigran hain, is wajah se ke Allah ne un mein ek ko doosre par fazeelat di aur is wajah se ke mard auraton par apna maal kharch karte hain. To nek auratein shoharon ki ita'at karne wali aur un ki ghair-haazri mein Allah ki hifazat aur taufeeq se hifazat karne wali hoti hain. Aur jin auraton ki naafarmaani ka tumhein andesha ho to unhein samjhao aur na samjhein to un se apne bistar alag kar lo aur phir na samjhein to unhein maaro. Phir agar woh tumhari ita'at kar lein to ab un par ziyadti ka raasta na dhoondo. Beshak Allah bahut buland, bahut bada hai.

blocks.text: Kis aurat se nikaah karna chahiye?

runs.text: Kis aurat se nikaah karna chahiye?

blocks.text: Nikaah ke liye aurat ka intikhaab karte waqt us ki deendari dekhi jaye aur deendar aurat ko tarjeeh di jaye. Jo log aurat mein sirf husn, maal-daari ya izzat-o-mansab dekhte hain, woh is hadees par ghaur karein. Hazrat Anas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Sarwar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Jo kisi aurat se us ki izzat ki wajah se nikaah kare, Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ us ki zillat badha dega. Jo us ke maal ki wajah se nikaah kare, Allah Ta'ala us ki mohtaaji hi badha dega. Aur jo us ke khandani martabe ki wajah se nikaah kare, Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ us ke kamine-pan mein izafa kar dega.” (Mu'jam-ul-Awsat, man ismuhu Ibrahim, 2/18, hadees: 2342)

runs.text: Aurat aur mard dono ko chahiye ke ek doosre ke huqooq ka lihaaz rakhein. Is silsile mein paanch ahadees hain:

blocks.text: 1. Hazrat Amr bin Ahwas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Huzoor-e-Anwar صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Main tumhein auraton ke haq mein bhalai ki wasiyyat karta hoon. Woh tumhare paas qaid hain. Tum un ki kisi cheez ke maalik nahin, siwaye is ke ke woh khuli badkaari karein. Agar woh aisa karein to unhein bistar mein alag chhor do aur agar na maanein to halki maar maaro. Phir agar woh tumhari baat maan lein to un ke khilaaf koi raasta na dhoondo. Tumhare auraton par aur auraton ke tum par kuchh huqooq hain. Tumhara haq yeh hai ke woh tumhare bistar par tumhare na-pasand logon ko na aane dein aur jinhein tum na-pasand karte ho unhein tumhare ghar mein daakhil na karein. Un ka haq tum par yeh hai ke tum un se bhalai karo, unhein achha libaas aur achhi ghiza do.” (Tirmizi, Kitab-ur-Riza', Baab ma jaa'a fi haqq-il-mar'ati ala zawjiha, 2/387, hadees: 1166)

Yeh dono agar sulah karana chahein to Allah un ke darmiyan ittefaaq paida kar dega. Beshak Allah khoob jaanne wala, khabardaar hai.

blocks.text: Is ka faida yeh hai ke rishtedaar ek doosre ke gharelu halaat se waaqif hote hain, dono fareeqon ko un par itminaan hota hai aur un se apne dil ki baat kehne mein jhijhak bhi nahin hoti. Yeh munsif munasib tareeqe se un ka masla hal kar lenge. Agar munsif miyan-biwi mein sulah karane ka iraada rakhein to Allah Ta'ala un dono mein ittefaaq paida farma dega. Is liye mumkin had tak sulah ke zariye is maamle ko hal karna chahiye.

blocks.text: Is se un logon ko ibrat pakarni chahiye jo neki ke kaamon mein laakhon rupay kharch karte hain, lekin maqsad sirf wah-wah karwana hota hai. Woh bahut zyada khairaat karte hain, lekin saath hi yeh shart rakhte hain ke akhbaar mein khabar aur tasveer zaroor aani chahiye. Isi tarah shaadiyon ki fazool rasmon mein laakhon rupay ura dene wale bhi ibrat haasil karein. Woh sirf is liye rasmein karte hain ke agar yeh rasmein achhe tareeqe se na ki gayin to log kya kahenge, falan ne itna kharch kiya tha, main kyun peeche rahun, waghera.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ: Beshak Allah ek zarrah barabar zulm nahin farmata.} Allah Ta'ala is se paak hai ke woh kisi par ek zarrah jitna bhi zulm farmaye. blocks.text: Hazrat Anas bin Malik رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshaad farmaya: “Allah Ta'ala zulm se paak hai. Momin neki karta hai to duniya mein rizq aur Aakhirat mein Jannat ki soorat mein sawaab paata hai. Aur kaafir koi neki karta hai to us ke badle duniya mein hi use rizq de diya jata hai aur Qiyamat ke din us ke paas koi neki na hogi jis par use koi jaza mile.” (Muslim, Kitaab Sifat-il-Qiyamat wal-Jannat wan-Naar, Baab Jaza-ul-Mu'min bi-hasanatihi fid-dunya wal-Aakhirah ... al-kh, safha 1508, hadees: 56 (2808))

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {فَكَیْفَ اِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍۭ بِشَهِیْدٍ: To kaisa haal hoga jab Hum har Ummat mein se ek gawah laayeinge.} Is aayat mein kafiron, munaafiqon, Yahoodiyon aur Nasraaniyon ke liye shadeed wa'eed hai ke Qiyamat ke din tamam Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام apni Ummat ke har nek aur bad shakhs ke imaan, kufr, nifaaq aur tamam achhe-bure aamaal ki gawaahi denge. Phir in sab par Huzoor Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko gawah aur nigehbaan banaya jayega. To us waqt un ka anjaam kya hoga! Qiyamat ke din di jaane wali is gawaahi ki tafseel Surah Baqarah ki aayat number 143 ke tehat guzar chuki hai.

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ke azaab se har ek ko darna chahiye

runs.text: Allah Ta'ala ke azaab se har ek ko darna chahiye

blocks.text: Yeh aayat kafiron ke baare mein naazil hui, lekin baharhaal duniya mein har aadmi ko Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke azaab se darna chahiye. Isi wajah se Qiyamat ki holnaaki aur azaab-e-Jahannam ki shiddat ke pesh-e-nazar hamare akaabir aslaaf aur buzurgan-e-deen bhi tamanna karte the ke kaash woh paida hi na hue hote.

blocks.text: Ameer-ul-Mu'mineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne ek baar parinde ko dekh kar irshaad farmaya: “Ae parinde! Kaash main tumhari tarah hota aur mujhe insaan na banaya jata.” Ameer-ul-Mu'mineen Hazrat Umar Farooq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka farmaan hai: “Meri tamanna hai ke main ek mendha hota jise mere ghar wale apne mehmaanon ke liye zibah kar dete.” Hazrat Abu Zar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka qaul hai: “Kaash main ek darakht hota jo kaat diya jata.” Ameer-ul-Mu'mineen Hazrat Usman-e-Ghani رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmaya karte: “Main is baat ko pasand karta hoon ke mujhe wafaat ke baad na uthaya jaye.” Hazrat Talhah aur Hazrat Zubair رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا farmaya karte: “Kaash hum paida hi na hue hote.” Umm-ul-Mu'mineen Hazrat Aishah Siddiqah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا farmaya kartin: “Kaash main koi bhooli-bisri cheez hoti.” Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmaya karte: “Kaash main raakh hota.” (Qoot-ul-Quloob, al-Fasl-us-Saani was-Salaasoon, Sharh Maqaam-il-Khauf wa Wasf-il-Khaa'ifeen ... al-kh, 1/459-460, mulakhkhasan)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae imaan waalo! Nashe ki haalat mein namaaz ke paas na jao jab tak samajhne na lago woh baat jo tum kaho aur na napaaki ki haalat mein (namaaz ke qareeb jao) hatta ke tum ghusl kar lo, siwaye is ke ke tum haalat-e-safar mein ho (to tayammum kar lo) aur agar tum beemaar ho ya safar mein ho ya tum mein se koi qaza-e-haajat se aaya ho ya tum ne auraton se humbistari ki ho aur paani na pao to paak mitti se tayammum karo to apne munh aur haathon ka masah kar liya karo. Beshak Allah maaf karne wala, bakhshne wala hai.

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:

Ae imaan waalo! Nashe ki haalat mein namaaz ke paas na jao jab tak samajhne na lago woh baat jo tum kaho aur na napaaki ki haalat mein (namaaz ke qareeb jao) hatta ke tum ghusl kar lo, siwaye is ke ke tum haalat-e-safar mein ho (to tayammum kar lo) aur agar tum beemaar ho ya safar mein ho ya tum mein se koi qaza-e-haajat se aaya ho ya tum ne auraton se humbistari ki ho aur paani na pao to paak mitti se tayammum karo to apne munh aur haathon ka masah kar liya karo. Beshak Allah maaf karne wala, bakhshne wala hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا: Ae imaan waalo!} Shaan-e-nuzool: Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne kuch Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ki daawat ki. Khane ke baad sharaab pesh ki gayi. Us waqt tak sharaab haraam nahin hui thi, is liye kuch hazraat ne sharaab pee li. Phir Maghrib ki namaaz padhi gayi. Imaam ne nashe ki haalat mein Surah Kafiroon ki tilaawat ki aur kalima “لَا” chhor diya. Is se ma'ni ghalat ho gaye. Is par yeh aayat naazil hui aur nashe ki haalat mein namaaz padhne se mana farma diya gaya. (Khazin, An-Nisa, zer-e-aayat 43, 1/382)

blocks.text: Is waaqe'ah se maloom hua ke agar nashe ki haalat mein koi shakhs kufriya kalima bol de to woh kaafir nahin hota. “قُلْ یٰۤاَیُّهَا الْكٰفِرُوْنَ” mein dono jagah “لَا” ka tark kufr hai, kyunke is se ma'ni yeh banega: “Ae kaafiro! Jin buton ki tum ibaadat karte ho, main bhi un ki ibaadat karta hoon.” Yeh yaqeenan kufriya kalima hai. Lekin yahan nashe ki haalat thi, is liye Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne us par kufr ka hukm na diya, balki Quran-e-Paak mein unhein “یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا” keh kar khitaab farmaya gaya. blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِاَعْدَآىٕكُمْ: Aur Allah tumhare dushmanon ko khoob jaanta hai.} Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ tumhare dushmanon ko khoob jaanta hai aur Us ne tumhein bhi un ki dushmani se khabardaar kar diya hai. Is liye jise Allah Ta'ala dushman farma de, woh yaqeenan hamara dushman hai, jaise Shaitan, kafir aur munaafiq.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Yahoodiyon mein kuch woh hain jo kalimaat ko un ki jagah se badal dete hain aur kehte hain: Hum ne suna aur maana nahin, aur aap sunein, aap ko na sunaya jaye, aur “Raa'ina” kehte hain zabaanen maror kar aur deen mein ta'na dene ke liye. Aur agar woh kehte ke hum ne suna aur maana aur Huzoor hamari baat sunein aur hum par nazar farmaein to yeh un ke liye behtar aur zyada durust hota, lekin un par to Allah ne un ke kufr ki wajah se la'nat kar di, to woh bahut thoda yaqeen rakhte hain.

blocks.text: Un ka tareeqa yeh tha ke zahir mein achhe ma'ni ka asar dete, lekin dil mein wahi bure ma'ni muraad lete. Jaise kehte: “Suniye aur Aap ko na sunaya jaye.” “Aap ko na sunaya jaye” ka zahiri ma'ni yeh tha ke koi na-gawaar baat Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke sunne mein na aaye, lekin un ki muraad yeh thi ke Aap ko sunna naseeb na ho.

blocks.text: Isi ki doosri misaal “رَاعِنَا” ka kalima hai. blocks.text: Hazrat Abdullah bin Salaam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ bahut bade Yahoodi aalim the. Woh Shaam se wapas aate hue raaste mein the ke unhone yeh aayat suni. Woh apne ghar pahunchne se pehle hi Islam le aaye aur Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat mein haazir hue. Arz ki: “Ya Rasoolallah! Mujhe khayaal nahin tha ke main apna munh peeth ki taraf phir jaane aur chehre ka naqsha mit jaane se pehle Aap ki khidmat mein haazir ho sakunga.” Unhone is khauf ki wajah se imaan laane mein jaldi ki, kyunke Tauraat Shareef se unhein Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke Rasool-e-Barhaq hone ka yaqeen tha. (Khazin, An-Nisa, zer-e-aayat 47, 1/390-391)

blocks.text: Maghfirat ki ummeed par gunah karna bahut khatarnaak hai

runs.text: Maghfirat ki ummeed par gunah karna bahut khatarnaak hai

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke kufr ke siwa Qiyamat ke din har gunah ke bakhshe jaane ka imkaan zaroor hai. Lekin is imkaan ki ummeed par gunahon mein padna bahut khatarnaak hai. Baaz sooraton mein gunah ko halka samajhne ki wajah se khud kufr ho jayega. Woh Allah Ta'ala kitna Kareem hai jo lakhon gunah karne wale bande ko maafi ki ummeed dila raha hai, aur woh banda kitna past hai jo aise Kareem ke karam aur rahmat par dil-o-jaan se qurbaan hokar us ki bandagi mein lagne ke bajaye us ki naafarmani par kamar baandhe hue hai.

blocks.text: Is aayat-e-Kareema mein khud-pasandi ki mazammat bayan hui hai. blocks.text: Taaghoot ka ma'ni

runs.text: Taaghoot ka ma'ni

blocks.text: Is aayat mein “Taaghoot” ka lafz aaya hai. Yeh “طَغٰی” se bana hai, jis ka ma'ni “sarkashi” hai. Jo Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ se sarkash ho aur doosron ko sarkash banaye, woh Taaghoot hai, chahe Shaitaan ho ya insaan. Quran-e-Kareem ne kufr ke sardaron ko bhi Taaghoot kaha hai. Taaghoot ke lafz mein sarkashi ka maadda maujood hai, is liye Allah Ta'ala ki baargaah ke maqarrabeen ke liye yeh lafz hargiz istemaal nahin ho sakta. Jo un ke liye yeh lafz istemaal kare, woh khud “Taaghoot” hai.

blocks.text: Yeh dono hukm Islami taleemaat ke shahkaar hain aur aman-o-amaan qayam karne aur huqooq ada karne mein markazi haisiyat rakhte hain. Dono ki kuch tafseel yeh hai:

runs.text: Yeh dono hukm Islami taleemaat ke shahkaar hain aur aman-o-amaan qayam karne aur huqooq ada karne mein markazi haisiyat rakhte hain. Dono ki kuch tafseel yeh hai:

blocks.text: (1) Amaanat ada karna: Amaanat ada karne mein bunyadi baat yeh hai ke maali maamlaat mein haqdaar ko us ka haq de diya jaye. Is ke saath aur bhi bohat si cheezen amaanat ada karne mein daakhil hain. Jaise Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما se riwayat hai, Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “Jo Musalmanon ka haakim bana, phir us ne un par kisi aise shakhs ko haakim muqarrar kiya jis ke baare mein woh khud jaanta hai ke is se behtar aur is se zyada Kitaab-o-Sunnat ka aalim Musalmanon mein maujood hai, to us ne Allah Ta'ala, us ke Rasool aur tamam Musalmanon se khayanat ki.” (Mu'jam-ul-Kabeer, Amr bin Dinar an Ibn Abbas, 11/94, hadees: 11216)

Ulama ne farmaya ke haakim ko paanch baaton mein dono fareeqon ke saath barabar sulook karna chahiye: (1) apne paas aane ka ek ko jaisa mauqa de, doosre ko bhi de; (2) dono ko ek jaisi nashist de; (3) dono ki taraf barabar tawajjuh rakhe; (4) dono ki baat sunne mein ek hi tareeqa rakhe; (5) faisla dete waqt haq ka lihaz kare aur jis ka doosre par haq ho, woh poora poora dilaye.

Kya aap ke paas koi daleel hai?” Aap ne farmaya: “Haan, Qanbar aur Hasan dono is baat ke gawah hain.”

blocks.text: Qaazi Sahib رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne kaha: “Hasan aap ke bete hain aur shar'i usool yeh hai ke bete ki gawahi baap ke haq mein jaiz nahin.” Jab Yahoodi ne Qaazi Sahib ka adilana faisla suna to hairat-zada ho kar kehne laga: “Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Aap mujhe Qaazi Sahib ke paas laaye aur Qaazi Sahib ne aap hi ke khilaaf faisla kar diya! Main gawahi deta hoon ke yahi mazhab-e-haq hai aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur beshak Muhammad صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ Allah Ta'ala ke Rasool hain. Yeh zarah aap hi ki hai.”

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae imaan walo! Allah ki ita'at karo aur Rasool ki ita'at karo aur un ki jo tum mein se hukoomat wale hain. Phir agar kisi baat mein tumhara ikhtilaf ho jaye to agar Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhte ho to us baat ko Allah aur Rasool ki baargaah mein pesh karo. Yeh behtar hai aur is ka anjaam sab se achha hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Huzoor Anwar ﷺ ne irshaad farmaya: “Meri aur us cheez ki jis ke saath Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe bheja hai misaal us shakhs ki si hai jo apni qaum ke paas aa kar kehne laga: Ae meri qaum! Main ne apni aankhon se ek lashkar dekha hai. Main wazeh tor par tumhein us se dara raha hoon, apni nijaat ki raah talaash kar lo. Ab ek giroh ne us ki baat maan kar mohlat se faida uthaya aur raaton-raat wahan se chala gaya, to woh nijaat paa gaya. Aur ek giroh ne us ki baat na maani aur wahin ruka raha, to subah ke waqt lashkar ne un par hamla karke unhein halaak kar diya. To jis ne meri ita'at ki aur jo main laya us par amal kiya, woh us giroh ki tarah hai jo nijaat paa gaya. Aur jis ne meri na-farmaani ki aur jo main laya use jhutlaya, woh us giroh ki tarah hai jo na maan kar halaakat mein pad gaya.” (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Fazaa'il, Baab: Shafqatuhu ﷺ ala ummatihi, s. 1253, hadees: 16 (2283))

blocks.text: Is aayat se sabit hua ke Musalman hukmranon ki ita'at ka bhi hukm hai, jab tak woh haq ke mutabiq rahen. Agar woh haq ke khilaaf hukm dein to un ki ita'at nahin ki jayegi. Is aayat se yeh bhi maloom hua ke ahkaam teen qisam ke hain: ek woh jo Quran se zahir tor par sabit hon, doosre woh jo zahir hadees se sabit hon, aur teesre woh jo Quran o Hadees ki taraf qiyaas ke zariye rujoo karne se maloom hon. Aayat mein “اُولِی الْاَمْرِ” ki ita'at ka hukm hai. Is mein imaam, ameer, baadshah, haakim, qaazi aur ulama sab daakhil hain.

Shaan-e-Nuzool: Bishr naam ke ek munaafiq ka ek Yahoodi se jhagra ho gaya. Yahoodi ne kaha: Chalo Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ se faisla karwa lete hain. Munaafiq ne socha ke Rasoolullah ﷺ kisi ki riayat nahin farmayenge aur mera matlab poora nahin hoga. Is liye Musalman hone ka da'wa karne ke bawajood us ne kaha ke Ka'b bin Ashraf Yahoodi ko panch bana lo. Aayat mein Taaghoot ki taraf faisla le jaane se isi Ka'b bin Ashraf ke paas faisla le jaana muraad hai.

blocks.text: Yahoodi jaanta tha ke Ka'b bin Ashraf rishwat leta hai. Is liye Yahoodi hone ke bawajood us ne use panch tasleem na kiya. Aakhir munaafiq ko faisle ke liye Huzoor ﷺ ki baargaah mein aana pada. Rasool-e-Saadiq o Ameen ﷺ ne jo faisla diya woh Yahoodi ke haq mein aur munaafiq ke khilaaf tha. Faisla sunne ke baad munaafiq us Yahoodi ko majboor karke Hazrat Umar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke paas le aaya. Yahoodi ne arz ki: Mera aur is ka maamla Aap ke Rasool ﷺ tay farma chuke hain, lekin yeh Huzoor ﷺ ke faisle se raazi nahin aur Aap se faisla chahta hai.

blocks.text: (1) Hazrat Abu Lubabah bin Abdul-Munzir رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se Ghazwa-e-Banu Quraizah ke mauqe par ek khata ho gayi. blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {فَلَا وَ رَبِّكَ: To ae Habeeb! Tumhare Rabb ki qasam.} Is aayat ka shan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Madinah ke log pahaar se aane wale paani se apne baaghon ki aabpaashi karte the. Ek Ansari ka Hazrat Zubair رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se jhagra ho gaya ke pehle apne khet ko paani kaun dega. Maamla Huzoor ﷺ ki baargaah mein pesh hua. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Ae Zubair! Tum apne baagh ko paani de kar apne padosi ki taraf paani chhor do. Hazrat Zubair رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka khet pehle aata tha, is liye pehle paani ki ijaazat di gayi. Saath hi Huzoor ﷺ ne Ansari ke saath bhi ehsan karne ka hukm diya. Lekin Ansari ko yeh faisla na-gawaar guzra aur us ki zaban se nikla: Zubair aap ﷺ ke phuphi-zaad bhai hain.

blocks.text: (1) Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rabb hone ki nisbat apne Habeeb ﷺ ki taraf farma kar irshad kiya: Ae Habeeb! Tere Rabb ki qasam. Yeh Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ki azeem shaan hai ke Allah Ta'ala apni pehchan apne Habeeb ﷺ ke zariye karwata hai.

blocks.text: (2) Huzoor Pur-Noor ﷺ ka hukm maanna farz qarar diya gaya aur is baat ko Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rabb hone ki qasam ke saath mazboot farmaya.

blocks.text: (3) Huzoor Akram ﷺ ka hukm maanne se inkar karne wale ko kafir qarar diya gaya.

blocks.text: (5) Allah Ta'ala bhi Haakim hai aur Huzoor ﷺ bhi, lekin dono mein la-muntahi farq hai. Is se maloom hua ke Allah Ta'ala ke liye istemal hone wali kai sifaat Huzoor ﷺ ke liye bhi boli ja sakti hain, jab tak shirk ki haqeeqat na paayi jaye.

blocks.text: (6) Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ ka hukm dil o jaan se maanna zaroori hai aur dil mein bhi us ke baare mein koi rukaawat nahin honi chahiye. Isi liye aayat ke aakhir mein farmaya gaya ke apne dilon mein Huzoor ﷺ ke hukm ke muta'alliq koi tangi na paayen aur poori tarah tasleem kar lein.

blocks.text: Kai namazi namaz mein khushu aur khuzu ke saath khare hote hain. Un ka maqsad logon ko dikhana nahin hota, lekin un ka dil namaz se ghafil hota hai. Dekhne wala samajhta hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke saamne khara hai, jabke baatin mein woh kisi khwahish ke saamne bazaar mein khara hota hai. Is tarah aamaal zaban-e-haal se baatin ki khabar dete hain aur us mein woh jhoota hota hai. Isi tarah koi shakhs sukoon aur waqar se chal raha ho, lekin us ka baatin sukoon aur waqar se khaali ho, to woh apne amal mein sachcha nahin. Khulasa yeh hai ke agar zaahir ka baatin ke khilaf hona irade se ho to yeh riya hai aur ikhlas khatam kar deta hai. Agar irade ke baghair ho to sidq chala jata hai. Is kharabi se nijaat yeh hai ke zaahir aur baatin ek jaisa ho, balki baatin zaahir se behtar ho.

blocks.text: Hazrat Anas bin Nadr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka jazba-e-shahadat

runs.text: Hazrat Anas bin Nadr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ka jazba-e-shahadat

blocks.text: Hazrat Anas bin Malik رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: "Mere chacha Hazrat Anas bin Nadr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ Ghazwa-e-Badr mein na ja sake. Unhone Nabi-e-Akram ﷺ se arz ki: 'Aap ﷺ ne mushrikeen se jo pehli jang ki thi, main us mein hazir na ho saka. Agar ab Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe kisi ghazwe mein shirkat ka mauqa diya to Allah Ta'ala dekh lega ke main kya karta hoon.' Phir jab Ghazwa-e-Uhad ka mauqa aaya aur kuch log bhaagne lage to Hazrat Anas bin Nadr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne arz ki: 'Ae mere Parwardigar عَزَّوَجَلَّ! In bhaagne walon mein jo Musalman hain, main un ki taraf se maazrat khwah hoon aur jo mushrik hain, main un se bari hoon.' Phir aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ talwar lekar maidan-e-jang ki taraf deewana-war badhe. Raaste mein Hazrat Sa'd bin Mu'az رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se mulaqat hui to farmaya: 'Ae Sa'd رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ! Jannat. Us Paak Parwardigar عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki qasam jis ke qabze-e-qudrat mein meri jaan hai! Main Uhad pahad ke qareeb Jannat ki khushboo mehsoos kar raha hoon.' Hazrat Sa'd رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: 'Jaisa kaarnama unhone anjaam diya, hum aisa nahin kar sakte.' Hazrat Anas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: 'Humne unhein shaheedon mein is haal mein paya ke un ke mubarak jism par teeron, talwaron aur neezon ke assi se zyada zakhm the. Un ke aza jagah jagah se kaat diye gaye the aur unhein pehchanna mushkil ho gaya tha. Un ki behen ne unhein ungliyon ke nishanon se pehchana.' (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-Jihad was-Siyar, Baab Qaulillah Ta'ala: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا۔۔۔ الخ، 2/255, hadees: 2805; Uyoon-ul-Hikayaat, al-Hikayatul-Aashirah, s. 27, multaqatan.)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Kya tumne un logon ko nahin dekha jinhein kaha gaya: Apne haath roke rakho, namaz qayam rakho aur zakat do. Phir jab un par jihad farz kiya gaya to un mein ek giroh logon se aisa darne laga jaise Allah se darna hota hai ya us se bhi zyada aur kehne lage: Ae hamare Rab! Tune hum par jihad kyun farz kar diya? Thori si muddat tak hamein aur mohlat kyun na di? Ae Habeeb! Tum farma do ke duniya ka saamaan thora sa hai aur parhezgaron ke liye Aakhirat behtar hai aur tum par dhaage ke barabar bhi zulm na kiya jayega.

blocks.text: Quran-e-Majeed mein ghaur-o-fikr karna aala darje ki ibaadat hai. Imam Ghazali رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ Ihya-ul-Uloom mein farmate hain ke ek aayat ko samajh kar aur ghaur-o-fikr karke padhna, baghair ghaur-o-fikr ke poora Quran padhne se behtar hai. (Ihya-ul-Uloom, Kitaab-ut-Tafakkur, Bayan Majari-il-Fikr, 5/170)

(Ihya-ul-Uloom, Kitaab-ut-Tafakkur, Bayan Majari-il-Fikr, 5/170)

blocks.text: Quran ka zikr karna, use padhna, dekhna aur chhoona sab ibaadat hai. Quran mein ghaur-o-fikr ki da'wat di gayi hai, lekin yeh baat wazeh hai ke Quran mein wohi ghaur-o-fikr mo'tabar aur sahih hai jo Sahib-e-Quran صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke farameen, Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki sohbat paane wale Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم aur un se tarbiyat paane wale Taabi'een رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِمْ ke uloom ki roshni mein ho. Kyunke woh ghaur-o-fikr jo us Zaat ke farameen ke khilaaf ho jin par Quran naazil hua aur us ghaur-o-fikr ke khilaaf ho jo wahi ke nuzool ka mushahida karne wale buzurgon ke ghaur-o-fikr ke khilaaf ho, hargiz mo'tabar nahin ho sakta. Is liye daur-e-jadeed ke un naye muhaqqiqon se bachna zaroori hai jo chaudah sau saal ke ulama, fuqaha, muhaddiseen, mufassireen aur poori Ummat ki samajh ko ghalat qarar de kar qawlan ya amalan yeh kehte nazar aate hain: “Quran agar samjha hai to hum ne hi samjha hai, pichhli saari Ummat jaahil hi guzri hai.” Yeh log yaqeenan gumraah hain.

blocks.text: {وَ لَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ غَیْرِ اللّٰهِ: Aur agar yeh Quran Allah ke ilawa kisi aur ki taraf se hota.} Yahan Quran-e-Paak ki haqqaniyat par ek nihayat aasaan aur wazeh daleel di ja rahi hai ke agar Quran-e-Paak Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke ilawa kisi aur ki taraf se hota to is mein bahut zyada ikhtilaaf hota. Is mein ghaib ki jo khabrein di gayi hain woh bilkul poori na hotin, balki koi baat poori hoti aur koi poori na hoti. Lekin jab aisa nahin hua, balki Quran-e-Paak ki tamaam ghaibi khabrein bilkul sach sabit ho rahi hain, to sabit hua ke yaqeenan yeh Kitaab Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki taraf se hai. Is ke mazameen mein bhi baahmi ikhtilaaf nahin ke kahin koi baat keh di aur kahin us ke khilaaf koi doosri baat keh di. Isi tarah fasaahat-o-balaaghat mein bhi is mein koi ikhtilaaf nahin, kyunke makhlooq ka kalaam fasiih ho bhi to sab ek jaisa nahin hota. Kuch kalaam balaaghat se bharpoor hota hai aur kuch kamzor aur ghatiya, jaisa ke shua'ra aur zabaan-daanon ke kalaam mein dekha jaata hai. Bade se bade shaair ka koi kalaam bahut shandaar hota hai aur koi bilkul kamzor. Lekin Quran kyunke Allah Ta'ala ka kalaam hai aur Allah Ta'ala hi ke kalaam ki shaan hai ke us ka tamaam kalaam fasaahat-o-balaaghat ke aala martabe par hota hai.

Halaanke agar yeh log is baat ko Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ aur apne ba-ikhtiyaar logon, jaise akaabir Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم jo sahib-e-raaye aur sahib-e-baseerat hain, ki khidmat mein pesh karte aur khud kuch mudakhlat na karte, to samajhdaar log apni aqal-o-daanish ya apni tehqeeq ki roshni mein us khabar ki haqeeqat jaan lete. Is tarah baat ka batangad banne ki bajaye haqeeqat-e-haal saamne aa jaati.

blocks.text: Zindagi ki islaah ka ek aham usool

runs.text: Zindagi ki islaah ka ek aham usool

blocks.text: Is aayat ko saamne rakh kar hum apne gharon ke maamlaat, balki mulki, bain-ul-aqwami aur sahafati maamlaat ko bhi jaanch sakte hain. Hamare yahan haal yeh hai ke koi shakhs ek baat uchhaalta hai aur phir woh maujooda media ke zariye poori duniya mein ghoomne lagti hai. Kuch arse baad pata chalta hai ke us baat ka koi sar-pair hi nahin aur woh bilkul jhooti hai. Musalmanon aur Islam ko badnaam karne ke liye aisi saazishein, afwaahen aur khabrein din-raat phailayi ja rahi hain. Yahan tak ke baaz jagahon par yeh baat phailayi gayi ke Musalmanon ka mazhab yeh hai ke koi Musalman us waqt tak Jannat mein nahin jayega jab tak woh kisi ek kaafir ko qatl na kar le. اَلْاَمَانُ وَالْحَفِیْظُ، kaisa jhoot aur kaisi dheetai hai. Kaafiron ke mulkon mein Musalmanon ka jo ta'assur phailaya ja raha hai woh bhi isi tarah ki jhooti afwaahon ke zariye hai. Phir aisi baatein sun kar Maghrib se muta'assir kuch padhe-likhe samjhe jaane wale hamare log in baaton ko Islam ke naam par pesh karke Islam ko badnaam karte hain.

blocks.text: Yahi maamla gharon mein hai. Kisi ne kuch baat kahi, woh phailte-phailte das martaba izafon ke saath aisi ban gayi ke khandanon mein ladaaiyan chhid gayin aur tabaahiyan mach gayin. Aisi saikron baaton ka hum sab ko tajurba hoga. In sab ke liye Quran ne yeh usool diya hai ke jab aisi koi baat pahunche to use ahl-e-daanish aur samajhdaar logon tak pahuncha diya jaye. Woh ghaur-o-fikr aur tehqeeq se us ki haqeeqat-e-haal maloom kar lenge. Is tarah baat ka batangad aur raai ka pahaad nahin banega. Hazrat Hafs bin Aasim رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Rasool-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshaad farmaya: “Kisi shakhs ke jhoota hone ke liye yahi baat kaafi hai ke woh har suni-sunai baat bayan kar de.” (Muslim, Baab-un-Nahyi an-il-Hadees bi-kulli ma sami', safha 8, hadees: 5 (5))

blocks.text: Is aayat ke taht Imam Fakhr-ud-Deen Razi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman is baat par daleel hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne har waade aur wa'eed mein jhoot se paak hai. Hamare Ahl-e-Sunnat-o-Jama'at ke ulama is daleel se Allah Ta'ala ke jhoot ko na-mumkin jaante hain, kyunke jhoot sifat-e-naqs hai aur naqs Allah Ta'ala par muhaal hai. Mu'tazilah is daleel se Allah Ta'ala ke jhoot ko na-mumkin maante hain, kyunke jhoot apni zaat mein qabeeh hai aur Allah Ta'ala se iska zaahir hona muhaal hai. Gharz yeh saabit hua ke Allah Ta'ala ka jhoot bolna bilkul mumkin nahin. (Tafseer-e-Kabeer, Al-Baqarah, taht-al-aayat: 80, 1/567, khulasa)

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Aur sach aur insaaf ke aitbaar se tere Rab ke kalimaat mukammal hain. Us ke kalimaat ko koi badalne wala nahin aur wahi sunne wala, jaanne wala hai.

blocks.text: Imam Fakhr-ud-Deen Razi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ is aayat ke taht farmate hain: Yeh aayat is baat par daleel hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki baat bahut si sifaat ke saath mausoof hai. Un mein se ek sifat us ka sachcha hona hai. Is par daleel yeh hai ke jhoot aib hai aur aib Allah Ta'ala par muhaal hai. Mazeed farmate hain ke Quran-o-Hadees ke dalail ka sahih hona is baat par mauqoof hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke kizb ko muhaal maana jaaye. (Tafseer-e-Kabeer, Al-An'am, taht-al-aayat: 115, 5/125)

blocks.text: Jhoot fi-nafsihi do baaton se khaali nahin: ya to woh naqs hoga ya naqs nahin hoga. Yeh zaahir hai ke jhoot zaroor naqs hai. Jab woh naqs hai to ba-ijma' Allah Ta'ala ke liye muhaal ho gaya, kyunke Allah Ta'ala har naqs aur aib se paak hai. Doosri surat mein agar jhoot ko naqs aur aib na bhi maana jaaye, tab bhi Allah Ta'ala ke liye muhaal hai, kyunke agar jhoot naqs nahin to kamaal bhi nahin. Allah Ta'ala sirf naqs aur aib se paak nahin, balki har us cheez se bhi paak hai jo kamaal se khaali ho, chahe woh naqs aur aib mein shamil na ho. Allah Ta'ala ki har sifat sifat-e-kamaal hai aur jis mein koi kamaal hi na ho woh Allah Ta'ala ki sifat kaise ho sakti hai.

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke logon ke jhoot bolne par qaadir hone aur Allah Ta'ala ke liye jhoot na-mumkin hone se yeh hargiz laazim nahin aata ke logon ki qudrat, ma'azAllah, Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se badh gayi. Yeh kehna ke banda jhoot bol sakta hai aur Allah Ta'ala jhoot nahin bol sakta, is se yeh laazim nahin aata ke insaan ki qudrat, ma'azAllah, Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se zyada ho gayi. Agar yeh baat sahih hoti ke aadmi jo kuch kar sakta hai Allah Ta'ala bhi kar sakta hai, to yeh bhi laazim aata ke jis tarah insaan nikah kar sakta aur biwi se hum-bistari kar sakta hai, Allah Ta'ala bhi, ma'azAllah, yeh kar sakta ho. Isi tarah jis tarah aadmi khaana kha sakta, paani pee sakta, apne aap ko darya mein dubo sakta, aag se jala sakta aur khaak aur kaanton par let sakta hai, Allah Ta'ala bhi apne liye yeh sab kar sakta ho. In sooraton mein insaan har tarah Khudaai se haath dho baithega, kyunke agar Allah Ta'ala yeh sab apne liye kar sakta ho to woh naaqis aur mohtaaj hua, aur naaqis aur mohtaaj Khuda nahin ho sakta. Aur agar na kar sake to aajiz thehrega aur kamaal-e-qudrat mein aadmi se kam ho jaayega, jabke aajiz Khuda nahin ho sakta.

Jab un ka yeh haal hai to tum un mein se kisi ko us waqt tak apna dost na banao jab tak woh Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein hijrat na karein.

blocks.text: Hijrat se un ke imaan ka saboot mil jaayega ke un ka imaan Allah Ta'ala aur us ke Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki raza ke liye hai, kisi dunyawi maqsad ke liye nahin. Phir agar woh hijrat karne se munh pherein aur kufr par qaayam rehna pasand karein to Ae Musalmano! Tum unhein pakro aur jahan pao qatl karo. Aur agar woh tumhari dosti ka da'wa karein aur dushmanon ke khilaaf tumhari madad ke liye tayyar hon to un ki madad qabool na karo, kyunke woh bhi dushman hain. (Rooh-ul-Bayaan, An-Nisa, taht-al-aayat: 89, 2/256; Khazin, An-Nisa, taht-al-aayat: 89, 1/411, mulaqqatan)

blocks.text: Arabic: وَ مَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ اَنْ یَّقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا اِلَّا خَطَــٴًـاۚ-وَ مَنْ قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا خَطَــٴًـا فَتَحْرِیْرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ وَّ دِیَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ اِلٰۤى اَهْلِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ یَّصَّدَّقُوْاؕ-فَاِنْ كَانَ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَدُوٍّ لَّكُمْ وَ هُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَتَحْرِیْرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍؕ-وَ اِنْ كَانَ مِنْ قَوْمٍۭ بَیْنَكُمْ وَ بَیْنَهُمْ مِّیْثَاقٌ فَدِیَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ اِلٰۤى اَهْلِهٖ وَ تَحْرِیْرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍۚ-فَمَنْ لَّمْ یَجِدْ فَصِیَامُ شَهْرَیْنِ مُتَتَابِعَیْنِ٘-تَوْبَةً مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ-وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلِیْمًا حَكِیْمًا(92)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur kisi Musalman ke liye jaaiz nahin ke kisi Musalman ko qatl kare magar yeh ke ghalati se ho jaaye. Aur jo kisi Musalman ko ghalati se qatl kar de to ek Musalman ghulaam ko azaad karna aur diyat dena laazim hai jo maqtool ke ghar walon ke hawaale ki jaayegi, siwaye is ke ke woh maaf kar dein. Phir agar maqtool tumhari dushman qaum se ho aur woh khud Musalman ho to sirf ek Musalman ghulaam ko azaad karna laazim hai. Aur agar maqtool us qaum mein se ho ke tumhare aur un ke darmiyan mu'ahadah ho to us ke ghar walon ke hawaale diyat di jaaye aur ek Musalman ghulaam ya laundhi ko azaad kiya jaaye. Phir jise ghulaam na mile to do mahine ke lagataar roze laazim hain. Yeh Allah ki baargaah mein us ki taubah hai aur Allah jaanne wala, hikmat wala hai.

blocks.text: Woh dono Haris bin Zaid ko saath le kar Ayyash ki talaash mein nikle aur Madinah Tayyibah pahunch kar unhein paa liya. Unhone Ayyash ko un ki maa ke beqaraar hone aur khaana-peena chhor dene ki khabar di aur Allah Ta'ala ke naam par ahad kiya ke hum tum se deen ke baare mein kuch nahin kahenge, bas tum Makkah Mukarramah chalo. Is tarah woh Ayyash ko Madinah se nikaal laaye. Madinah se baahar aa kar unhein baandha aur har ek ne sau sau koore maare. Phir unhein maa ke paas laaye to maa ne kaha: “Main tumhari rassiyan nahin kholungi jab tak tum apna deen na chhor do.” Ayyash ko dhoop mein bandha hua daal diya gaya. In museebaton se majboor ho kar Ayyash ne un ki baat maan li aur apna deen chhor diya.

blocks.text: Is par Haris bin Zaid ne Ayyash ko malaamat ki aur kaha: “Tum Islam par the. Agar yeh haq tha to tum ne haq chhor diya aur agar baatil tha to tum baatil deen par rahe.” Yeh baat Ayyash ko bahut naagawaar guzri aur unhone kaha: “Jab main tumhein akela paaunga to Khuda ki qasam, zaroor tumhein qatl kar dunga.” Is ke baad Ayyash Islam laaye aur Madinah Tayyibah hijrat kar gaye. Un ke baad Haris bhi Islam laaye aur hijrat kar ke Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat mein pahunche, lekin us din Ayyash maujood na the aur unhein Haris ke Islam laane ki khabar na hui. Quba Shareef ke qareeb Ayyash ne Haris ko dekh kar qatl kar diya. Logon ne kaha: “Ae Ayyash! Tum ne bahut bura kiya, Haris Islam la chuke the.” Ayyash ko bahut afsos hua. Woh Rahmat-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat-e-aqdas mein haazir hue aur arz ki ke mujhe qatl ke waqt tak un ke Islam ki khabar hi na hui. Is par yeh aayat-e-karimah naazil hui aur kaffare ki surat bayan ki gayi. (Baghawi, An-Nisa, taht-al-aayat: 92, 1/368)

blocks.text: Doosri surat yeh hai ke koi Musalman kisi doosre Musalman ko ghalati se qatl kar de, jaise shikaar ko maar raha ho lekin goli Musalman ko lag jaaye, ya kisi ko jang karne wala kaafir samajh kar maar diya ho lekin qatl ke baad maloom ho ke maqtool Musalman tha. Is surat mein qaatil par ek ghulaam ya laundhi ko azaad karna laazim hai aur is ke saath diyat bhi ada karega jo maqtool ke waarison ko di jaayegi. Woh isay meeras ki tarah taqseem karenge. blocks.text: Chauthi surat yeh hai ke agar maqtool zimmi ho ya Muslim hukoomat ki ijaazat se Muslim mulk mein aaya ho, jise musta'man kehte hain, to usay qatl karne ki surat mein us ke ghar walon ko diyat di jaayegi aur ek Musalman ghulaam ya laundhi ko azaad kiya jaayega. Agar ghulaam ya laundhi na mile, jaise hamare zamane mein ghulaam aur laundiyan hain hi nahin, to do mahine ke lagataar roze rakhe jaayenge. Hazrat Anas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshaad farmaya: “Bade gunaah-e-kabeera mein se ek kisi jaan ko na-haq qatl karna hai.” (Bukhari, Kitaab-ud-Diyaat, Baab Qaulullahi Ta'ala: Wa man ahyaaha, 4/358, hadees: 6871)

blocks.text: Agar Musalmano ke qatl ko halaal samajh kar iska irtikaab kiya to yeh khud kufr hai aur aisa shakhs hamesha Jahannam mein rahega. Aur agar qatl ko haraam hi samjha lekin phir bhi iska irtikaab kiya to yeh gunaah-e-kabeera hai aur aisa shakhs arsa-e-daraaz tak Jahannam mein rahega. Aayat mein خَالِدًا ka lafz hai. Is ka ek ma'na hamesha hota hai aur doosra ma'na arsa-e-daraaz hota hai. Yahan doosre ma'na mein zikr hua hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae iman walo! Jab tum Allah ke raaste mein chalo to khoob tahqeeq kar liya karo aur jo tumhein salaam kare use yeh na kaho ke tu Musalman nahin. Tum dunyawi zindagi ka saamaan chahte ho, pas Allah ke paas bahut se ghanimat ke maal hain. Pehle tum bhi aise hi the to Allah ne tum par ehsaan kiya, to khoob tahqeeq kar liya karo. Beshak Allah tumhare tamam aamaal se khabardar hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {اِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ فَتَبَیَّنُوْا: Jab tum Allah ke raaste mein chalo to khoob tahqeeq kar liya karo.} Is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Fadak ke rehne wale Mirdas bin Nahik ki qaum mein un ke siwa koi Islam nahin laya tha. Jab un logon ko khabar mili ke Islam ka lashkar un ki taraf aa raha hai to sab log bhaag gaye, lekin Mirdas wahin thehre rahe. Jab unhone door se lashkar ko dekha to yeh soch kar ke kahin koi ghair-Muslim jamaat na ho, apni bakriyan lekar pahaad ki choti par chadh gaye. Lashkar aaya aur unhone Allahu Akbar ke naare sune to khud bhi takbeer padhte hue neeche aaye aur kehne lage: لَا اِلٰـہَ اِلَّا اللہُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُوْلُ اللہِ، السّلام علیکم۔ Musalmano ne socha ke Fadak ke sab log kaafir hain aur yeh shakhs dhoka dene ke liye iman ka izhaar kar raha hai. Is khayal se Hazrat Usamah bin Zaid رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne unhein qatl kar diya aur bakriyan le aaye.

Lashkar aaya aur unhone Allahu Akbar ke naare sune to khud bhi takbeer padhte hue neeche aaye aur kehne lage: لَا اِلٰـہَ اِلَّا اللہُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُوْلُ اللہِ، السّلام علیکم۔ Musalmano ne socha ke Fadak ke sab log kaafir hain aur yeh shakhs dhoka dene ke liye iman ka izhaar kar raha hai. Is khayal se Hazrat Usamah bin Zaid رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne unhein qatl kar diya aur bakriyan le aaye.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Uzr walon ke ilawa jo Musalman jihaad se baithe rahe woh aur Allah ki raah mein apne maal aur jaan ke saath jihaad karne wale barabar nahin. Apni jaan aur maal ke saath jihaad karne walon ko baithe rehne walon par Allah ne darjon ke aitbaar se fazeelat di hai. Allah ne sab se bhalaai ka waada farmaya hai aur jihaad karne walon ko baithe rehne walon par bahut bade ajr ki fazeelat di hai.

blocks.text: Bukhari Shareef ki riwayat mein hai ke jab aayat ka pehla hissa naazil hua ke mujahideen aur ghair-mujahideen barabar nahin, to Hazrat Abdullah bin Umm-e-Maktum رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ, jo na-beena Sahabi the, arz karne lage: “Ya RasoolAllah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Allah ki taraf se bahut se darje, bakhshish aur rehmat hai aur Allah bakhshne wala, meherban hai.

Allah ki taraf se bahut se darje, bakhshish aur rehmat hai aur Allah bakhshne wala, meherban hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {دَرَجٰتٍ مِّنْهُ: Allah ki taraf se bahut se darje.} Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne mujahideen ka ajr bayan farmaya ke un ke liye Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se Jannat ke bahut se darje, un ke gunahon ki bakhshish aur Jannat ki ne'matein hain. Allah Ta'ala jihaad karne walon ko bakhshne wala aur un par meherban hai. (Tafseer-e-Samarqandi, An-Nisa, taht-al-aayat: 96, 1/380)

Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Jo shakhs Allah ki raah mein jihaad kare aur ghar se us ka nikalna sirf Allah ki raah mein jihaad aur us ke deen ki tasdeeq ke liye ho, to Allah Ta'ala is baat ka zaamin ho jaata hai ke agar woh shaheed ho gaya to use Jannat mein daakhil karega, ya ajr aur ghanimat ke saath us ke ghar wapas bhej dega, jahan se woh rawana hua tha.” (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Imaarah, Baab fadl-ul-jihaad wal-khurooj fi sabeelillah, safha 1042, hadees: 104 (1876))

اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ تَوَفّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰٓىٕكَةُ ظَالِمِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ قَالُوْا فِیْمَ كُنْتُمْؕ-قَالُوْا كُنَّا مُسْتَضْعَفِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِؕ-قَالُوْۤا اَلَمْ تَكُنْ اَرْضُ اللّٰهِ وَاسِعَةً فَتُهَاجِرُوْا فِیْهَاؕ-فَاُولٰٓىٕكَ مَاْوٰىهُمْ جَهَنَّمُؕ-وَ سَآءَتْ مَصِیْرًاۙ    (97)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Beshak jin logon ki jaan farishte is haal mein qabz karte hain ke woh apni jaan par zulm karne wale hote hain, un se farishte kehte hain: Tum kis haal mein the? Woh kehte hain: Hum zameen mein kamzor the. To farishte kehte hain: Kya Allah ki zameen kushadah na thi ke tum us mein hijrat kar jaate? To yeh woh log hain jin ka thikana Jahannam hai aur woh kitni buri lautne ki jagah hai.

blocks.text: Is aayat se saabit hua ke jo shakhs kisi shehar mein apne deen par qaayam na reh sakta ho aur use maloom ho ke doosri jagah ja kar apne deeni faraiz ada kar sakega, us par hijrat waajib ho jaati hai. Is hukm ko saamne rakh kar kaafiron ke darmiyan rehne wale bahut se Musalmano ko ghaur karne ki zaroorat hai. Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ taufeeq ata farmaye. Hadees mein hai ke jo shakhs apne deen ki hifaazat ke liye ek jagah se doosri jagah muntaqil hua, agarche ek baalisht hi kyun na ho, us ke liye Jannat waajib hui aur use Hazrat Ibrahim aur Muhammad Mustafa صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki rafaqat naseeb hogi. (Tafseer-e-Samarqandi, Al-Ankaboot, taht-al-aayat: 56, 2/542)

blocks.text: A'la Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne hijrat ki qismein bayan farmayi hain. Un mein se ek qism Dar-ul-Islam se hijrat hai. Hijrat-e-khaassa ki teen suratein hain:

runs.text: A'la Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne hijrat ki qismein bayan farmayi hain. Un mein se ek qism Dar-ul-Islam se hijrat hai. Is ke baare mein farmate hain: Dar-ul-Islam se hijrat-e-aamma haraam hai, kyun ke is se masaajid ki veerani aur be-hurmati, Musalmano ki qabron ki barbaadi, aur aurton, bachon aur kamzor logon ki tabaahi hogi. Hijrat-e-khaassa ki teen suratein hain:

blocks.text: 1. Agar koi shakhs kisi khaas wajah se kisi khaas jagah apne deeni faraiz ada na kar sakta ho aur doosri jagah unhein ada karna mumkin ho, to agar majboori isi ghar mein ho to us par farz hai ke yeh ghar chhor kar doosre ghar chala jaye. Agar mohalle mein majboor ho to doosre mohalle mein chala jaye aur agar shehar mein majboor ho to doosre shehar mein chala jaye.

blocks.text: 2. Agar yahan apne deeni faraiz ada karne se aajiz na ho, lekin us ke boodhe maa-baap, biwi ya bachay jin ka nafaqah us par farz hai, na ja sakte hon ya na jaayen, aur us ke chale jaane se woh be-sahaara ho jaayen, to us ke liye Dar-ul-Islam se hijrat karna haraam hai. Hadees mein hai: “Kisi aadmi ke gunahgaar hone ke liye itna kaafi hai ke woh use zaya kar de jis ka nafaqah us ke zimme tha.” Isi tarah woh aalim bhi wahan se hijrat nahin kar sakta jis se badh kar us shehar mein koi aalim na ho.

Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “Jis shakhs ne neki ka iraada kiya aur neki na ki to us ke liye ek neki likh di jaati hai. Aur jis ne neki ka iraada kiya aur use kar liya to us ke liye das se saat sau guna tak nekiyan likhi jaati hain. Aur jis ne gunah ka iraada kiya, phir us par amal na kiya to us ka gunah nahin likha jaata. Aur agar woh gunah kar le to ek gunah likha jaata hai.” (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Iman, Baab iza ham-mal-abdu bi-hasanatin kutibat..., safha 79, hadees: 206 (130))

blocks.text: Sadr-ul-Afazil Maulana Naeem-ud-Deen Muradabadi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ke farman ka khulasa hai ke ilm haasil karne, jihad, Hajj, Madinah ki ziyaarat, neki ke kaam, zuhd-o-qana'at aur halal rizq ki talaash ke liye watan chhorna Allah aur Rasool ki taraf hijrat hai. Is raah mein inteqaal hone wala ajr paayega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا se marwi hai ke Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “Jise ilm haasil karte hue inteqaal aa gaya, woh Allah Ta'ala se is haal mein mulaaqaat karega ke us ke aur Ambiya-e-Kiraam عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke darmiyan sirf darja-e-nubuwwat ka farq hoga.” (Mu'jam-ul-Awsat, Baab-ul-Ya, man ismuhu Ya'qub, 6/475, hadees: 9454)

blocks.text: 2. Qasr ke liye kaafiron ka khauf shart nahin. Hazrat Ya'la bin Umayyah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne Hazrat Umar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se arz ki: Hum to aman mein hain, phir qasr kyun karte hain? Aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne farmaya: Mujhe bhi is par ta'ajjub hua tha, is liye maine Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ se poocha. Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “Yeh Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki taraf se tumhare liye sadqah hai, tum us ke sadqah ko qabool karo.” (Muslim, Kitaab Salaat-ul-Musaafireen wa Qasruha, Baab Salaat-ul-Musaafireen wa Qasruha, safha 347, hadees: 4 (686)) Aayat nazil hone ke waqt safar aksar khauf se khaali nahin hote the, is liye aayat mein khauf ka zikr hua. Warna khauf aur andesha qasr ke liye shart nahin. صحابۂ کرام رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم aman ke safar mein bhi qasr karte the.

blocks.text: 3. Jis safar mein qasr kiya jaata hai us ki kam se kam miqdaar teen raat-din ki musafat hai, jo oont ya paidal chalne ki darmiyani raftaar se tay hoti ho. Khushki, samandar aur pahaadon mein is ki miqdaar mukhtalif hoti hai. Aaj ke zamane mein hamare hamwaar zameeni safar ke hisaab se yeh miqdaar baanwe (92km) kilometer banti hai.

blocks.text: 4. Qasr sirf farzon mein hai, sunnaton mein nahin. Safar mein bhi sunnaten padhni chahiye. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا farmate hain: Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne hazar ki namaz aur safar ki namaz ko farz kiya. blocks.text: Arabic: وَ اِذَا كُنْتَ فِیْهِمْ فَاَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلٰوةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَآىٕفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ مَّعَكَ وَ لْیَاْخُذُوْۤا اَسْلِحَتَهُمْ- فَاِذَا سَجَدُوْا فَلْیَكُوْنُوْا مِنْ وَّرَآىٕكُمْ ۪- وَ لْتَاْتِ طَآىٕفَةٌ اُخْرٰى لَمْ یُصَلُّوْا فَلْیُصَلُّوْا مَعَكَ وَ لْیَاْخُذُوْا حِذْرَهُمْ وَ اَسْلِحَتَهُمْۚ-وَدَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْ تَغْفُلُوْنَ عَنْ اَسْلِحَتِكُمْ وَ اَمْتِعَتِكُمْ فَیَمِیْلُوْنَ عَلَیْكُمْ مَّیْلَةً وَّاحِدَةًؕ-وَ لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَیْكُمْ اِنْ كَانَ بِكُمْ اَذًى مِّنْ مَّطَرٍ اَوْ كُنْتُمْ مَّرْضٰۤى اَنْ تَضَعُوْۤا اَسْلِحَتَكُمْۚ-وَ خُذُوْا حِذْرَكُمْؕ-اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اَعَدَّ لِلْكٰفِرِیْنَ عَذَابًا مُّهِیْنًا(102)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur aye Habeeb! Jab tum un mein tashreef farma ho, phir namaz mein un ki imaamat karo to chahiye ke un mein ek jama'at tumhare saath ho aur woh apne hathiyar liye rahein. Phir jab woh sajdah kar lein to hat kar tum se peechhe ho jaayen aur ab doosri jama'at aaye jo us waqt tak namaz mein shareek na thi. blocks.text: Is hisse ke baare mein ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke Ghazwa-e-Zaat-ur-Riqa' se farigh hone ke baad, jab dushman ke bahut se aadmi giraftaar ho gaye aur maal-e-ghaneemat haasil hua, Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ qaza-e-haajat ke liye jungle mein tanha tashreef le gaye. Dushman ki jama'at ka Gauras bin Haris talwar liye chhup kar pahaad se utra aur achanak Huzoor ke paas aa kar kehne laga: Ya Muhammad صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Ab tumhein mujh se kaun bachayega? Pyare Aaqa صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Allah Ta'ala.” Saath hi Huzoor ne dua farmayi. Gauras talwar chalane ka iraada karte hue munh ke bal gir gaya aur talwar us ke haath se chhoot gayi. Huzoor ne talwar utha kar farmaya: Ab tumhein mujh se kaun bachayega? Us ne kaha: Mera bachane wala koi nahin. Huzoor ne farmaya: “اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُوْلُ اللهِ padh lo, to main tumhari talwar tumhein de dunga.” Us ne inkaar kiya aur kaha: Main gawahi deta hoon ke kabhi aap se nahin larunga aur zindagi bhar aap ke kisi dushman ki madad nahin karunga. Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne talwar use de di. Us ne kaha: Ya Muhammad صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Aap mujh se bahut behtar hain. blocks.text: 1. Is aayat se maloom hua ke namazon ke baad kalima-e-tauheed ka zikr jaaiz hai, jaisa ke mashaaikh ki aadat hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki sahih ahadees se bhi yeh zikr saabit hai. Hazrat Mughirah bin Shu'bah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain ke Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ har farz namaz ke baad yeh farmate: “لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِیْکَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْکُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْئٍ قَدِیْرٌ، اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا اَعْطَیْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِیَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا یَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْکَ الْجَدُّ۔” Yani Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh akela hai, us ka koi shareek nahin. Baadshahi usi ki hai aur sab tareefen usi ke liye hain. Woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Ya Allah! Jo Tu de use koi rokne wala nahin aur jo Tu rok de use koi dene wala nahin. Tere muqaable mein kisi daulatmand ko us ki daulat faida nahin de sakti. (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-Azaan, Baab-uz-Zikr ba'd-as-Salaat, 1/294, hadees: 844)

Hazrat Mughirah bin Shu'bah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain ke Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ har farz namaz ke baad yeh farmate: “لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِیْکَ لَهٗ، لَهُ الْمُلْکُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْئٍ قَدِیْرٌ، اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا اَعْطَیْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِیَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا یَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْکَ الْجَدُّ۔” Yani Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh akela hai, us ka koi shareek nahin. Baadshahi usi ki hai aur sab tareefen usi ke liye hain. Woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Ya Allah! Jo Tu de use koi rokne wala nahin aur jo Tu rok de use koi dene wala nahin. Tere muqaable mein kisi daulatmand ko us ki daulat faida nahin de sakti. (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-Azaan, Baab-uz-Zikr ba'd-as-Salaat, 1/294, hadees: 844)

blocks.text: Sahih Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا har namaz mein salaam pherne ke baad yeh kalimaat padhte: “لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِیکَ لَهٗ لَهُ الْمُلْکُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْئٍ قَدِیرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّۃَ اِلاَّ بِاللهِ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ اِلاَّ اِیَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَۃُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَائُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ مُخْلِصِینَ لَهُ الدِّینَ وَلَوْ کَرِهَ الْکَافِرُونَ۔” Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا ne kaha ke Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ har namaz ke baad yeh kalimaat buland aawaaz se padhte the. runs.text: Safar mein do namazen jama karne ka shar'i hukm

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke safar mein do namazen jama nahin ki ja sakti. Ahadees mein bhi safar ke dauraan do namazen jama karne ki nafi aayi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: “Maine kabhi nahin dekha ke Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne koi namaz us ke waqt ke ilawa padhi ho, siwaye do namazon ke. Un mein ek Maghrib hai jo Muzdalifah mein Isha ke waqt padhi aur wahan Fajr bhi mamool ke waqt se pehle andhere mein padhi.” (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Hajj, Baab Istihbaab Ziyaadat-ut-Taghlees bi Salaat-is-Subh..., safha 671, hadees: 292 (1289))

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke jis safar mein Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Maghrib aur Isha mila kar padhi, woh Hajjat-ul-Wida ka safar tha. Nau Zil-Hijjah ko Muzdalifah mein dono namazen jama farmayi thin. Baqi ahadees mein jama se murad jama'-e-soori hai, yani pehli namaz aakhir waqt mein aur doosri namaz awal waqt mein padhna.

blocks.text: Ta'assub ka radd

runs.text: Ta'assub ka radd

blocks.text: Isi aayat se ta'assub ka radd bhi hota hai. Islam mein is baat ki koi gunjaish nahin ke aadmi apni qaum ya khandaan ki har maamale mein himayat kare, agarche woh baatil par hon. Balki Haq ki pairwi karna zaroori hai. Is mein rang-o-nasl, qaum-o-ilaqa, mulk-o-subah, zabaan aur saqaafat ke har qisam ke ta'assub ka radd hai. Bahut si ahadees mein bhi ta'assub ki shadeed mazammat ki gayi hai. Un mein se teen ahadees yeh hain:

blocks.text: 1. Hazrat Fusaylah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہَا farmati hain: Mere walid ne Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki baargaah mein arz ki: Ya RasoolAllah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Kya apni qaum se muhabbat rakhna bhi ta'assub hai? Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshaad farmaya: “Nahin, balki apni qaum ki zulm mein madad karna ta'assub hai.” (Ibn Majah, Kitaab-ul-Fitan, Baab-ul-Asabiyyah, 4/327, hadees: 3949)

blocks.text: Is se wakeel ka pesha karne walon ko ghaur karna chahiye. Baarha aisa hota hai ke wakeel ko maloom hota hai ke us ka muakkil mujrim aur khayaanat karne wala hai, lekin woh maal batorne ke chakkar mein mazloom ko zaalim aur zaalim ko mazloom bana deta hai. Woh zaalim ki tarafdaari karta, us ki taraf se daleel pesh karta, jhoot bolta, doosre fareeq ka haq maarta aur na jaane kin kin haraam kaamon ka murtakib hota hai. runs.text: Taqwa aur paakeezgi ki bunyaad

blocks.text: Yeh aayat-e-mubarakah taqwa aur paakeezgi ki bunyaad hai. Agar insaan yeh khayal rakhe ke mera koi haal Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ se chhupa hua nahin, to woh gunaah karne ki himmat na kare. Quran-e-Paak mein jagah jagah logon ko gunaahon se rukne ka hukm isi baat ke zariye diya gaya hai ke Allah dekh raha hai. Agar koi shakhs is jumle par ghaur kare aur ise apne dil-o-dimaagh mein bitha le to gunaahon ka ilaaj bahut aasaan ho jaayega.

blocks.text: Hazrat Sahl bin Abdullah Tustari رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Main teen saal ka tha. Raat ko uth kar apne maamoon Hazrat Muhammad bin Sawwar رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ko namaz padhte dekhta tha. Ek din unhone mujh se farmaya: Kya tum us Allah Ta'ala ko yaad nahin karte jis ne tumhein paida kiya? Maine poocha: Main use kis tarah yaad karoon? Unhone farmaya: Jab letne lago to teen baar zubaan hilaaye baghair sirf dil mein yeh kalimaat kaho: “اَللہُ مَعِیَ، اللہُ نَاظِرٌ اِلَیَّ، اللہُ شَاہِدٌ” Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ mere saath hai, Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ mujhe dekh raha hai, Allah Ta'ala mera gawaah hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Sahl رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Maine chand raaten yeh kalimaat padhe aur phir unhein bataya. Unhone farmaya: Har raat saat martaba yeh kalimaat padho. Maine aisa hi kiya aur phir unhein bataya to unhone farmaya: Har raat gyarah martaba yeh kalimaat padho. Maine isi tarah padha to mujhe apne dil mein is ki lazzat mehsoos hui. Jab ek saal guzar gaya to mere maamoon ne kaha: Jo kuch maine tumhein sikhaya hai use yaad rakho aur qabr mein jaane tak hamesha padhte raho. Yeh tumhein duniya aur Aakhirat mein faida dega.

blocks.text: Gunaah-e-jaariyah ka sabab banne wale ko bhi gunaah milta hai

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke jo kisi gunaah-e-jaariyah ka sabab bane, use gunaah karne walon ke gunaah mein se bhi hissa milega. Jaise kisi ne cinema ya sharaab-khaana khola, behayai ka adda banaya, apni dukaan par filmein chalaayin jahan log baith kar dekhein, kisi ko ghalat raah par laga diya, ya kisi ko sharaab, jua ya nashay ka aadi bana diya, to gunaah ka kaam karne wale aur use is raah par lagane wale dono gunaahgaar honge. blocks.text: Is aayat se maloom hua ke be-gunaah ko tohmat lagana sakht jurm hai, chahe woh be-gunaah Musalman ho ya kaafir, kyun ke Tu'mah ne Yahoodi kaafir par bohtaan lagaya tha aur Allah Ta'ala ne is ki mazammat farmayi. Ahadees mein bhi be-gunaah par tohmat lagane ki wa'eedein bayan hui hain.

blocks.text: 2. Beshak ghair-e-Khuda ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ke ma'loomaat ko gher nahin sakta, barabar hona to door ki baat hai. Tamaam awwaleen-o-aakhireen, Ambiya-o-Mursaleen, malaaikah aur muqarrabeen sab ke uloom mil kar bhi Allah ke uloom ke muqaable mein woh nisbat nahin rakhte jo karoro samandaro se ek chhoti si boond ke karorve hissa ko hai. Dono mahdood hain, yani dono ki ek inteha hai, jabke Allah Ta'ala ke uloom be-inteha hain. Makhlooq ke uloom agar Arsh-o-Farsh, mashriq-o-maghrib aur roz-e-awwal se roz-e-aakhir tak tamaam kaainaat ko gher lein, phir bhi mahdood hain, kyun ke Arsh-o-Farsh aur roz-e-awwal-o-aakhir dono had hain. Do hadon ke darmiyan jo kuch ho woh mahdood hota hai.

Jaise cinema banaane, be-hayaai ke markaz qaaim karne aur filmi sanat ko taraqqi dene ke liye mashware karna. Yeh mashware sirf khair se khaali nahin, balki shar se bhare hue hain. Allah Ta'ala Musalmano ko hidaayat ata farmaye.

Aise log mubarakbaad ke mustahiq hain.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یَغْفِرُ اَنْ یُّشْرَكَ بِهٖ: Allah shirk ko nahin bakhshega.} Is aayat ke shaan-e-nuzool ke baare mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما ka qoul hai ke yeh aayat ek boodhe Arabi ke haq mein naazil hui. Woh baargaah-e-Risaalat mein haazir ho kar arz karne laga: یا نبیَّ اللہ! Main boodha hoon aur gunaaho mein dooba hua hoon. Main himmat ke saath gunaaho mein mubtala hota raha aur ek pal ke liye bhi yeh gumaan nahin kiya ke main Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ se bhaag sakta hoon. blocks.text: Mardood Shaitaan ka bada maqsad logon ko behkaana aur unhein aisa bana dena hai ke najaat aur maghfirat ka koi raasta baaqi na rahe. Is ke liye woh alag alag tareeqe apnaata hai. Un mein se ek yeh hai ke insaan ke dil aur dimaagh mein lambi muddat tak zinda rehne ka khayal bitha kar use maut se ghaafil rakhta hai. Insaan inhi umeedo par jeeta rehta hai aur achanak maut ka waqt aa jaata hai. Phir maut use apne dardnaak panje mein jakad leti hai. Us waqt afsos ka kya faida jab mauqa haath se nikal chuka ho? Phir apne kiye hue aamaal ka anjaam bhugatna padta hai. Aaj kal aksar log maut ko bhool kar duniya ki lambi umeedo mein gum hain.

blocks.text: Imam Ghazali رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Dil mein lambi zindagi ki umeed baandh lena ya to jahalat aur naadaani ki wajah se hota hai ya duniya ki muhabbat ki wajah se. Jahalat aur naadaani yeh hai ke aadmi apni jawaani par bharosa kar le aur budhaape se pehle marne ka khayal dil se nikaal de. Isi tarah tandurusti ki haalat mein achanak maut ko namumkin samajhna bhi naadaani hai. Aise shakhs ko ghaur karna chahiye: Kya laakho bachche jawaani ki dehleez tak pahunchne se pehle hi duniya se rukhsat nahin hue? Kya hazaaro insaan chadhati jawaani mein maut se hum-aaghosh nahin hue? Kya saikro naujawaan bhari jawaani mein luqma-e-ajal nahin bane? Kya darjano naujawaan beemariyo ka shikaar nahin hue? Saath hi yeh baat dil mein bitha le ke maut us ke ikhtiyaar mein nahin. Jab woh chahega, us waqt maut nahin aayegi. Is liye jawaani ya kisi aur cheez par bharosa karna khud naadaani hai. Lambi zindagi ki umeed ki doosri wajah duniya ki muhabbat hai. Insaan apne dil ko tasalli deta rehta hai ke abhi bahut waqt baaqi hai. Pehle yeh makaan bana loon, falan kaarobaar shuru kar loon, achhi gaari khareed loon aur zindagi ki sahulatein jama kar loon; budhaapa aayega to Allah Allah karunga. Is tarah ek kaam se das kaam nikaalta rehta hai, yahan tak ke ek din maut ka paighaam aa jaata hai aur us ke paas pachtaane ke siwa kuch nahin bachta. Aise shakhs ko duniya ki na-paayedari aur haqeeqat ko samajhna chahiye. Jab us par yeh baat khul jaaye ke duniya ki lazzat chand roz ki hai aur ek din maut ke haatho ise khatam hona hai, to woh duniya ko azeez nahin rakh sakta.” (Kimiya-e Sa'aadat, Rukn Chahaarum: Munjiyaat, Asl Dahum, Asbaab-e Tool-e-Amal, 2/995-996, mulakhkhasan)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Shaitaan unhein waade deta hai aur umeedein dilaata hai aur Shaitaan unhein sirf dhoke ke waade deta hai.

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Shaitaan unhein waade deta hai aur umeedein dilaata hai aur Shaitaan unhein sirf dhoke ke waade deta hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {یَعِدُهُمْ: Shaitaan unhein waade deta hai.} Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne Shaitaan ka tareeqa-e-kaar bayan farmaya ke woh logon ko tarah tarah ki umeedein dilaata aur waswase daalta hai taake insaan gumraahi mein pad jaaye. Woh mushrikeen ko un ka shirk achha kar ke dikhaata hai, munaafiqo ko un ki munaafiqat pasand karwaata hai aur gunaah ke kaam karne walon ko filmein banaane, gaane bajaane aur doosre kaamo ko culture, tahzeeb, aazaadi aur roshan-khayaali jaise naam de kar pasand karwaata hai. Isi tarah riyaakaari, shaadi-byaah ki ghalat rasmein aur fazool kharchi ke kaam logo se maqam, rutbe aur status ke naam par karwaata hai. Lekin haqeeqat yeh hai ke Shaitaan unhein dhoka deta hai. Woh jis cheez ke nafa aur faide ki umeed dilaata hai, asal mein us mein sakht nuqsaan hota hai.

Woh jis cheez ke nafa aur faide ki umeed dilaata hai, asal mein us mein sakht nuqsaan hota hai.

blocks.text: {اُولٰٓىٕكَ مَاْوٰىهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ: Un ka thikaana Dozakh hai.} Yaani jo log Shaitaan ko apna dost banaate aur us ki baato par amal karte hain, un ka thikaana Jahannam hai. Woh Jahannam se bachne ki koi jagah nahin paayenge. Woh zaroor Jahannam mein daakhil honge aur us mein hamesha rahenge. (Khaazin, An-Nisa, taht-al-aayat: 121, 1/432)

blocks.text: {وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا: Aur jo imaan laaye.} Kaafiro ke baare mein wa'eed bayan karne ke baad yahan imaan walon ke liye Jannat ke waade ka zikr hai. Irshaad farmaya gaya ke jo log imaan laaye aur unhone achhe kaam kiye, hum unhein jald aise baagho mein daakhil karenge jin ke neeche paani, doodh, sharaab aur shehad ki nahrein behti hain. Woh un mein hamesha rahenge. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ka sachcha waada hai aur Allah Ta'ala se zyada kisi ki baat sachchi nahin. blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ke Khaleel aur Habeeb

runs.text: Allah Ta'ala ke Khaleel aur Habeeb

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke tamam Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke tamam kamaalaat Sayyid-ul-Anbiya صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko haasil hain. Huzoor Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke Khaleel bhi hain. Sahih Muslim ki hadees mein hai ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne jis tarah Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko apna Khaleel banaya hai, isi tarah mujhe bhi apna Khaleel banaya hai." (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Masaajid wa Mawaazi'-is-Salaat, Baab-un-Nahyi an Binaa-il-Masaajid alal-Quboor, safha 270, hadees: 23 (532))

Tirmizi Shareef ki hadees mein hai ke Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Main Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ka Habeeb hoon aur yeh main fakhr ke liye nahin kehta." blocks.text: Khaleel aur Habeeb ka farq

runs.text: Khaleel aur Habeeb ka farq

blocks.text: Buzurgon ne Khaleel aur Habeeb ke farq ko yun bayan farmaya hai:

runs.text: Buzurgon ne Khaleel aur Habeeb ke farq ko yun bayan farmaya hai:

blocks.text:
1. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne Qiyamat ke din ruswaai se bachne ki dua maangi. (Ash-Shu'ara: 87) Jabke Allah Ta'ala ne khud apne Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ aur un ke sadqe un ke Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ko Qiyamat ki ruswaai se bachne ki khushkhabri sunaayi. (At-Tahreem: 8)
2. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne Rab Ta'ala se mulaaqaat ki tamanna ki. (As-Saaffaat: 99) Jabke Allah Ta'ala ne apne Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko khud bula kar mulaaqaat ka sharaf ata farmaya. (Bani Isra'il: 1)
3. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne hidaayat ki arzoo ki. (As-Saaffaat: 99) Aur Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ se Allah Ta'ala ne khud farmaya: "Aur tumhein seedhi raah dikha de." (Al-Fath: 2)
4. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke paas farishte mo'azziz mehmaan ban kar aaye. (Az-Zaariyaat: 24) Aur Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke liye Rab Ta'ala ne farmaya ke farishte un ke lashkar aur sipahi bane. (At-Taubah: 10, Aal-e-Imran: 125, At-Tahreem: 4)
5. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne apni ummat ki maghfirat ki dua maangi. (Ibrahim: 41) Aur Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko Allah Ta'ala ne khud hukm diya ke apni ummat ki maghfirat maangiye. (Muhammad: 19)
6. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne dua ki ke baad walon mein un ka achha zikr baaqi rahe. (Ash-Shu'ara: 84) Aur Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ se Rab Kareem عَزَّوَجَلَّ ne khud farmaya: "Aur hum ne tumhare liye tumhara zikr buland kar diya." (Alam Nashrah: 4)
7. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke waqi'e mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke unhone Qaum-e-Loot se azaab door karne ke liye bahut koshish ki. (Hood: 74, 76; Al-Ankaboot: 32) Aur Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ se Rabb-e-Ghaffaar عَزَّوَجَلَّ ne farmaya: "Allah in kafiron par bhi azaab na karega jab tak ae Rahmat-e-Aalam, aap in mein tashreef farma hain." (Al-Anfaal: 33)
8. Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne arz ki: "Ae Allah! Meri dua qubool farma." (Ibrahim: 40) Aur Habeeb صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ aur un ke maanne walon se Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen عَزَّوَجَلَّ ne farmaya: "Tumhara Rab farmata hai: Mujh se dua maango, main qubool karunga." (Al-Mu'min: 60) (Fataawa Razawiyyah, 30/178-182, khulaasa)

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Aur Allah hi ka hai jo kuchh aasmaano mein hai aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai aur Allah har shay ko ghere hue hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ مُّحِیْطًا: Aur Allah har shay ko ghere hue hai.} Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ har shay ko muheet hai. Is ka matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka ilm aur qudrat har shay ka ihata kiye hue hai. Kisi shay ke jitne pehlu ho sakte hain, woh sab Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke ilm mein hain aur koi shay us se baahar nahin.

{وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ مُّحِیْطًا: Aur Allah har shay ko ghere hue hai.}

Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ har shay ko muheet hai. Is ka matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka ilm aur qudrat har shay ka ihata kiye hue hai. Kisi shay ke jitne pehlu ho sakte hain, woh sab Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke ilm mein hain aur koi shay us se baahar nahin.

blocks.text: Ilmi faide ke liye A'la Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ki ek ibaarat pesh hai. Aap farmate hain: "Ilm aur qudrat-e-Ilaahi ke har shay ko muheet hone ka yeh matlab nahin ke us ka ilm aur qudrat har jagah maujood hai, kyun ke jagah ya simt mein hona jism aur jismani cheez ki sifat hai. Allah Ta'ala aur us ki sifaat in cheezon se paak hain. Ilm ke ihate ka matlab yeh hai ke har shay, chahe wajib ho ya mumkin, mumtani' ho ya ma'doom, maujood ho ya paida ki hui ya qadeem, Allah Ta'ala ke ilm mein hai. Qudrat ke ihate ka matlab yeh hai ke har mumkin shay par Allah Ta'ala ko qudrat hai." (Fataawa Razawiyyah, 14/620)

blocks.text: Arabic: وَ یَسْتَفْتُوْنَكَ فِی النِّسَآءِؕ-قُلِ اللّٰهُ یُفْتِیْكُمْ فِیْهِنَّۙ-وَ مَا یُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فِی الْكِتٰبِ فِیْ یَتٰمَى النِّسَآءِ الّٰتِیْ لَا تُؤْتُوْنَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَ تَرْغَبُوْنَ اَنْ تَنْكِحُوْهُنَّ وَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِیْنَ مِنَ الْوِلْدَانِۙ-وَ اَنْ تَقُوْمُوْا لِلْیَتٰمٰى بِالْقِسْطِؕ-وَ مَا تَفْعَلُوْا مِنْ خَیْرٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِهٖ عَلِیْمًا(127)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur aap se auraton ke baare mein fatwa maangte hain. Tum farmao ke Allah aur jo Kitaab tumhare saamne tilaawat ki jaati hai woh tumhein un auraton ke baare mein fatwa dete hain ke un ke huqooq ada karo. Aur woh tumhein un yateem ladkiyon ke baare mein fatwa deta hai jinhein tum un ka muqarrar kiya hua miraas ka hissa nahin dete aur un se nikah karne se be-raghbati karte ho. Allah ka hukm yeh hai ke yeh kaam na karo. Aur kamzor bachon ke baare mein fatwa deta hai ke un ke huqooq ada karo. Aur yateemon ke haq mein insaaf par qayam raho. Aur tum jo neki karte ho to Allah use jaanta hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ یَسْتَفْتُوْنَكَ فِی النِّسَآءِ: Aur aap se auraton ke baare mein fatwa maangte hain.} Zamana-e-Jaahiliyyat mein Arab log auraton aur chhote bachon ko mayyit ke maal ka waaris nahin maante the. Jab aayat-e-miraas naazil hui to unhone arz ki: "Ya Rasoolallah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Kya aurat aur chhote bachche bhi waaris honge?" Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne unhein isi aayat se jawab diya. Hazrat Aishah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہَا ne farmaya ke yateemon ke waliyon ka tareeqa yeh tha ke agar yateem ladki maal aur husn wali hoti to us se kam mahr par nikah kar lete, aur agar maal aur husn na hota to use chhor dete. Agar woh khoobsurat na hoti magar maal-daar hoti to us se nikah na karte aur is khauf se kisi doosre ke nikah mein bhi na dete ke shohar us ke maal mein shareek ho jaayega. Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayaat naazil farma kar unhein in buri aadaton se mana kiya. (Khaazin, An-Nisa, taht-al-aayat: 127, 1/435)

blocks.text:
1. Hazrat Abu Darda رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai ke ek shakhs ne Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki baargaah mein apne dil ki sakhti ki shikaayat ki. Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Kya tum pasand karte ho ke tumhara dil narm ho jaaye? Kisi yateem ko pao to us ke sar par haath phero aur apne khaane mein se use khilao. Tumhara dil narm ho jaayega aur tumhari zarooratein bhi poori hongi." (Musannaf Abdur Razzaaq, Kitaab-ul-Jaami', Baab As-haab-il-Amwaal, 10/135, hadees: 20198)
2. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا se riwayat hai, Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Jis ne teen yateemon ki parwarish ki, woh raat ko Qiyam karne wale, din ko roza rakhne wale aur subah-shaam Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein talwaar nikaalne wale ki tarah hai. Main aur woh Jannat mein do bhaiyon ki tarah honge, jis tarah yeh do ungliyan hain." Aur aap ne shahadat ki ungli aur darmiyani ungli mila kar dikhaayi. (Ibn Maajah, Kitaab-ul-Adab, Baab Haqq-il-Yateem, 4/194, hadees: 3680)
3. Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Rasool-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Bewaon aur miskeenon par kharch karne wala Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki raah mein jihad karne wale aur raat ko Qiyam karne wale aur din ko roza rakhne wale ki tarah hai." (Ibn Maajah, Kitaab-ut-Tijaarat, Baab-ul-Hass ala al-Makaasib, 3/6, hadees: 2140)
4. Hazrat Anas bin Maalik رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Jo mere kisi ummati ki haajat poori kare aur us ki niyyat yeh ho ke is ke zariye us ummati ko khush kare, us ne mujhe khush kiya. Jis ne mujhe khush kiya us ne Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ko khush kiya, aur jis ne Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ko khush kiya Allah Ta'ala use Jannat mein daakhil karega." (Shu'ab-ul-Imaan, As-Saalis wal-Khamsoon min Shu'ab-il-Imaan, 6/115, hadees: 7653)

blocks.text: Arabic: وَ اِنِ امْرَاَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْۢ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوْزًا اَوْ اِعْرَاضًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَیْهِمَاۤ اَنْ یُّصْلِحَا بَیْنَهُمَا صُلْحًاؕ-وَ الصُّلْحُ خَیْرٌؕ-وَ اُحْضِرَتِ الْاَنْفُسُ الشُّحَّؕ-وَ اِنْ تُحْسِنُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِیْرًا(128)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur agar kisi aurat ko apne shohar ki zyadati ya be-raghbati ka andesha ho to un par koi haraj nahin ke aapas mein sulah kar lein aur sulah behtar hai aur dil ko laalach ke qareeb kar diya gaya hai. Aur agar tum neki aur parhezgaari ikhtiyaar karo to Allah ko tumhare kaamo ki khabar hai.

Isi liye jo gunaah muashray mein bigaad ka sabab bante hain aur jo cheezein khandaani nizaam mein kharaabi paida karti hain, un ki Quran mein baar baar islaah farmaayi gayi hai. I'raaz yani munh pherna yeh hai ke biwi se muhabbat na rakhe, baat-cheet chhor de ya kam kar de.

I'raaz yani munh pherna yeh hai ke biwi se muhabbat na rakhe, baat-cheet chhor de ya kam kar de.

blocks.text: Un dono par koi haraj nahin ke samajh-boojh ke saath aapas mein sulah kar lein. Is ka aasaan tareeqa yeh hai ke aurat shohar se apne mutaalibaat kuchh kam kar de aur apne kuchh huqooq ka bojh halka kar de, aur shohar kam raghbat ke bawajood is biwi se achha bartao kare. Aisa nahin hona chahiye ke sirf aurat hi qurbaani ka bakra banayi jaaye. Mard aur aurat ka is tarah sulah kar lena zyadati aur judaai dono se behtar hai. Talaaq agarche baaz sooraton mein jaa'iz hai, lekin Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki baargaah mein nihayat na-pasand cheez hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا se riwayat hai, Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek halaal cheezon mein sab se na-pasand cheez talaaq hai." (Abu Dawood, Kitaab-ut-Talaaq, Baab Karaahiyat-it-Talaaq, 2/370, hadees: 2178)

blocks.text: Miyan-biwi ke maamle mein bhi aur is se hat kar bhi baat yeh hai ke dil laalach ke phande mein phanse hue hain. Har shakhs apni aaraam aur aasaaish chahta hai aur apne upar kuchh mushakkat bardaasht kar ke doosre ki aasaaish ko tarjeeh nahin deta. Is liye jo shakhs doosre ki rahat ko muqaddam rakhta hai aur khud takleef utha kar doosron ko sukoon deta hai, woh bahut ba-himmat hai. Aisi baaton ke baare mein Quran-e-Majeed mein farmaya:

blocks.text: Arabic: وَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِیْعُوْۤا اَنْ تَعْدِلُوْا بَیْنَ النِّسَآءِ وَ لَوْ حَرَصْتُمْ فَلَا تَمِیْلُوْا كُلَّ الْمَیْلِ فَتَذَرُوْهَا كَالْمُعَلَّقَةِؕ-وَ اِنْ تُصْلِحُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِیْمًا(129)

blocks.text: Aam taur par talaaq ke baad aurat aur us ke ghar wale bahut ghamgeen hote hain. Aise mauqe par agar yeh aayat-e-mubarakah baar baar padhi jaaye to اِنْ شَآءَ اللہ عَزَّوَجَلَّ dil ko taskeen milegi aur Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ munasib hal bhi ata farma dega. Is mein shoharon ke liye bhi hidayat hai ke woh apne aap ko biwiyon ka maalik aur mukhtaar na samjhein aur yeh na samjhein ke agar unhone unhein chhor diya to ab kainaat mein in auraton ka koi sahaara nahin rahega. Nahin, Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ unhein sahaara dega.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae iman walo! Allah ke liye gawahi dete hue insaaf par khoob qaim ho jao, chahe tumhare apne ya walidain ya rishtedaaron ke khilaf hi gawahi ho. Jis ke khilaf gawahi do, woh ameer ho ya ghareeb, baharhaal Allah un dono ke zyada qareeb hai. To nafs ki khwahish ke peeche na chalo ke insaaf na karo. Aur agar tum baat ko pher do ya munh pher lo to beshak Allah tumhare kaamon se khabar rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Rishtedaaron ko tarjeeh dena, apne logon ki tarafdaari karna, ta'alluq rakhne walon ka lihaz karna, kisi ki ameeri ki wajah se us ka saath dena, ya kisi ki ghurbat par taras kha kar doosre fareeq par zyadti karna, yeh sab insaaf ke taqaze poore karne mein rukawat hain. In sab ka zikr karne ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya ke faisla karte aur gawahi dete waqt jo sahi hukm hai us ke mutabiq chalo aur kisi ta'alluq ka lihaz na karo. Yahan tak ke agar tumhara faisla ya tumhari gawahi tumhare sage maa-baap ke khilaf bhi ho, tab bhi adl se na hato.

blocks.text: Haq faisle ki azeem tareen misaal: Is ki azeem tareen misaal is hadees ki roshni mein dekhiye. Hazrat Aishah Siddiqah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا farmati hain: "Quraish ke ek khandan ki aurat ne chori ki. Us ke khandan walon ne Hazrat Usamah bin Zaid رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se kaha ke woh Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki bargah mein us ki sifarish karein. Hazrat Usamah bin Zaid رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne sifarish ki to Tajdar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: 'Kya tum Allah Ta'ala ki hudood mein se ek hadd ke baare mein sifarish karte ho?' Phir Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ kharay hue aur khutbah irshad farmaya. Phir farmaya: 'Tum se pehle logon ko is baat ne halaak kiya ke jab un mein se koi moazziz shakhs chori karta to use chhor dete, aur jab koi kamzor chori karta to us par hadd qaim kar dete. Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki qasam! Agar Fatimah bint Muhammad رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا bhi chori kar leti to main us ka bhi haath kaat deta.'" (Bukhari, Kitaab Ahadees-ul-Anbiya, 56waan Baab, 2/468, hadees: 3475)

Aur agar yeh khitab munafiqon se ho to matlab yeh hai: ae iman ka zahiri da'wa karne walo! Ikhlas ke saath iman lao.

Phir munafiqon ki ek buri harkat bhi bayan ki gayi ke woh Musalmanon ko chhor kar kafiron ko dost banate hain. Un ka khayal tha ke Islam ghalib nahin hoga. Is se pehli aayat mein munafiqon ke liye dardnaak azaab ki dhamki bayan ki gayi thi. Phir munafiqon ki ek buri harkat bhi bayan ki gayi ke woh Musalmanon ko chhor kar kafiron ko dost banate hain. Un ka khayal tha ke Islam ghalib nahin hoga. Is liye woh kafiron ko taaqat aur shaukat wala samajh kar un se dosti karte aur un se milne mein izzat samajhte the.

blocks.text: Haalanke kafiron se dosti mana hai aur un se milne mein izzat samajhna baatil hai. Is se maloom hua ke kafiron se mohabbat aur dosti rakhna, khaas taur par Musalmanon ke muqaable mein, munafiqon ki alamat hai. Aise sab logon ke baare mein farmaya ja raha hai ke kya yeh logon ke paas ja kar izzat dhoondte hain, jabke tamam izzaton ka Maalik Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ hai. Wahi Kareem Maula izzat wala hai. Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki ata se hi Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام aur momin izzat wale bante hain, jinhein Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ izzat deta hai.

blocks.text: Munafiqon ke is rawaiye ko saamne rakh kar aaj duniya ke halaat dekhiye to maloom hoga ke yeh bimaari aaj bahut aam hai. Apnon ko chhor kar beganon se dosti, Musalmanon ko chhor kar kafiron se pyaar, aur baahmi ittehad se izzat paane ke bajaye kafiron ke qadmon mein baith kar izzat haasil karne ki koshish Musalman qaum mein kis tarah phaili hui hai. Allah Ta'ala hum sab ko aqal-e-saleem ata farmaye.

blocks.text: Quran, Shariat ya deen ka mazaaq udaaya ja raha ho aur koi shakhs phir bhi wahan baitha rahe to ya to woh khud is kaam mein mubtala ho jayega, ya buri sohbat ki nahusat se mutasir hoga, ya kam az kam yeh baat zaroor saamne aa jayegi ke us ke dil mein deen ki qadr nahin. Agar Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ, Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ, Quran-e-Majeed aur deen se mohabbat hoti to jahan in ka mazaaq udaaya ja raha ho wahan hargiz na baithta. Insani fitrat hai ke jahan kisi ke pyare ko bura kaha jaaye wahan baithna gawara nahin hota. Jahan kisi ke maa-baap ko gaali di ja rahi ho wahan aadmi baith nahin sakta. To jahan Allah Ta'ala, Rasool-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ aur Quran-o-deen ka mazaaq udaaya ja raha ho, wahan Musalman kaise baith sakta hai? Kya مَعَاذَاللہ Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ aur us ke pyare Rasool صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki qadr maa-baap ke barabar bhi nahin?

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Woh jo tumhare upar gardish-e-zamana ka intezaar karte rehte hain. Phir agar Allah ki taraf se tumhein fatah mile to kehte hain: Kya hum tumhare saath na the? Aur agar kafiron ke liye fatah ka hissa ho to un se kehte hain: Kya hum tum par ghaalib na the aur kya hum ne Musalmanon ko tum se roke na rakha? To Allah tumhare darmiyan Qiyamat ke din faisla karega aur Allah kafiron ko Musalmanon par koi raah na dega.

Aur jab namaz ke liye khade hote hain to bade sust hokar logon ke saamne riyaakaari karte hue khade hote hain aur Allah ko bahut thoda yaad karte hain.

blocks.text: Munafiqon ki nishani yeh hai ke jab mominon ke saath namaz ke liye khade hote hain to mare dil aur susti ke saath khade hote hain. Un ke dilon mein iman nahin hota, is liye unhein ibaadat ka shauq aur bandagi ka lutf haasil nahin hota. Woh sirf logon ko dikhane ke liye namaz padhte hain.
