blocks.text: Namaz mein susti karna munafiqon ki alamat hai: Is se maloom hua ke namaz mein susti karna munafiqon ki alamat hai. Namaz na padhna, ya sirf logon ke saamne padhna aur tanhaai mein na padhna, ya logon ke saamne khushu-o-khuzu ke saath aur tanhaai mein jaldi-jaldi padhna, ya namaz mein idhar-udhar ke khayalat laana aur dil jama karne ki koshish na karna, yeh sab susti ki alamat hain.

blocks.text: Namaz mein khushu-o-khuzu paida karne ka aasaan nuskha: Kisi ne Hazrat Hatim Asamm رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ se un ki namaz ke baare mein poocha to unhone farmaya: Jab namaz ka waqt qareeb aata hai to main mukammal wuzu karta hoon. Phir jis jagah namaz ada karni hoti hai wahan aa kar itni der baithta hoon ke mere azaa jama ho jaayen. Is ke baad yeh tasawwur karke namaz ke liye khada hota hoon ke Ka'bah Muazzamah mere saamne hai, Pul-Siraat mere qadmon ke neeche hai, Jannat mere daahine taraf aur Jahannam baayen taraf hai, Malak-ul-Maut عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام mere peechhe khade hain, aur mujhe yeh khayal hota hai ke yeh meri aakhri namaz hai. Phir main umeed aur khauf ke darmiyan qiyaam karta hoon, theek tarah takbeer kehta hoon, thehar-thehar kar qiraat karta hoon, aajizi ke saath ruku karta hoon, darte hue sajda karta hoon, baayen pindli par baith kar apne qadmon ka pichhla hissa bichha deta hoon aur daahina qadam anguthe par khada kar deta hoon. Phir ikhlaas ke saath baqi af'aal ada karta hoon. Ab main nahin jaanta ke meri namaz qabool bhi hui ya nahin. (Ihya Ulum-id-Deen, Kitaab Asraar-us-Salaat wa Muhimmaatuha, Al-Baab-ul-Awwal, Fazilat-ul-Khushu', 1/206)

blocks.text: (1) Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا se riwayat hai, Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshaad farmaya: "Musalman Musalman ka bhai hai. Ek shakhs Sarwar-e-Kaainaat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke saamne Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ki shaan mein bad-zabani karta raha. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ khaamosh rahe, lekin woh baaz na aaya. Ek martaba aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne use jawaab de diya to Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ khade ho gaye.

Pehle, yani mehmaan-nawaazi wale sha'n-e-nuzool ko saamne rakhein to is se un logon ko ibrat haasil karni chahiye jo mezbaan ki mehmaan-nawaazi se khush nahin hote, chahe ghar wale ne kitni hi tangi ke saath khaane ka intezaam kiya ho.

blocks.text: Khaas taur par rishtedaaron aur bil-khusoos sasuraali rishtedaaron mein mehmaan-nawaazi par shikwa-shikaayat aam hai. Ek khaana banaya to aitiraaz hota hai ke do kyun nahin banaye? Do banaye to aitiraaz hota hai ke teen kyun nahin banaye? Namkeen banaya to aitiraaz hota hai ke meetha kyun nahin banaya? Meetha banaya to aitiraaz hota hai ke falan meetha kyun nahin banaya? Gharz bahut se mehmaan zulm, zyadati aur takleef dene se baaz nahin aate. Aise rishtedaaron ko dekh kar ghar walon ki tabiyat kharaab hona shuru ho jaati hai.

blocks.text: Hadees-e-Mubarak mein mehmaan ko hukm diya gaya hai ke kisi Musalman ke liye halaal nahin ke woh apne Musalman bhai ke paas itni der thehre ke use gunaah mein mubtala kar de. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ne arz ki: "Ya Rasoolallah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Woh use gunaah mein kaise mubtala karega?" Irshaad farmaya: "Woh apne bhai ke paas thehra hoga aur haal yeh hoga ke us ke paas koi aisi cheez na hogi jis se woh us ki mehmaan-nawaazi kar sake." Hadees ke raawiyon ka fisq ya aib bayan karna, chor ya ghaasib ki shikaayat karna aur mulk ke ghaddaaron ki khabar hukoomat ko dena sab jaaiz hai. blocks.text: Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Abu Zar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: “Main Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ki baar-gah mein haazir hua. Aap ﷺ safed kapde pehne hue aaraam farma rahe the. Phir main dobara haazir hua to Aap ﷺ bedaar ho chuke the. Aap ﷺ ne irshaad farmaya: ‘Jo banda yeh kahe ke Allah Ta'ala ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur isi waade par us ka inteqaal ho jaye to woh Jannat mein dakhil hua.’ Main ne arz ki: ‘Agarche us ne zina ya chori ki ho?’ Irshaad farmaya: ‘Agarche us ne zina ya chori ki ho.’ Main ne phir arz ki: ‘Agarche woh zina ya chori kare?’ Irshaad farmaya: ‘Agarche woh zina ya chori kare.’ Main ne phir arz ki: ‘Agarche us ne zina ya chori ki ho?’ Irshaad farmaya: ‘Agarche woh zina ya chori kare, Abu Zar ki naak khaak-aalood ho.’” (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-Libaas, 4/57, hadees: 5827)

Jannat mein sirf Musalman jayenge aur Tajdaar-e-Risalat ﷺ ki shafaat bhi sirf Musalmanon ko milegi, agarche woh kabira gunaahon ke murtakib hon.

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke Ahl-e-Sunnat ka ijma hai ke momin kisi gunaah ki wajah se kafir nahin hota. Sharh-e-Aqaid-e-Nasafiyyah mein hai: “Nabi-e-Akram ﷺ ke zamane se aaj tak ummat ka is baat par ijma hai ke Ahl-e-Qibla mein se jo shakhs baghair taubah ke mar gaya, us ki namaz-e-janazah padhi jayegi aur us ke liye dua aur istighfar bhi kiya jayega, agarche us ka kabira gunaah karna maloom ho. Is liye ke pehle hi ummat ka is baat par ittefaq hai ke momin ke siwa kisi ke liye namaz-e-janazah, dua aur istighfar jaaiz nahin.” (Sharh Aqaid Nasafiyyah, Mabhas-ul-Kabeerah, safha 110)

blocks.text: Sharh Fiqh-e-Akbar mein hai: “Hum Khawarij ki tarah kisi gunaah ke sabab kisi Musalman ki takfeer nahin karenge, agarche woh kabira gunaah ho. Haan, agar woh kisi aise gunaah ko halaal jaane jis ki hurmat qat'i daleel se sabit ho to woh kafir hai. Hum Mu'tazilah ki tarah kabira gunaah karne wale se iman ka wasf bhi saaqit nahin karenge, balki use haqeeqi momin kahenge. Ahl-e-Sunnat wal-Jamaat ke nazdeek iman dil se tasdeeq aur zaban se iqraar ka naam hai, jabke amal ka ta'alluq kamal-e-iman se hai.” (Sharh Fiqh-e-Akbar, Al-Kabeerah la tukhrij-ul-mu'min anil-iman, safha 71, 74)

blocks.text: A'la Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Aadmi haqeeqatan kisi baat se mushrik us waqt tak nahin hota jab tak ghair-e-Khuda ko mabood ya mustaqil-bizzat aur wajib-ul-wujood na maane. Baaz nusoos mein baaz af'aal par tashbeeh, sakhti zahir karne, ya tawheed ke khilaaf kisi irade aur aqeede ki wajah se shirk ka lafz aaya hai. Baaz amal par kufr ka lafz aana aisa kufr nahin jo aadmi ko mutlaqan Islam se nikaal de aur baghair taubah ke maghfirat se mehroom kar de. Ahl-e-Sunnat ka ijma hai ke momin kisi kabira gunaah ki wajah se Islam se baahar nahin hota. Nusoos ko bila tafseel istilahi kufr-o-shirk par mahmool karna Khawarij ka mardood mazhab hai.” (Fatawa Razawiyyah, 21/131)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: (Ae Habeeb!) Ahl-e-Kitaab aap se sawal karte hain ke aap un par aasman se ek kitaab utaar dein. To yeh log Musa se is se bhi bada sawal kar chuke hain, jo unhone kaha tha: (Ae Musa!) Allah humein elaniya dikha do. To un ke zulm ki wajah se unhein kadak ne pakad liya. Phir un ke paas roshan nishaniyan aa jaane ke bawajood woh bachhde ko mabood bana baithe. Phir hum ne yeh maaf kar diya aur hum ne Musa ko roshan ghalba ata farmaya.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur un ke is kehne ki wajah se ke hum ne Maseeh Isa bin Maryam Allah ke Rasool ko shaheed kiya, halanke unhone na to use qatl kiya aur na use sooli di, balki un Yahoodiyon ke liye Isa se milta-julta ek aadmi bana diya gaya. Aur beshak yeh Yahoodi jo is Isa ke bare mein ikhtilaf kar rahe hain, zaroor is ki taraf se shubhe mein pade hue hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke guman ki pairwi ke siwa unhein is ki kuch bhi khabar nahin, aur beshak unhone use qatl nahin kiya.

blocks.text: Ek qawl yeh hai ke Yahood-o-Nasara ko apni maut ke waqt jab azaab ke farishte nazar aate hain to woh Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام par imaan le aate hain, lekin us waqt ka imaan maqbool aur mo'tabar nahin hota. blocks.text: {یَكُوْنُ عَلَیْهِمْ شَهِیْدًا: Woh un par gawah honge.} Yani Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام Qiyamat ke din Yahoodiyon par yeh gawahi denge ke unhone aap عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki takzeeb ki aur aap عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke haq mein zaban-e-ta'n daraaz ki. Aur Nasara par yeh gawahi denge ke unhone aap عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko Rabb thehraya aur Khuda عَزَّوَجَلَّ ka shareek jaana. Ahl-e-Kitab mein se jo log imaan le aayenge, Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام un ke imaan ki bhi gawahi denge.

blocks.text: Sood aur rishwat ki mazammat: Is aayat se sood ki hurmat aur rishwat ki qabahat aur gandagi bhi maloom hui. Sood lena shadeed haraam hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai ke Sarwar-e-Kainaat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: "Beshak sood sattar gunahon ka majmua hai. In mein sab se chhota gunah yeh hai ke aadmi apni maa se zina kare." (Ibn Majah, Kitab-ut-Tijaraat, Baab-ut-Taghleez fir-Riba, 3/72, hadees: 2274)

blocks.text: Ahl-e-Kitab un sab ki nubuwwat ko maante hain. Jab un mein se kai Ambiya ki nubuwwat tasleem karne mein Ahl-e-Kitab ko koi hichkichahat nahin hui to Imam-ul-Anbiya, Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki nubuwwat tasleem karne mein kya uzr hai?

blocks.text: Rasoolon عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko bhejne ka maqsad makhlooq ki hidayat karna, unhein Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed aur ma'rifat ka dars dena, imaan mukammal karna aur ibaadat ke tareeqe sikhana hai. Kitab ke alag alag waqt par nazil hone se yeh maqsad zyada mukammal tareeqe se hasil hota hai, kyunke thoda thoda karke baat aasani se dil mein utarti chali jaati hai. Is hikmat ko na samajhna aur aitiraaz karna intehai darje ki bewaqoofi hai. SubhanAllah! Kaisa dil-nasheen aur pyara jawab hai.

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا: Beshak jinhon ne kufr kiya.} Yahan bhi Yahoodiyon ka bayan hai ke unhone Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke saath kufr kiya aur Allah ki kitab, yani Taurat mein maujood Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke ausaaf badal kar aur aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki nubuwwat ka inkaar karke zulm kiya. Aise log jab tak apne kufr par qaayam rahein aur kufr hi par mar jaayein, un ki maghfirat ki koi gunjaish nahin. Unhein kisi seedhe raaste ki hidayat bhi nahin milegi. Albatta Jahannam ka raasta un ke liye zaroor khula hua hai aur bilkul wazeh hoga.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aye Kitaab walo! Apne deen mein had se na badho aur Allah par sach ke siwa koi baat na kaho. Beshak Maseeh, Maryam ka beta Eesa sirf Allah ka Rasool aur us ka ek kalma hai jo us ne Maryam ki taraf bheja aur us ki taraf se ek khaas rooh hai to Allah aur us ke Rasoolon par imaan lao aur na kaho (ke mabood) teen hain. (Is se) baaz raho, (yeh) tumhare liye behtar hai. Sirf Allah hi ek mabood hai, woh paak hai is se ke us ki koi aulaad ho. Usi ka hai jo kuch aasmanon mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai aur Allah kaafi kaarsaaz hai.

runs.text: Isaaiyon ke firqe aur un ke aqeede

blocks.text: Isaai chaar bade firqon mein bat gaye the: (1) Ya'qoobiyah, (2) Malkaniyah, (3) Nasturiyah, (4) Marqosiyah. In mein se har ek Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke baare mein alag kufri aqeeda rakhta tha. Ya'qoobiyah aur Malkaniyah Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko Khuda kehte the. Nasturiyah Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko Khuda ka beta kehte the. Marqosiyah firqe ka aqeeda tha ke Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام teen mein se teesre hain.

blocks.text: Is jumle ka matlab kya hai, is mein bhi un ke darmiyan ikhtilaf tha. Baaz teen uqnoom, yani wajood, maante the aur kehte the ke Baap, Beta aur Rooh-ul-Qudus teen hain. Baap se zaat, Bete se Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام aur Rooh-ul-Qudus se un mein hulool karne wali hayaat murad lete the. Goya un ke nazdeek mabood teen the aur woh in teenon ko ek kehte the.

blocks.text: Is aayat mein Ahl-e-Kitaab ko hidayat di gayi hai ke Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke baare mein ifraat-o-tafreet se baaz rahein. Unhein Khuda ya Khuda ka beta na kahen aur hulool-o-ittehaad ka aqeeda rakh kar un ki tauheen bhi na karein. Balke yeh aqeeda rakhein ke Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام Hazrat Maryam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ke bete hain, un ka is ke siwa koi nasab nahin. Woh sirf Allah Ta'ala ke Rasool, us ka ek kalma jo Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Maryam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ki taraf bheja, aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se ek khaas rooh hain. Is liye unhein chahiye ke Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ aur us ke Rasoolon par imaan laayein, tasdeeq karein ke Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ek hai aur beta aur aulaad se paak hai, aur tasdeeq karein ke Hazrat Eesa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke Rasoolon mein se hain.

blocks.text: Chunanche Sarkar-e-Kainaat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ka mubarak baal bhi mojiza hai. Jab Hazrat Khalid رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ki topi mein raha to unhein hamesha dushmanon par fatah hoti rahi. Jab woh Qaisar-e-Room Heraclius ki pagri mein raha to us ke sar ka dard door raha. Hazrat Sayyiduna Amr bin Aas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne wasiyyat ki thi ke mere kafan mein Tajdar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke mubarak baal rakh diye jaayen taa-ke qabr ki mushkil aasaan ho. Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne wasiyyat ki ke mujhe ghusl de kar meri aankhon aur labon par Sultan-e-Do Jahan صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke naakhun aur mubarak baal rakh diye jaayen taa-ke qabr ke hisaab mein aasaani ho. Is se maloom hua ke mubarak baal qabr ki mushkil aasaan karte hain. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم mareezon ko mubarak baalon ka dhula hua paani pilaya karte the. Hazrat Talhah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke ghar ek martaba mubarak baal pohnch gaye to unhone saari raat malaaikah ki tasbeeh-o-tahleel suni.

Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne wasiyyat ki ke mujhe ghusl de kar meri aankhon aur labon par Sultan-e-Do Jahan صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke naakhun aur mubarak baal rakh diye jaayen taa-ke qabr ke hisaab mein aasaani ho. Is se maloom hua ke mubarak baal qabr ki mushkil aasaan karte hain. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم mareezon ko mubarak baalon ka dhula hua paani pilaya karte the. Hazrat Talhah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke ghar ek martaba mubarak baal pohnch gaye to unhone saari raat malaaikah ki tasbeeh-o-tahleel suni.

blocks.text: Mubarak haath bhi daleel hai. Badr ke din ek muthi kankariyan kafiron ki taraf phenki to Rab Ta'ala ne farmaya: مَا رَمَیْتَ اِذْ رَمَیْتَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَمٰى yani aap ne nahin phenka balke hum ne phenka. Isi haath mein aa kar kankariyon ne kalima padha. Isi haath se bai'at li gayi to Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ ne farmaya ke un ke haathon par hamara haath hai. Ungliyan bhi mojiza hain: ek pyale paani mein ungliyan mubarak rakh di to paani ke chashme jaari ho gaye. Ungli ke ishaare se chaand cheer diya. Mubarak paon bhi mojiza hai: pathar par chale to pathar ne un ka asar le liya, farsh par bhi chale aur Arsh par bhi.

Jaagna aur sona bhi mojiza hai: har shakhs ki neend wuzu tod deti hai, magar Sarkar-e-Aali Waqar صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki neend wuzu nahin todti. Aap ka poora mubarak jism saaye se mehfooz raha, yani saaya bhi kisi ke qadmon ke neeche nahin aata tha. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aye Habeeb! Tum se fatwa poochte hain, tum farma do ke Allah tumhein kalaalah ke baare mein fatwa deta hai. Agar kisi mard ka inteqaal ho jis ki aulaad na ho aur us ki ek behen ho to tarke mein us ki behen ka aadha hai aur mard apni behen ka waaris hoga agar behen ki aulaad na ho. Phir agar do bahnein hon to tarke mein un ka do-tihaai hissa hoga aur agar bhai behen hon, jin mein mard bhi hon aur auratein bhi, to mard ka hissa do auraton ke barabar hoga. Allah tumhare liye saaf bayan farmata hai taa-ke tum bhatak na jao aur Allah har cheez jaanta hai.

Zamana-e-Jahiliyyat mein bhi kafir in ka adab karte the aur Islam ne bhi in ka ehtiram baqi rakha. Pehle Islam mein in mahino mein jang haram thi. Ab har waqt jihad ho sakta hai, lekin in mahino ka ehtiram badastoor baqi hai. Is ki tafseel Surah Taubah, aayat 36 mein aayegi.

blocks.text: {وَ لَا الْهَدْیَ وَ لَا الْقَلَآىٕدَ: Aur na Haram ki qurbaniyon ko aur na alaamati patte wali qurbaniyon ko.} Arab log qurbaniyon ke gale mein Haram Shareef ke darakhton ki chaal waghera ke haar daalte the taake log jaan lein ke yeh Haram ko bheji hui qurbaniyan hain aur un se chhed-chhad na karein. Haram Shareef ki un qurbaniyon ke ehtiram ka hukm diya gaya hai.

Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ apne Ashab رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ke saath tashreef le ja rahe the. Raaste mein Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ne Shuraih ko dekha aur chaha ke mawashi us se wapas le lein, lekin Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne mana farma diya. blocks.text: Yeh nihayat jaame' aayat hai. Neki aur taqwa ki tamam qismein is mein shamil hain, aur ism aur udwan mein har woh cheez shamil hai jo gunah aur zyadti ke daayre mein aati ho. Ilm-e-deen phelane mein waqt, maal, dars-o-tadrees aur likhne waghera se ek doosre ki madad karna; Islam ki dawat aur us ki taleemaat duniya ke har kone tak pahunchane ke liye baahmi ta'awun karna; apni aur doosron ki amali haalat sudharna; neki ki dawat dena aur burai se rokna; mulk aur qaum ke mushtarka faidon mein ek doosre ka saath dena; social work aur samaji khidmaat, sab is mein shamil hain.

blocks.text: سُبْحَانَ اللہ! Quran-e-Paak ki taleemaat kitni umdah hain. Is ka har hukm dil ki gehraai mein utarne wala aur har aayat gumrah logon ke liye roshni ka minaar hai. In taleemaat se sahi faida us waqt milega jab in par amal bhi kiya jaaye. Afsoos ke aaj Musalmanon ki ek tadaad amali taur par Quran ki taleemaat se bahut door ho gayi hai. Allah Ta'ala sab Musalmanon ko Quran ke ahkaam par amal ki taufeeq ata farmaye.

blocks.text: Arabic: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَیْكُمُ الْمَیْتَةُ وَ الدَّمُ وَ لَحْمُ الْخِنْزِیْرِ وَ مَاۤ اُهِلَّ لِغَیْرِ اللّٰهِ بِهٖ وَ الْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَ الْمَوْقُوْذَةُ وَ الْمُتَرَدِّیَةُ وَ النَّطِیْحَةُ وَ مَاۤ اَكَلَ السَّبُعُ اِلَّا مَا ذَكَّیْتُمْ- وَ مَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى النُّصُبِ وَ اَنْ تَسْتَقْسِمُوْا بِالْاَزْلَامِؕ-ذٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌؕ-اَلْیَوْمَ یَىٕسَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ دِیْنِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَ اخْشَوْنِؕ-اَلْیَوْمَ اَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِیْنَكُمْ وَ اَتْمَمْتُ عَلَیْكُمْ نِعْمَتِیْ وَ رَضِیْتُ لَكُمُ الْاِسْلَامَ دِیْنًاؕ-فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ فِیْ مَخْمَصَةٍ غَیْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّاِثْمٍۙ-فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِیْمٌ(3)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tum par haram kiya gaya hai murdaar, khoon, suar ka gosht, woh jaanwar jis ke zabh ke waqt ghairullah ka naam pukara gaya ho, gala ghontne se marne wala, bina dhaar wali cheez ki chot se marne wala, bulandi se gir kar marne wala, kisi jaanwar ke seeng maarne se marne wala, aur woh jise kisi darinde ne kha liya ho, siwaye un ke jinhein tum ne zinda paa kar zabh kar liya ho. Aur jo but ke aastane par zabh kiya gaya ho, aur paanse daal kar qismat maloom karna bhi haram hai. Yeh gunah ka kaam hai. Aaj kafir tumhare deen se na-umeed ho gaye, to un se na daro aur mujh se daro. Aaj main ne tumhare liye tumhara deen mukammal kar diya, tum par apni nemat poori kar di aur tumhare liye Islam ko deen pasand kiya. To jo bhook ki shiddat mein majboor ho, is haal mein ke gunah ki taraf mail na ho, to beshak Allah bakhshne wala, mehrban hai.

blocks.text: Baaz mufassireen ka qawl hai ke deen mukammal karne ka matlab Islam ko ghalib karna hai. Isi ka asar tha ke Hajjat-ul-Wida mein is aayat ke naazil hone par koi mushrik Musalmanon ke saath Hajj mein shareek na ho saka. Ek qawl yeh hai ke ma'ni yeh hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein dushman se aman diya. Ek qawl yeh hai ke deen ka ikmaal yeh hai ke yeh pichhli Shari'aton ki tarah mansookh nahin hoga aur Qiyamat tak baqi rahega. (Khazin, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 3, 1/464)

blocks.text: Is aayat ke baare mein Bukhari aur Muslim ki hadees mein hai ke Hazrat Umar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke paas ek Yahoodi aaya aur bola: Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ! Aap ki kitaab mein ek aayat hai. Agar woh hum Yahoodiyon par naazil hui hoti to hum us ke naazil hone ke din Eid manate. Hazrat Umar Farooq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne poocha: Kaun si aayat? Us Yahoodi ne اَلْیَوْمَ اَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ wali aayat padhi. Aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne farmaya: Main us din ko jaanta hoon jis din yeh naazil hui aur is ke naazil hone ki jagah ko bhi pehchanta hoon. Woh jagah Arafaat thi aur din Jumu'ah ka tha. (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-Iman, Baab Ziyadat-ul-Iman wa Nuqsanuhu, 1/28, hadees: 45; Muslim, Kitaab-ut-Tafseer, safha 1609, hadees: 5 (3017))

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae Habeeb! Tum se poochhte hain ke un ke liye kya halal hua. Tum farma do ke tumhare liye paak cheezein halal ki gayi hain aur woh shikari jaanwar bhi jinhein tum ne shikaar par daudate hue shikaar karna sikha diya hai. Tum unhein woh sikhate ho jo Allah ne tumhein sikhaya hai. To us mein se khao jo woh tumhare liye shikaar karke rok dein aur shikari jaanwar ko chhorte waqt us par Allah ka naam lo. Allah se darte raho. Beshak Allah bahut jald hisaab lene wala hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae iman walo! Jab tum namaz ki taraf kharay hone lago to apne chehron ko aur apne haath kohniyon tak dho lo aur saron ka masah karo aur takhnon tak paon dho lo. Aur agar tum be-ghusl ho to khoob paak ho jao. Aur agar tum beemar ho ya safar mein ho ya tum mein se koi bait-ul-khala se aaya ho ya tum ne auraton se sohbat ki ho aur in sooraton mein paani na pao to paak mitti se tayammum kar lo, to apne chehron aur haathon ka us se masah kar lo. Allah nahin chahta ke tum par kuchh tangi rakhe, lekin woh yeh chahta hai ke tumhein khoob paak kar de aur apni nemat tum par poori kar de taake tum shukr ada karo.

blocks.text: Janabat ke kai asbaab hain: (1) Jaagte mein shahwat ke saath uchhal kar mani ka kharij hona. (2) Sote mein ehtilaam ho jaana. (3) Humbistari karna, agarche mani kharij na ho. Is ka hukm yeh hai ke ghusl kiye baghair namaz padhna, tilawat-e-Quran karna, Quran-e-Paak ko chhoona aur masjid mein daakhil hona najaiz hai. Jo kaam janabat ki haalat mein mana hain, haiz aur nifaas ki haalat mein bhi mana honge. Lekin jab tak aurat haiz ya nifaas ki haalat mein hai, ghusl karne se paak nahin hogi, jabke junubi ghusl karne se paak ho jaata hai. Isi tarah haiz aur nifaas ki haalat mein biwi se sohbat karna bhi mana hai, jabke janabat ki haalat mein sohbat karna mana nahin. (Ahkaam-ul-Quran, Surah Al-Maidah, Baab-ul-Ghusl min-al-Janabah, 2/457)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae iman walo! Insaaf ke saath gawahi dete hue Allah ke hukm par khoob qaim ho jao aur tumhein kisi qaum ki adaawat is par na ubhaare ke tum insaaf na karo, balki insaaf karo. Yeh parhezgari ke zyada qareeb hai aur Allah se daro. Beshak Allah tumhare tamam aamaal se khabardaar hai.

blocks.text: Makkah Mukarramah pahunchne ke baad ek din tawaaf ke dauran kisi dehaati Musalman ka paon us ki chaadar par pad gaya aur chaadar kandhe se utar gayi. Jablah bin Ayham ne poocha: Tum ne meri chaadar par qadam kyun rakha? Us ne kaha: Main ne jaan-boojh kar qadam nahin rakha, ghalati se pad gaya tha. Yeh sun kar Jablah ne us ke chehre par zor daar thappad maar diya. Thappad ki wajah se us ke do daant toot gaye aur naak bhi zakhmi ho gayi.

blocks.text: Targheeb ke liye ek hadees-e-mubarakah pesh ki jaati hai. Hazrat Muaz bin Jabal رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: "Main ek safar mein Rasool-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke humraah tha. Ek roz chalte chalte main Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke qareeb ho gaya aur arz ki: Ya Rasoolallah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Mujhe aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare aur Jahannam se door rakhe.

Ek roz chalte chalte main Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke qareeb ho gaya aur arz ki: Ya Rasoolallah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Mujhe aisa amal bataiye jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare aur Jahannam se door rakhe.

blocks.text: "Huzoor-e-Anwar صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: Tum ne mujh se ek bahut badi baat ka sawaal kiya. Albatta jis ke liye Allah Ta'ala aasaan farma de, us ke liye aasaan hai. Tum Allah Ta'ala ki ibaadat karo aur us ke saath kisi ko shareek na thehrao, namaz qaim karo, zakat ada karo, Ramazan ke roze rakho aur Baitullah Shareef ka Hajj karo.

blocks.text: "Phir irshad farmaya: Kya main tumhein neki ke darwaaze na bataun? Roza dhaal hai aur sadaqah gunahon ko is tarah bujha deta hai, jaise paani aag ko bujhata hai. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur beshak Allah ne Bani Israeel se ahad liya aur hum ne un mein baarah sardaar muqarrar kiye aur Allah ne farmaya: Beshak main tumhare saath hoon. Agar tum namaz qaim rakho, zakat dete raho, mere Rasoolon par iman lao, un ki ta'zeem karo aur Allah ko achha qarz do to beshak main tum se tumhare gunah mita doonga aur zaroor tumhein un baaghon mein daakhil karunga jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain. To is ahad ke baad tum mein se jis ne kufr kiya to woh zaroor seedhi raah se bhatak gaya.

Apni qaum ke har giroh mein se ek sardaar banao. Is tarah baarah sardaar muqarrar karo; har sardaar apni qaum ke hukm maanne aur ahad poora karne ka zimmedaar ho.

blocks.text: Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne baarah sardaar muntakhab kiye aur Bani Israeel ko le kar rawana hue. Jab Ariha ke qareeb pahunche to un sardaron ko dushmanon ke haalaat maloom karne bheja. Unhone dekha ke woh log bahut bade qad-o-qamat, nihayat taaqatwar aur haibat wale hain. Yeh sardaar un se dar kar laut aaye aur apni qaum ko sab haal bata diya, halaanke unhein aisa karne se mana kiya gaya tha.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: To un ke ahad todne ki wajah se hum ne un par laanat ki aur un ke dil sakht kar diye. Woh Allah ki baaton ko un ke maqamat se badal dete hain aur unhone un nasihaton ka bada hissa bhula diya jo unhein ki gayi thin. Aur tum un mein se chand ek ke siwa sab ki kisi na kisi khayanat par muttali hote rahoge. To unhein maaf kar do aur un se darguzar karo. Beshak Allah ehsaan karne walon se muhabbat farmata hai.

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke bad-amaliyon ki wajah se bhi dil sakht ho jaate hain. Hazrat Yahya bin Mu'aaz رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Aansu dilon ki sakhti ki wajah se khushk hote hain. Dilon ki sakhti gunahon ki kasrat se hoti hai aur gunah aibon ki zyadaati ki wajah se bahut ho jaate hain.” (Shu'ab-ul-Iman, As-Saabi' wal-Arba'oon min Shu'ab-ul-Iman, fasl fi at-tab'i alal-qalb aw ar-rain, 5/446, hadees: 7221)

blocks.text: {وَ لَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ: Aur aap hamesha muttali hote rahenge.} Sarwar-e-Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko bataya gaya ke Aap hamesha un logon ki khayanaton se muttali hote rahenge. Daghabaazi, khayanat, ahad todna aur Rasoolon se bad-ahdi un ki aur un ke baap dada ki purani aadat hai. Haan, un mein se jo thodi si tadaad iman laayi, woh khayanat karne wali nahin. Un se jo pehle ho chuka us par giraft na farmayein. (Baizawi, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 13, 2/306)

Woh tum par bahut si woh cheezein zaahir farmate hain jo tum ne Allah ki kitaab se chhupa di thin aur bahut si maaf farma dete hain. Beshak tumhare paas Allah ki taraf se ek Noor aaya aur ek roshan Kitaab.

blocks.text: Tumhari chhupayi hui baatein zaahir karne ke saath Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ bahut si baatein maaf bhi farma dete hain. (Tafseer Kabeer, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 15, 4/327)

blocks.text: Allamah Mulla Ali Qaari رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “وَ اَیُّ مَانِعٍ مِنْ اَنْ یُجْعَلَ النَّعْتَانِ لِلرَّسُوْلِ صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ فَاِنَّہٗ نُوْرٌعَظِیْمٌ لِکَمَالِ ظُھُوْرِہٖ بَیْنَ الْاَنْوَارِ وَ کِتَابٌ مُّبِیْنٌ حَیْثُ اَنَّہٗ جَامِعٌ لِجَمِیْعِ الْاَسْرَارِ وَمُظْھِرٌ لِلْاَحْکَامِ وَالْاَحْوَالِ وَالْاَخْبَارِ” yani is baat mein kya rukawat hai ke Noor aur Kitaab-e-Mubeen dono Rasool-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki na'at hon? (Sharh-e-Shifa, Al-Qism-ul-Awwal, Al-Baab-ul-Awwal fi Sana'illahi Ta'ala alaih, Al-Fasl-ul-Awwal, 1/51)

(Sharh-e-Shifa, Al-Qism-ul-Awwal, Al-Baab-ul-Awwal fi Sana'illahi Ta'ala alaih, Al-Fasl-ul-Awwal, 1/51)

blocks.text: Balki khud Rasool-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne apna Noor hona bayan farmaya. Imam Abdul Razzaaq رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ Hazrat Jaabir رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat karte hain: “قَالَ سَاَلْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللہِ صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ اَوَّلِ شَیْئٍ خَلَقَہُ اللہُ تَعَالٰی؟ فَقَالَ ھُوَ نُوْرُ نَبِیِّکَ یَا جَابِرُ خَلَقَہُ اللہُ” yani Hazrat Jaabir رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: Main ne Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ se poocha ke Allah Ta'ala ne sab se pehle kya paida farmaya? To Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: “Ae Jaabir! Woh tumhare Nabi ka Noor hai jise Allah Ta'ala ne paida farmaya.” (Al-Juz-ul-Mafqood min Al-Musannaf Abdul Razzaaq, Kitaab-ul-Iman, Baab fi Takhleeq Noor-e-Muhammad ﷺ, safha 63, hadees: 18)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Beshak woh log kafir ho gaye jinhon ne kaha ke Allah hi Maseeh bin Maryam hai. Tum farma do: Agar Allah Maseeh bin Maryam ko aur us ki maa aur tamaam zameen walon ko halaak karne ka irada farma le to kaun hai jo Allah se bachane ki taaqat rakhta hai? Aur aasmaanon aur zameen ki aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyan hai sab ki baadshahat Allah hi ke liye hai. Woh jo chahta hai paida karta hai aur Allah har shay par Qaadir hai.

Nasraaniyon ke Ya'qubiyyah aur Malakaniyyah firqon ka bhi yahi aqeeda tha ke Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko Allah batate the. Woh hulool ke qaail the aur un ka batil aqeeda tha ke Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام mein is tarah hulool kiye hue hai jaise phool mein khushboo aur aag mein garmi. مَعَاذَ اللہ ثُمَّ مَعَاذَاللہ۔ Allah Ta'ala is se paak hai. Allah Ta'ala ne is aayat mein un ke kufr ka hukm diya aur phir un ke aqeede ke fasad ko bayan farmaya.

blocks.text: Is aayat mein Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki uloohiyyat ki kai tareeqon se tardeed hai:

runs.text: Is aayat mein Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki uloohiyyat ki kai tareeqon se tardeed hai:

blocks.text: (1) Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko wafaat aa sakti hai. Jise wafaat aa sakti ho, woh Khuda nahin ho sakta.

blocks.text: (2) Aap عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام maa ke pait se paida hue. Jis mein yeh sifat ho, woh Allah nahin ho sakta.

blocks.text: (3) Allah Ta'ala aasmaan aur zameen ki tamam cheezon ka Maalik hai aur har cheez Allah Ta'ala ki bandi hai. blocks.text: Is aayat se maloom hua ke apne aap ko aamaal se be-niyaaz samajhna Isaaiyon ka aqeeda hai. Aaj kal baaz Ahl-e-Bait se muhabbat ka da'wa karne wale aur baaz jaahil faqeer bhi yahi aqeeda rakhte hain. Aisa aqeeda kufr hai, kyunki Quran-e-Kareem ne har jagah iman ke saath nek aamaal ka bhi zikr farmaya hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae Kitaab walo! Beshak tumhare paas hamare Rasool tashreef laaye, woh Rasoolon ki tashreef aawari band ho jaane ke arse ke baad tum par hamare ahkaam zaahir farma rahe hain taake tum yeh na kaho ke hamare paas to koi khushkhabri dene wala aur daraane wala aaya hi nahin. To beshak tumhare paas khushkhabri dene wala aur daraane wala tashreef la chuka aur Allah har shay par Qaadir hai.

Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke baad Huzoor Sarwar-e-Kaainat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki tashreef-aawari tak paanch sau unahattar (569) saal tak koi Nabi tashreef nahin laaye. blocks.text: Iqtidaar ke bojh se aansu bahaana

runs.text: Iqtidaar ke bojh se aansu bahaana

blocks.text: Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ki zawja-e-mohtarma farmati hain: Jab Aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ khilaafat ke mansab par faa'iz hue to ghar aa kar musalle par baith gaye aur rone lage. Itna roye ke Aap ki daadhi mubarak aansuon se tar ho gayi. Main ne arz ki: Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ! Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya: “Meri gardan par Tajdar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki ummat ka bojh daal diya gaya hai. Jab main ne bhooke faqeeron, mareezon, mazloom qaidiyon, musafiron, boodhon, bachchon aur aulaad-daaron, balki poori saltanat ke museebat-zadon ki khabar-giri ke baare mein socha aur mujhe maloom hai ke mera Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ Qiyamat ke din in ke baare mein mujh se poochhega, to mujhe dar hai ke kahin main un ke baare mein jawab na de sakun. Isi bhaari zimmedari aur us ke baare mein poochh-gachh ki fikr ki wajah se main ro raha hoon.” (Tareekh-ul-Khulafa, Umar bin Abdul Aziz رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ, safha 189)

blocks.text: Un dono ne yeh bhi kaha ke Jabbareen ke bade bade jism dekh kar mat daro. Hum ne unhein dekha hai. Un ke jism bade hain, lekin dil kamzor hain. Yeh baat sun kar Bani Israeel bohat naaraaz hue. Woh josh mein aane ke bajaye un dono ke khilaaf ho gaye aur un par pathar barsane ka iraada kiya.

blocks.text: Is waqia se maloom hua ke Rasool-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke saathiyon se kahin afzal hain. Un buzurgon ne kisi mushkil mauqe par bhi Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ka saath nahin chhoda aur aisa rukha jawab nahin diya. Balki apna sab kuch Huzoor-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ par qurban kar diya.

blocks.text: Jis tarah Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ tamam Nabiyon ke sardaar hain, isi tarah Huzoor Anwar صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم tamam Ambiya ke Sahaba ke sardaar hain. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ki jaanisaari ke baare mein yeh waqia mulahaza karein.

blocks.text: Jang-e-Badr ke mauqe par Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم se mashwara farmaya. Hazrat Sa'd bin Ubadah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ khade hue aur arz ki: Ya Rasoolallah! صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ, Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ hamari raye maloom karna chahte hain. Us Zaat ki qasam jis ke qabze-e-qudrat mein meri jaan hai, agar Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ hamein samandar mein kood jaane ka hukm dein to hum us mein kood jaayenge. (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Jihaad was-Siyar, Baab Ghazwat-ul-Badr, safha 981, hadees: 83 (1779))

Bani Israeel ki buzdili aur Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke hukm par amal na karne ki saza yeh mili ke muqaddas zameen chalis saal tak un par haraam kar di gayi. Yani Bani Israeel ab muqaddas zameen mein daakhil na ho sakenge.

blocks.text: Jis zameen mein yeh log bhatakte phire, woh lagbhag sataais meel thi aur qaum kai lakh afraad par mushtamil thi. Woh sab apne saamaan ke saath poora din chalte, lekin jab shaam hoti to apne aap ko usi jagah paate jahan se chale the. Yeh un par saza thi. Sirf Hazrat Musa, Hazrat Haroon, Hazrat Yusha aur Hazrat Kaalib عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام par Allah Ta'ala ne aasani farmayi aur un ki madad ki, jaise Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke liye aag ko thanda aur salaamati wali bana diya tha.

blocks.text: Itni badi jamaat ka itni chhoti zameen mein chalis saal tak aawara aur pareshaan phirna aur kisi ka wahan se na nikal paana khilaaf-e-aadat waqia hai. Jab Bani Israeel ne is jangal mein Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام se khane peene aur doosri zarooriyat aur takleef ki shikayat ki to Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki dua se unhein aasmani ghiza “Mann-o-Salwa” ata farmayi. Un ke badan par aisa libaas paida kiya jo badan ke saath badhta tha. Koh-e-Toor ka ek safed pathar bhi ata farmaya. Jab woh safar ka saamaan utaarte ya kahin thehrte to Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام us pathar par asa maarte aur us se Bani Israeel ke baarah girohon ke liye baarah chashme jaari ho jaate. Saaya karne ke liye ek baadal bheja gaya.

blocks.text: Maidan-e-Teh mein jitne log daakhil hue the, un mein se jo bees saal se zyada umar ke the woh sab wahin wafat pa gaye, siwaye Yusha bin Noon aur Kaalib bin Yuqna ke. Jinhon ne Arz-e-Muqaddasah mein daakhil hone se inkar kiya tha, un mein se koi bhi wahan daakhil na ho saka. blocks.text: Haabeel aur Qaabeel ka waqia

runs.text: Haabeel aur Qaabeel ka waqia

blocks.text: Tareekh ke ulama ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Hawwa رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ke har hamal mein ek ladka aur ek ladki paida hote the. Ek hamal ke ladke ka doosre hamal ki ladki ke saath nikah kiya jaata tha. Us waqt insaan sirf Hazrat Adam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki aulaad mein mahdood the, is liye aapas mein nikah ke siwa koi doosri soorat na thi.

Ek hamal ke ladke ka doosre hamal ki ladki ke saath nikah kiya jaata tha. blocks.text: Isi dastoor ke mutabiq Hazrat Adam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام Qaabeel ka nikah Liwda se karna chahte the, jo Haabeel ke saath paida hui thi, aur Haabeel ka nikah Aqleema se, jo Qaabeel ke saath paida hui thi. Qaabeel is par raazi na hua. Aqleema zyada khoobsurat thi, is liye woh us ka talabgaar tha. Hazrat Adam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne farmaya: Woh tumhare saath paida hui hai, is liye tumhari behen hai; tumhara us ke saath nikah halal nahin. Qaabeel ne kaha: Yeh aap ki raye hai, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh hukm nahin diya.

Aasmani aag ne Haabeel ki qurbani qabool kar li aur Qaabeel ki gandum ko chhor diya.

Jab Hazrat Adam عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام Hajj ke liye Makkah Mukarramah tashreef le gaye to Qaabeel ne Haabeel se kaha: Main tujhe qatl kar dunga. Haabeel ne poocha: Kyun? Yeh sirf is liye hai ke main Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ se darta hoon. blocks.text: Aman-o-salaamati ka mazhab

runs.text: Aman-o-salaamati ka mazhab

blocks.text: Yeh aayat-e-mubarakah Islam ki asal taleemaat ko wazeh karti hai ke Islam kis qadar aman-o-salaamati ka mazhab hai aur Islam ki nazar mein insani jaan ki kitni ahmiyat hai. Un logon ko ibrat haasil karni chahiye jo Islam ki asal taleemaat ko peechhe daal kar Islam ke daaman par qatl-o-ghaaratgari ki himayat ka badnuma daagh lagaate hain. Aur un logon ko bhi naseehat haasil karni chahiye jo Musalman kehla kar be-qasoor logon ko bam dhamakon aur khudkush hamlon ke zariye maut ki neend sula kar yeh gumaan karte hain ke unhone Islam ki bahut badi khidmat anjaam de di.

blocks.text: Is saza ki tafseel yeh hai ke daakuon ne kisi Musalman ya zimmi ko qatl kiya aur maal na liya to unhein qatl kiya jaaye. Agar qatl bhi kiya aur maal bhi loota to Badshah-e-Islam ko ikhtiyar hai ke haath paon kaat kar qatl kar de, ya sooli de, ya haath paon kaat kar qatl kare aur phir laash ko sooli par chadha de, ya sirf qatl kar de, ya qatl kar ke sooli par chadha de, ya sirf sooli de. Agar qatl nahin kiya, sirf maal loota to daayan haath aur baayan paon kaat diya jaaye. Agar na maal loota na qatl kiya, sirf daraaya dhamkaya to unhein qaid kar liya jaaye, yahan tak ke sachchi taubah kar lein. blocks.text: Islami sazayon ki hikmat

runs.text: Islami sazayon ki hikmat

blocks.text: Islam ne har jurm ki saza us ki no'iyat ke mutabiq mukhtalif rakhi hai. Chhote jurm ki saza halki aur bade jurm ki us ki haisiyat ke mutabiq sakht saza rakhi hai, taake zameen mein aman qaim ho aur log be-khauf sukoon aur chain ki zindagi guzaar saken. Is ke ilawa bhi be-shumar hikmatein hain.

Is ke ilawa bhi be-shumar hikmatein hain.

blocks.text: Daaka-zani ki saza hi ko le lijiye. Jab tak is par amal raha, tijarati qaafile apne qeemti saaz-o-saamaan ke saath be-khauf-o-khatar safar karte the. Is wajah se tijarat ko bahut farogh mila aur log maashi taur par mazboot ho gaye. Jab se is saza par amal nahin ho raha, tijarati sargarmiyan sab ke saamne hain. Jis mulk mein tijarati saaz-o-saamaan ki naql-o-hamal ki hifazat ka munasib intizam nahin hota, wahan ki baraamad aur daraamad nihayat kam hoti hai aur maeeshat par bahut bura asar padta hai.

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:

Beshak agar kaafir log zameen mein jo kuchh hai woh sab aur us ke barabar itna hi aur us ke saath mila kar Qiyamat ke din ke azaab se chhutkaare ke liye dein to un se qubool nahin kiya jaayega aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {لِیَفْتَدُوْا بِهٖ: Taake fidya de kar jaan chhudaayen.} Yani agar kaafir duniya ke tamaam maal ke maalik hon aur us ke barabar doosri duniya ke maal ke bhi maalik hon, aur yeh sab kuchh apni jaan ko Qiyamat ke din ke azaab se chhudaane ke liye fidya mein de dein, tab bhi un ka yeh fidya qubool nahin kiya jaayega. Qiyamat ke din kaafiron ko azaab zaroor hoga aur us din un ke paas azaab se bachne ki koi soorat nahin hogi. (Khaazin, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 36, 1/491)

Log aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ko is tarah dekhte jaise koi qaid-e-tanhaai mein ho aur use saza-e-maut sunaayi jaane wali ho. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae Rasool! Jo log kufr mein daude ja rahe hain tumhein ghamgeen na karein. Ye woh hain jo apne munh se kehte hain ke hum imaan laaye, halaanke un ke dil Musalman nahin. Aur kuch Yahoodi bahut jhoot sunne wale hain aur un doosre logon ki bhi khoob sunte hain jo aap ki bargah mein nahin aaye. Ye Allah ke kalaam ko us ke maqamaat ke baad badal dete hain. Ye aapas mein kehte hain: Agar tumhein ye tehreef wala hukm mile to ise le lena aur agar ye na mile to bachna. Aur jise Allah gumraah karna chahe to ae mukhatab! blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Bahut jhoot sunne wale, bade haraam-khor hain. blocks.text: Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Tum apne maa-baap ke ghar baithe rehte aur dekhte ke tumhare liye kitne tohfe aate? Phir tum apni baat mein kitne sachche hote.” Phir aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya: “Jab main tum mein se kisi ko kisi jagah ka aamil banata hoon jis ka Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyaar diya hai, to woh mere paas aa kar kehta hai: Ye aap ka maal hai aur ye mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya hai. Woh apne maa-baap ke ghar kyun na baitha raha, yahan tak ke us ke paas tohfe aate? Khuda ki qasam! Tum mein se jo shakhs na-haq koi cheez lega, woh use uthaye hue Allah Ta'ala ki bargah mein haazir hoga.” Phir aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne haath buland kiya yahan tak ke baghal ki safedi nazar aane lagi aur farmaya: “Ae Allah! Kya main ne tera hukm pahuncha diya?” (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-Hiyal, Baab Ihtiyaal-ul-Aamil li-yuhda lah, 4/398, hadees: 6979)

blocks.text: Jis ne rishwat ke zariye koi maal haasil kiya ho, us par farz hai ke jis jis se woh maal liya tha unhein wapas kare. Agar woh log zinda na rahe hon to un ke waarison ko de. Is ke siwa rishwat ke maal ke wabaal se bachne ka koi aur tareeqa nahin. (Fatawa Razawiyyah, 23/551, khulaasa)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Beshak humne Taurat naazil farmayi jis mein hidaayat aur noor hai. Farmanbardaar Nabi aur Rabbani ulama aur fuqaha yahoodiyon ko isi ke mutabiq hukm dete the, kyunki unhein Allah ki is kitaab ka muhafiz banaya gaya tha aur woh us ke khud gawaah the. To logon se khauf na karo aur mujh se daro aur meri aayaat ke badle thodi zaleel qeemat na lo. Aur jo us ke mutabiq faisla na kare jo Allah ne naazil kiya to wohi log kaafir hain.

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ne Taurat naazil farmayi. Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام, un ke baad aane wale bahut se Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام aur ulama-o-fuqaha Taurat ke mutabiq faisle karte aur us ki taleemaat par amal karte the. blocks.text: Is aayat mein Yahood-o-Nasaara ke saath dosti aur muwalaat, yani un ki madad karna, un se madad lena aur un ke saath muhabbat ke ta'alluq rakhna mana kiya gaya hai. Yeh hukm aam hai, agarche aayat kisi khaas waaqe'e ke mauqe par naazil hui. Is liye bila qaid farmaya gaya ke Yahoodiyon aur Isaaiyon ko dost na banao. Woh Musalmanon ke muqable mein aapas mein ek doosre ke dost hain, tumhare dost nahin. Kafir koi bhi hon aur aapas mein un ke kitne hi ikhtilaaf hon, Musalmanon ke muqable mein woh sab ek hain: ’’اَلْکُفْرُ مِلَّۃٌ وَّاحِدۃٌ‘‘ Kafir ek hi millat hain. (Madaarik, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 51, safha 289)

blocks.text: Is liye Musalmanon ko kafiron ki dosti se bachne ka hukm dene ke saath bahut sakht wa'eed bayan ki gayi ke jo un se dosti karega woh unhi mein se hai. Is mein sakhti aur taakeed hai ke Musalmanon par Yahood-o-Nasaara aur Islam ke har mukhaalif se alag rehna waajib hai. (Madaarik, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 51, safha 289; Khaazin, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 51, 1/503, multaqatan)

blocks.text: Jo log kafiron se dosti karte hain woh apni jaanon par zulm karte hain. Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke Islami hukoomat mein kafiron ko aham aur faisla-kun ohde na diye jaayen. Yeh aayat Musalmanon ke hazaaron maamlaat mein rehnumaai karti hai aur is ki haqaaniyat bilkul zaahir hai. Duniya ke haalaat par nazar daalein to samajh aata hai ke Musalmanon ki zillat aur barbaadi us waqt shuru hui jab woh aapas mein nafrat, dushmani aur toot-phoot ka shikaar hue, ghair Muslimon ko apna khairkhwaah aur hamdard samajh kar un se dostiyan lagaane lage aur unhein apnon par tarjeeh dene lage. Allah Ta'ala hamein aqal-e-saleem ata farmaye.

blocks.text: Hazrat Sheikh Abu Abdullah Khayyaat رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ke paas ek aatish-parast kapde silwaata tha aur har baar ujrat mein khota sikka de jaata tha. Aap رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ use le lete the. Ek baar aap ki ghair-haazri mein shaagird ne aatish-parast se khota sikka lene se inkaar kar diya. Jab Hazrat Sheikh Abu Abdullah Khayyaat رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ waapas aaye aur unhein yeh maloom hua to shaagird se farmaya: Tum ne khota dirham kyun nahin liya? Kai saal se woh mujhe khota sikka hi deta raha hai aur main bhi khaamoshi se le leta hoon taake woh kisi doosre Musalman ko na de aaye. (Ihya-ul-Uloom, Kitaab Riyaazat-un-Nafs wa Tahzeeb-ul-Akhlaaq, Bayaan Alamaat Husn-ul-Khuluq, 3/87-88)

Hadees-e-Mubarak mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا se riwayat hai ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek behtareen saathi woh hain jo apne humraahiyon ke liye behtar hon aur Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke nazdeek behtareen hamsaaya woh hain jo apne hamsaaye ke liye achche hon.” (Tirmizi, Kitaab-ul-Birr was-Silah, Baab Ma Ja'a fi Haqq-il-Jiwaar, 3/379, hadees: 1951)

blocks.text: Haq-goi mein kisi ki malaamat ki parwaah na karne ke baare mein yeh hikayat dekhiye: Qaazi Abu Haazim رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ insaaf ke maamale mein bahut sakht the. Aap hamesha haq baat kehte aur durust faisle karte the. Ek baar waqt ke Khalifa Mu'tazid-billah ne aap ki taraf paighaam bheja: Falaan taajir ne hum se maal khareeda hai aur naqad raqam ada nahin ki. Woh mere ilawa doosron ka bhi qarzdaar hai. Mujhe khabar mili hai ke doosre qarzkhwaahon ne aap ke paas gawaah pesh kiye to aap ne us taajir ka maal un mein taqseem kar diya. Woh Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat mein haazir hue aur arz ki: Ya Rasoolallah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ! Hamari qaum ne hamein chhor diya aur qasmein khaayi hain ke woh hamare paas nahin baithenge. Doori ki wajah se hum aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke ashaab ki sohbat mein bhi nahin baith sakte. Afsos ke jo kaam Yahoodi aur munaafiq kiya karte the, wahi kaam Musalman kehlane walon mein aate ja rahe hain. Namaaz, roza, Hajj, zakaat, farishte, Jannat, hoorain, Dozakh aur us ka azaab, Qurani aayaat, Ahadees-e-Nabawi, deeni kitaabein, deeni shaa'ir, imaamah, daarhi, masjid, madrasa, deendaar aadmi, deeni libaas aur deeni jumle, garz woh kaunsi mazhabi cheez hai jis ka is zamaane mein khule aam filmon, dramaon, khaas taur par mazaahiya dramaon, aam bol-chaal, doston ki majlison, dunyawi taqreeron, hansi mazaaq ki nashiston aur baahmi guftagu mein mazaaq nahin udaaya jaata. blocks.text: Yahan “ithm” har gunaah aur naafarmaani ko shaamil hai. In Yahoodiyon ki sifat par ghaur karne ki zaroorat hai. Zahir mein gunaah, zyadati aur haraam-khori ke kaamon mein bhaag kar jaana un ki sifat batayi gayi, lekin aaj hamare darmiyan kitne log aise hain jo neki ke kaam mein der karte, balki use chhor dete hain, lekin gunaah ke kaam mein jaldi karte hain. Kisi ki madad karne aur use zulm se bachaane mein kinaara kar ke nikal jaate hain, lekin zulm aur zyadati mein apni qaum, ilaqe ya tehreek ke jhande ke neeche ta'assub ke saath maujood hote hain. Halaal un ke gale mein atakta hai, lekin jahan haraam ki umeed ho, rishwat mile, sood mile aur najaiz tijaarat ka faayda nazar aaye, wahan bhaag kar jaate hain.

blocks.text: Yahan Yahoodi darveshon aur ulama ke baare mein farmaya gaya ke unhone apni qaum ko gunaah ki baat kehne aur haraam khaane se kyun na roka. Is se maloom hua ke aalim-e-deen bhi is baat par pakda jaayega ke woh gunaah hota dekhe aur qudrat ke bawajood mana na kare, kyunki aisa aalim gunaah karne wale ki tarah hai. Imam Fakhruddin Raazi رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Gunaah roohani marz hai aur iska ilaaj Allah Ta'ala, us ki sifaat aur us ke ahkaam ki ma'rifat hai. Agar yeh ilm haasil hone ke bawajood gunaah khatam na hon to yeh aise marz ki tarah hai jo dawa khaane ke bawajood khatam na ho. Aalim ka gunaah karna is baat ki daleel hai ke us ka dil ka marz nihayat shadeed hai.” (Tafseer-e-Kabeer, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 63, 4/393)

blocks.text: Arabic: وَ قَالَتِ الْیَهُوْدُ یَدُ اللّٰهِ مَغْلُوْلَةٌؕ-غُلَّتْ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ لُعِنُوْا بِمَا قَالُوْاۘ-بَلْ یَدٰهُ مَبْسُوْطَتٰنِۙ-یُنْفِقُ كَیْفَ یَشَآءُؕ-وَ لَیَزِیْدَنَّ كَثِیْرًا مِّنْهُمْ مَّاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْكَ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ طُغْیَانًا وَّ كُفْرًاؕ-وَ اَلْقَیْنَا بَیْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَ الْبَغْضَآءَ اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَةِؕ-كُلَّمَاۤ اَوْقَدُوْا نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ اَطْفَاَهَا اللّٰهُۙ-وَ یَسْعَوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ فَسَادًاؕ-وَ اللّٰهُ لَا یُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِیْنَ(64)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur Yahoodiyon ne kaha: Allah ka haath bandha hua hai. Un ke haath baandhe jaayen aur un par is kehne ki wajah se laanat hai. Balki Allah ke haath kushaada hain, jaise chahta hai kharch farmata hai. Aur ae Habeeb! Yeh jo tumhari taraf tumhare Rab ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai, yeh un mein se bahut se logon ki sarkashi aur kufr mein izafa karega. Aur humne Qiyamat tak un mein dushmani aur bughz daal diya. Jab kabhi yeh ladaai ki aag bhadkaate hain to Allah use bujha deta hai. Aur yeh zameen mein fasaad phailaane ke liye koshish karte hain aur Allah fasaad phailaane walon ko pasand nahin karta.

blocks.text: {كُلَّمَاۤ اَوْقَدُوْا نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ: Jab kabhi yeh ladaai ki aag bhadkaate hain.} Jab bhi Yahoodiyon ne fasaad, shar-angezi aur Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ki mukhaalifat ki to Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ne un par kisi aise shakhs ko musallat kar diya jis ne unhein halaakat aur barbaadi se do-chaar kar diya. Pehle jab unhone fitna-fasaad shuru kiya aur Taurat ke ahkaam ki mukhaalifat ki to Allah Ta'ala ne Bakht Nasr ko un ki taraf bheja, jis ne unhein tabaah kar diya. runs.text: Deen ki pabandi aur Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at rizq mein wus'at ka zariya hai

blocks.text: Is aayat se maloom hua ke deen ki pabandi aur Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at aur farmabardaari se rizq mein wus'at hoti hai. Hazrat Abu Ishaq Hamdani رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ne irshaad farmaya: “Jise apni umr mein izafa aur rizq mein ziyadati pasand ho, use chahiye ke Allah Ta'ala se dare aur rishtedaron ke saath silah-rahmi kare.” (Shu'ab-ul-Imaan, as-saadis wal-khamsun min shu'ab-il-imaan, 6/219, hadees: 7947)

blocks.text: Aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Huzoor-e-Aqdas ﷺ ne irshaad farmaya: “Ae logo! Jo cheez tumhein Jannat ke qareeb aur Jahannam se door kar sakti hai, main ne tumhein us ka hukm de diya hai, aur jo cheez tumhein Jahannam ke qareeb aur Jannat se door kar sakti hai, main ne tumhein us se mana kar diya hai. Beshak Rooh-ul-Ameen عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام ne mere dil mein yeh baat daali hai ke koi jaan us waqt tak wafaat nahin paayegi jab tak apna rizq poora na kar le. Is liye Allah Ta'ala se daro aur achhe tareeqe se rizq talab karo. Rizq der se milna tumhein is baat par na ubhaare ke tum Allah Ta'ala ki na-farmaani ke zariye rizq talab karne lago, kyunki Allah Ta'ala ke paas jo kuch hai, woh us ki ita'at ke zariye hi haasil kiya ja sakta hai.” (Sharh-us-Sunnah, Kitaab-ur-Riqaaq, baab-ut-tawakkul alallah عزوجل، 7/329, hadees: 4006)

blocks.text: Arabic: قُلْ یٰۤاَهْلَ الْكِتٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلٰى شَیْءٍ حَتّٰى تُقِیْمُوا التَّوْرٰىةَ وَ الْاِنْجِیْلَ وَ مَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْكُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْؕ-وَ لَیَزِیْدَنَّ كَثِیْرًا مِّنْهُمْ مَّاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْكَ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ طُغْیَانًا وَّ كُفْرًاۚ-فَلَا تَاْسَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ(68)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tum farma do: Ae Kitabiyo! Jab tak tum Taurat, Injeel aur jo kuch tumhari taraf tumhare Rab ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai, use qaayam nahin kar lete, tum kisi cheez par nahin ho. Aur ae Habeeb! Yeh jo tumhari taraf tumhare Rab ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai, yeh un mein se bahut se logon ki sarkashi aur kufr mein zaroor izafa karega. To tum kaafir qaum par gham na karo.

Agar tum haqeeqi taur par Taurat aur Injeel par amal karo to Tajdaar-e-Risaalat ﷺ par bhi imaan lao, kyunki Aap ﷺ par imaan laane ka hukm Taurat aur Injeel mein maujood hai.

Yeh jo Aap ki taraf Aap ke Rab ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai.} Yani ae Habeeb ﷺ, jo Quran Aap ki taraf Aap ke Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai, yeh Ahl-e-Kitaab ke ulama aur sardaron ki puraani sarkashi aur kufr mein izafa karega. Jab Quran-e-Majeed ki koi aayat naazil hoti hai to woh us ka inkaar kar dete hain aur is tarah apne kufr aur sarkashi mein aur sakht ho jaate hain. Is liye ae Habeeb ﷺ, jo Yahoodi Aap ki nubuwwat ka inkaar kar rahe hain aur Aap par imaan nahin la rahe, un ki wajah se ghamgeen na hon, kyunki un ke kufr ka wabaal unhi par padega. blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Beshak jo apne aap ko Musalman kehte hain, aur Yahoodi, sitaron ki pooja karne wale aur Isaai, in mein se jo Allah aur Qiyamat par sachche dil se imaan laaye aur nek amal kare, to un par na koi khauf hoga aur na woh ghamgeen honge.

Is liye un ke baare mein uluhiyyat ka aqeeda rakhna baatil hai. (Abu Saud, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 76, 2/76)

blocks.text: Auliya-e-Kiraam ki ta'zeem karna aur faiz-o-barkaatein haasil karne ke liye un ke mazaaraat par haazir hona jaaiz aur pasandeeda amal hai, kyunki Auliya-e-Kiraam Allah Ta'ala ke maqbool bande hain aur un ke mazaaraat rahmat-e-Ilaahi utarne ke maqamaat hain. Lekin aaj ke zamaane mein Auliya-e-Kiraam aur un ke mazaaraat ke baare mein intehaai ghulu kiya jaata hai. Baaz log un ki jaaiz ta'zeem ko najaaiz aur haraam kehte hain aur un ke mazaaraat par haaziri ko shirk aur but-parasti kehte hain. Doosri taraf baaz naadaan log un ki ta'zeem mein shar'i hadd paar kar jaate hain aur mazaaraat par aise kaam karte hain jo Shariat mein najaaiz aur haraam hain.

Bani Israeel mein se kufr karne walon par Daawood aur Isa bin Maryam ki zabaan par se laanat ki gayi. Ye laanat is wajah se thi ke unhone naafarmaani ki aur woh sar-kashi karte rehte the.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {لُعِنَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا: Kufr karne walon par laanat ki gayi.} Ailah ke rehne walon ko haftay ke din shikaar karna mana tha. Jab unhone is hukm ki mukhaalifat ki aur shikaar karne se baaz na aaye to Hazrat Daawood عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne un par laanat ki aur un ke khilaaf dua farmayi. Chunanche un sab ko bandar aur khinzeer ki shakl mein masakh kar diya gaya. Surah-e-A'raaf mein is qisse ki tafseel maujood hai. Aur Ashaab-e-Maa'idah ne jab naazil kiye hue dastarkhwaan ki nematein khaane ke baad mana kiye jaane ke bawajood unhein zakhira kiya aur imaan na laaye to Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne un ke khilaaf dua farmayi. Woh khinzeer aur bandar ban gaye. Us waqt un ki tadaad paanch hazaar thi. (Jamal, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 78, 2/260-261)

Is liye har saaliheen ki jamaat pehle walon ke lihaaz se khalaf aur baad walon ke lihaaz se salaf hoti hai.” Hadees-e-Paak ki sharh karte hue farmate hain: “Yani Musalmanon mein baaz jaahil ulama ki shakl mein zahir ho kar Quran aur hadees ki ghalat ta'weelein aur ma'nawi tehreefein karenge. Woh maqbool jamaat in sab cheezon ko door karegi. Alhamdulillah! Aaj tak aisa ho raha hai aur aainda bhi hoga. Dekho, ulama-e-deen ki sarparasti na hukoomat karti hai na qaum, lekin phir bhi ye jamaat paida ho rahi hai aur deen ki khidmat barabar kar rahi hai.” (Miraat-ul-Manaajih, Kitaab-ul-Ilm, al-fasl-us-saani, 1/201, tehat-ul-hadees: 230)

blocks.text: Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai, Huzoor Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen ﷺ ne irshad farmaya: “Jo Momin Quran padhta hai us ki misaal turanj ki si hai ke khushboo bhi achhi hai aur zaiqa bhi achha hai. Jo Momin Quran nahin padhta, woh khajoor ki tarah hai ke us mein khushboo nahin magar zaiqa meetha hai. Jo munaafiq Quran padhta hai, woh phool ki tarah hai ke us mein khushboo hai magar zaiqa kadwa hai. Aur jo munaafiq Quran nahin padhta, woh andarain ki tarah hai ke us mein khushboo bhi nahin aur zaiqa bhi kadwa hai.” (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-At'imah, Baab zikr-ut-ta'aam, 3/535, hadees: 5427)

Ae iman walo! Un paak cheezon ko haraam na thehrao jo Allah ne tumhare liye halal ki hain aur hadd se na badho. Beshak Allah hadd se badhne walon ko pasand nahin karta.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {لَا تُحَرِّمُوْا طَیِّبٰتِ: Paak cheezon ko haraam na thehrao.} Is aayat ke nuzool ka sabab yeh hai ke Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ki ek jamaat Huzoor Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen ﷺ ka waaz sun kar ek din Hazrat Usman bin Maz'un رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke ghar jama hui. Unhone aapas mein duniya se kinara karne ka ahad kiya. Unka faisla hua ke woh taat pehnenge, hamesha din mein roza rakhenge, saari raat ibaadat mein guzaarenge, bistar par nahin letenge, gosht aur charbi nahin khaayenge, aurton se alag rahenge aur khushboo nahin lagaayenge. Is par yeh aayat-e-kareema naazil hui aur unhein is irade se rok diya gaya. (Tafseer Qurtubi, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 87, 3/156, al-juz-us-saadis)

blocks.text: Ahadees-e-mubarakah mein is tarah ke bahut se waaqi'aat milte hain jin mein Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ne aitidaal ka hukm diya aur ibaadat mein khud ko bahut zyada takleef dene se mana farmaya. Is silsile mein 3 ahadees mulahiza hon:

runs.text: Ahadees-e-mubarakah mein is tarah ke bahut se waaqi'aat milte hain jin mein Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ne aitidaal ka hukm diya aur ibaadat mein khud ko bahut zyada takleef dene se mana farmaya. Is silsile mein 3 ahadees mulahiza hon:

blocks.text: (1) Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aishah Siddiqah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا farmati hain: Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ un ke paas tashreef farma the. Us waqt Hazrat Haula bint-e-Tuwayt رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا wahan se guzrin. Hazrat Aishah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ne Tajdar-e-Risalat ﷺ se arz ki: “Yeh Haula bint-e-Tuwayt hain. Log kehte hain ke yeh raat bhar nahin soti.” Rasoolullah ﷺ ne irshad farmaya: “Raat bhar nahin soti! Itna amal kiya karo jitna aasani se kar sako. Khuda ki qasam! Allah Ta'ala nahin uktaayega, lekin tum ukta jaoge.” (Muslim, Kitaab Salaat-il-Musaafireen wa Qasruha, Baab fazeelat-ul-amal-id-daaim min qiyaam-il-lail wagherah, s. 394, hadees: 220 (785))

blocks.text: (2) Hazrat Anas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain ke Rahmat-e-Aalam ﷺ masjid mein tashreef laaye. Masjid ke do sutoon ke darmiyan ek rassi bandhi hui thi. Aap ﷺ ne poocha: “Yeh kya hai?” Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ne arz ki: “Yeh Hazrat Zainab رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہا ki rassi hai. Woh namaz padhti hain aur jab un par thakan ya susti hoti hai to is rassi ko pakad leti hain.” Huzoor Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen ﷺ ne irshad farmaya: “Is rassi ko khol do. Tum mein se har shakhs us waqt tak namaz padhe jab tak aasani se padh sake. Jab thakan ya susti ho to baith jaaye.” (Muslim, Kitaab Salaat-il-Musaafireen wa Qasruha, Baab fazeelat-ul-amal-id-daaim min qiyaam-il-lail wagherah, s. 394, hadees: 219 (784))

blocks.text: (3) Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُما farmate hain: “Main hamesha roze rakhta tha aur har raat Quran-e-Majeed ki tilaawat karta tha. Nabi-e-Kareem ﷺ ke saamne mera zikr hua to Aap ﷺ ne mujhe bulaya aur irshad farmaya: ‘Mujhe khabar mili hai ke tum hamesha roze rakhte ho aur har raat Quran-e-Majeed padhte ho?’ Main ne arz ki: ‘Ji haan, Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ! Main ne is ibaadat se sirf bhalaai ka irada kiya hai.’ Sarkar-e-Risalat ﷺ ne farmaya: ‘Tumhare liye kaafi hai ke mahine mein sirf 3 din roze rakh liya karo.’ Main ne arz ki: ‘Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ! Main is se zyada ki taaqat rakhta hoon.’ Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: ‘Tumhari biwi ka tum par haq hai, tumhare mehmaan ka tum par haq hai aur tumhare jism ka tum par haq hai. Allah Ta'ala ke Nabi Hazrat Dawood عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام ke roze rakho, kyunki woh logon mein sab se zyada ibaadat-guzar the.’ Main ne poocha: ‘Ya Allah Ta'ala ke pyaare Nabi! Hazrat Dawood عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام ke roze kis tarah the?’ Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: ‘Woh ek din roza rakhte aur ek din iftaar karte the.’ Phir farmaya: ‘Har mahine ek Quran-e-Pak khatm kiya karo.’ Main ne arz ki: ‘Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ! Main is se zyada ki taaqat rakhta hoon.’ Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: ‘Phir 20 din mein ek Quran-e-Pak khatm kar lo.’ Main ne arz ki: ‘Main is se zyada ki taaqat rakhta hoon.’ Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: ‘Phir 10 din mein ek Quran-e-Pak khatm kar lo.’ Main ne arz ki: ‘Main is se zyada ki taaqat rakhta hoon.’ Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: ‘Phir 7 din mein Quran-e-Pak khatm kar lo aur is se zyada apne aap ko mashakkat mein na daalo, kyunki tumhari biwi ka bhi tum par haq hai, tumhare mehmaan ka bhi tum par haq hai aur tumhare jism ka bhi tum par haq hai.’” (Muslim, Kitaab-us-Siyaam, Baab-un-nahi an saum-id-dahr, s. 585, hadees: 182 (1159))

blocks.text: Halal cheezon ko chhorne ka shar'i hukm

runs.text: Halal cheezon ko chhorne ka shar'i hukm

blocks.text: Halal cheezon ko chhorna jaiz hota hai, kyunki unhein karna farz ya wajib nahin hota. Lekin jis tarah haraam samajh kar haraam cheez ko chhoda jaata hai, usi tarah halal cheez ko chhorne ki ijaazat nahin. Kisi halal cheez ke baare mein mubalaghe ke taur par yeh kehna bhi jaiz nahin ke “ham ne ise apne upar haraam kar liya hai.” Sufiya-e-Kiraam رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِم se bahut si cheezein chhorne ke waaqi'aat milte hain. Yeh ilaaj ke taur par hota hai. Jaise beemaar aadmi bahut si ghizaon ko halal samajhne ke bawajood sehat ke liye parhez karta hai aur kai cheezein chhor deta hai, isi tarah Sufiya-e-Kiraam رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِم nafs ke ilaaj ke liye baaz halal cheezein chhor dete hain. Lekin yeh zaroori hai ke halal cheezon ke saath haraam jaisa sulook na kiya jaaye.

blocks.text: Arabic: لَا یُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِیْۤ اَیْمَانِكُمْ وَ لٰـكِنْ یُّؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا عَقَّدْتُّمُ الْاَیْمَانَۚ-فَكَفَّارَتُهٗۤ اِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسٰكِیْنَ مِنْ اَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُوْنَ اَهْلِیْكُمْ اَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ اَوْ تَحْرِیْرُ رَقَبَةٍؕ-فَمَنْ لَّمْ یَجِدْ فَصِیَامُ ثَلٰثَةِ اَیَّامٍؕ-ذٰلِكَ كَفَّارَةُ اَیْمَانِكُمْ اِذَا حَلَفْتُمْؕ-وَ احْفَظُوْۤا اَیْمَانَكُمْؕ-كَذٰلِكَ یُبَیِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ(89)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Allah tumhein tumhari bekaar qasmon par nahin pakdega, lekin un qasmon par pakdega jinhein tum mazboot kar lo. To aisi qasam ka kaffarah 10 miskeenon ko us ausat darje ka khaana khilana hai jo tum apne ghar walon ko khilate ho, ya unhein kapde dena hai, ya ek ghulaam azaad karna hai. Phir jo yeh na paaye to 3 din ke roze rakhe. Yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffarah hai jab tum qasam khao aur apni qasmon ki hifazat karo. Allah isi tarah tumhare liye apni aayaat bayan karta hai taake tum shukr ada karo.

Sharaab noshi ki wajah se hone wali zehni aur doosri beemariyon ka ilaaj, nashe ki haalat mein driving se hone wale haadse, police ki giraftariyan, sharaabiyon ki aulaad ke liye parwarish-gaahen aur aspataal, sharaab se muta'alliq jurm par adaalaton ki masroofiyat aur sharaabiyon ke liye qaid-khaane, in sab par hone wale akhrajaat sharaab ki aamdani se kahin zyada hain. Quran-o-Hadees mein mukhtalif andaaz se Musalmanon ko is shaitani amal se roka gaya hai. Lekin afsos ke aaj Musalmanon ka ek hissa is khabees amal mein mubtala nazar aata hai. Woh duniya aur aakhirat ke liye mufeed kaam chhor kar apna din-raat isi mein laga rahe hain. blocks.text: Arabic: اِنَّمَا یُرِیْدُ الشَّیْطٰنُ اَنْ یُّوْقِعَ بَیْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَ الْبَغْضَآءَ فِی الْخَمْرِ وَ الْمَیْسِرِ وَ یَصُدَّكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ وَ عَنِ الصَّلٰوةِۚ-فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّنْتَهُوْنَ(91)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Shaitan to yahi chahta hai ke sharaab aur jue ke zariye tumhare darmiyan dushmani aur bughz-o-keena daal de aur tumhein Allah ki yaad se aur namaz se rok de, to kya tum baaz aate ho?

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Shaitan to yahi chahta hai ke sharaab aur jue ke zariye tumhare darmiyan dushmani aur bughz-o-keena daal de aur tumhein Allah ki yaad se aur namaz se rok de, to kya tum baaz aate ho?

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {اِنَّمَا یُرِیْدُ الشَّیْطٰنُ: Beshak Shaitan to chahta hai.} Is aayat mein sharaab aur jue ke nataij aur un ke azaab ka bayan hai. Sharaab peene aur jua khelne ka dunyawi nuqsaan yeh hai ke in se logon ke darmiyan bughz aur dushmani paida hoti hai. In ka deeni nuqsaan yeh hai ke jo shakhs in buraaiyon mein mubtala ho jaata hai, woh Allah ke zikr aur namaz ke auqaat ki pabandi se mehroom ho jaata hai. Is se maloom hua ke jo cheez Allah ke zikr aur namaz se roke, woh buri hai aur use chhor dena chahiye. Isi liye Jumu'ah ki azaan ke baad tijaarat haraam hai. [1]

blocks.text: Isi tarah jo Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم doosre shehron mein maujood the aur unhein abhi yeh maloom nahin hua tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne sharaab haraam farma di hai, agar woh is be-ilmi ke dauran sharaab pi lete to un ke baare mein kya hukm hai? Un ke haq mein yeh aayat naazil hui aur bataya gaya ke hurmat ka hukm naazil hone se pehle jin nek aur iman walon ne kuchh khaaya ya piya, woh gunahgaar nahin. Isi tarah jin logon ko hurmat ka hukm naazil hone ka ilm nahin, un par hukm ki maloomat hone se pehle sharaab pee lene ki surat mein koi gunah nahin.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Ae iman walo! Haalat-e-ihram mein shikaar ko qatl na karo. Aur tum mein jo use qasdan qatl kare to us ka badla yeh hai ke maweshiyon mein se isi tarah ka woh jaanwar de jis ke shikaar ki misl hone ka tum mein se do mo'tabar aadmi faisla karein. Yeh Ka'bah ko pahunchti hui qurbani ho, ya chand miskeenon ka khaana kaffare mein de, ya us ke barabar roze, taake woh apne kaam ka wabaal chakhe. Allah ne pehle jo kuchh guzra use maaf farma diya aur jo dobara karega to Allah us se inteqaam lega. Aur Allah Ghaalib hai, badla lene wala hai.

Khaufzada log wahan panaah lete hain, kamzor logon ko wahan aman milta hai, tajir wahan nafa kamaate hain aur Hajj-o-Umrah karne wale wahan haazir ho kar manasik ada karte hain. Is liye yeh Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki badi nemat hai.

blocks.text: Isi tarah Zul-Hijjah ka mahina, jis mein Hajj ada kiya jaata hai, aur Hady ke jaanwar bhi logon ke deeni aur dunyawi kaam se jude hue hain. Un ke gosht se ghareeb aur ameer sab faida uthate hain aur un ke zariye Islam ka ek rukn ada hota hai.

blocks.text: Is aayat aur is ki tafseer mein zikr ki gayi riwayaat se chaar aham baatein maloom hoti hain:

runs.text: Is aayat aur is ki tafseer mein zikr ki gayi riwayaat se chaar aham baatein maloom hoti hain:

blocks.text: 1. Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ka ilm-e-ghaib: In riwayaat se maloom hua ke Tajdar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ghaib ka ilm rakhte hain, kyunki kisi ka haqeeqi baap kaun hai, is ka ta'alluq ghaib se hai. Yeh bhi maloom hua ke Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko kulli ilm ata farmaya gaya. Warna Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ yeh na farmate ke jo chaho poochho, balki farmate ke falan falan shobay ke baare mein poochho ya sirf shariat ke muta'alliq sawaal karo. Sarwar-e-Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ka baghair kisi qaid ke farmana ke jo poochhna hai poochho, aur poochhne walon ka har qisam ki baat pooch lena, is baat ki daleel hai ke Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ sab kuch jaante hain. Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ka bhi yahi aqeedah tha.

blocks.text: Note: Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke ilm-e-ghaib ke muta'alliq Fatawa Razawiyyah ki 29veen jild mein maujood A'la Hazrat رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ki yeh kitaabein padhna nihayat mufeed hai: (1) Khaalis-ul-I'tiqaad: ilm-e-ghaib se muta'alliq 120 dalaail par mushtamil azeem kitaab. Is mein Mustafa Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko Daafi-ul-Bala, yani balaayein door karne wala kehne walon ke liye inaamaat bayan kiye gaye hain.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {قَدْ سَاَلَهَا قَوْمٌ مِّنْ قَبْلِكُمْ: Beshak tum se pehle ek qaum ne in ashya ke baare mein sawaal kiya tha.} Musalmanon ko ek hukm dene ke baad pehli ummaton ke waqiaat se samjhaya gaya ke tum se pehle ki qaumon ne bhi apne Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام se be-zaroorat sawaalaat kiye. Jab Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne ahkaam bayaan farma diye to woh un par amal na kar sake. Is liye tum sawaalaat karne se bacho, kyunki agar tumhare har sawaal ka jawaab de diya gaya to mumkin hai ke kisi sawaal ka jawaab tumhein bura lage.

blocks.text: 1. Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwayat hai ke Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “Musalmanon mein sab se bada mujrim woh hai jis ne aisi cheez ke baare mein sawaal kiya jo haraam nahin ki gayi thi, lekin us ke sawaal karne ki wajah se haraam kar di gayi.” (Bukhari, Kitaab-ul-I'tisaam bil-Kitaab was-Sunnah, Baab Ma Yukrah min Kasrat-is-Su'aal, 4/502, hadees: 7289)

blocks.text: Yeh rasmein zamana-e-Jahiliyyat se Islam ke ibtidaai daur tak chali aa rahi thin. Is aayat mein inhein baatil qarar diya gaya aur farmaya gaya ke yeh Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ne muqarrar nahin kiya, balki kaafir Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ par jhoot baandhte hain. Allah Ta'ala ne in jaanwaron ko haraam nahin kiya, is liye in ki hurmat Allah ki taraf mansub karna ghalat hai. runs.text: Jhooti qasam aur jhooti gawahi ki mazammat

blocks.text: Aaj logon ki haalat itni kharab ho chuki hai ke un ke nazdeek jhooti qasam khaana, jhooti gawahi dena, jhoote muqadme mein phansa kar apne Musalman bhai ki izzat barbaad karna, use lohe ki salakhon ke peeche majboori ki zindagi guzaarne par majboor karna aur apne Musalman bhai ka na-haq maal kha jaana goya jurm hi nahin. Is duniya ki fani zindagi ko aakhri manzil samajh lena aqalmandi nahin, balki nadani aur bewakoofi ki inteha hai. Unhein chahiye ke in Qurani aayaat aur in ahadees ko ghaur se parh kar ibrat haasil karein.

blocks.text: Arabic: اِذْ قَالَ اللّٰهُ یٰعِیْسَى ابْنَ مَرْیَمَ اذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِیْ عَلَیْكَ وَ عَلٰى وَ الِدَتِكَۘ-اِذْ اَیَّدْتُّكَ بِرُوْحِ الْقُدُسِ- تُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِی الْمَهْدِ وَ كَهْلًاۚ-وَ اِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ الْحِكْمَةَ وَ التَّوْرٰىةَ وَ الْاِنْجِیْلَۚ-وَ اِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ الطِّیْنِ كَهَیْــٴَـةِ الطَّیْرِ بِاِذْنِیْ فَتَنْفُخُ فِیْهَا فَتَكُوْنُ طَیْرًۢا بِاِذْنِیْ وَ تُبْرِئُ الْاَ   كْمَهَ وَ الْاَبْرَصَ بِاِذْنِیْۚ-وَ اِذْ تُخْرِ جُ الْمَوْتٰى بِاِذْنِیْۚ-وَ اِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ عَنْكَ اِذْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ فَقَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْهُمْ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌ(110)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Jab Allah farmayega: Ae Maryam ke bete Isa! Apne upar aur apni walidah par mera woh ehsan yaad kar, jab main ne paak rooh se teri madad ki. Tu gahware mein aur badi umar mein logon se baatein karta tha aur jab main ne tujhe Kitaab aur hikmat aur Taurat aur Injeel sikhaayi aur jab tu mere hukm se mitti se parinde jaisi soorat bana kar us mein phoonk maarta tha to woh mere hukm se parinda ban jaati aur tu mere hukm se paidaishi naabina aur safed daag ke mareez ko shifa deta tha aur jab tu mere hukm se murdon ko zinda karke nikaalta aur jab main ne Bani Israeel ko tum se rok diya. Jab tu un ke paas roshan nishaniyan le kar aaya to un mein se kaafiron ne kaha: Yeh to khula jadoo hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne farmaya: Agar iman rakhte ho to Allah Ta'ala se daro aur taqwa ikhtiyar karo, taake tumhara maqsad poora ho jaaye. Baaz mufassireen ne kaha ke is ka ma'na yeh hai: Sab ummaton se alag aur nirala sawal karne mein Allah Ta'ala se daro. Ya is ka ma'na yeh hai ke jab tum Allah Ta'ala ki kamil qudrat par iman rakhte ho to aise sawal na karo jin se shak ya taraddud ka guman ho sakta ho. blocks.text: Hawariyon ke is jawab se saaf ho gaya ke unhone Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat mein shak ki wajah se pehle sawal nahin kiya tha, balki un ka maqsad kuch aur tha. Un ki is darkhwast par Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne unhein tees roze rakhne ka hukm diya aur farmaya: Jab tum in rozon se farigh ho jaoge to Allah Ta'ala se jo dua karoge woh qabool hogi. runs.text: Nuzool-e-Rahmat ke din ko Eid banana صالحین ka tareeqa hai

blocks.text: Is aayat se maloom hua ke jis din Allah Ta'ala ki khaas rahmat naazil ho, us din ko Eid banana, khushiyan manana, ibadatein karna aur Allah Ta'ala ka shukr ada karna صالحین ka tareeqa hai. Beshak Tajdaar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki tashreef-aawari Allah Ta'ala ki sab se badi ni'mat aur azeem tareen rahmat hai. Is liye Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki wiladat-e-mubarak ke din Eid manana, Milad Shareef parh kar Allah Ta'ala ka shukr ada karna aur khushi ka izhar karna pasandeedah, achha aur Allah Ta'ala ke maqbool bandon ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا farmate hain: Jab Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ Madinah Munawwarah tashreef laaye to dekha ke Yahoodi Ashura ke din roza rakhte hain. Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne poocha: “Yeh kya hai?” Yahoodiyon ne arz ki: Yeh achha din hai. Is din Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israeel ko un ke dushman se nijaat di thi, is liye Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne is din roza rakha. Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: “Hazrat Musa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام se mera ta'alluq tum se zyada hai.” Chunanche Huzoor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Ashura ka roza rakha aur is din roza rakhne ka hukm diya. (Bukhari, Kitaab-us-Saum, Baab: Siyaam-e-Yaum-e-Ashura, 1/656, hadees: 2004)

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {قَالَ اللّٰهُ: Allah ne farmaya.} Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki darkhwast ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: Main woh dastarkhwan tum par utaarta hoon. Lekin is ke naazil hone ke baad tum mein se jo kufr karega, main use aisa azaab dunga jo saare jahan mein kisi ko nahin dunga. Chunanche aasman se dastarkhwan naazil hua. Is ke baad un mein se jin logon ne kufr kiya, un ki sooratein masakh karke khinzeer bana di gayin aur woh teen din mein sab halaak ho gaye. (Tafseer Baghawi, Al-Maidah, tehat-ul-aayat: 115, 2/66)

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {اِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ: Agar Tu unhein azaab de.} Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ko maloom hoga ke un ki qaum mein kuch log kufr par jamay rahe aur kuch log iman se musharraf hue. Is liye woh bargah-e-Ilahi mein arz karenge: “Un mein se jo log kufr par qaa'im rahe, agar Tu unhein azaab de to yeh bilkul haq aur adl o insaaf hai, kyunke unhone hujjat poori ho jaane ke baad kufr ikhtiyar kiya. Aur jo iman laaye, agar Tu unhein bakhsh de to yeh tera fazl o karam hai aur tera har kaam hikmat par mabni hai.”

blocks.text: Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne bhi is aayat ko parh kar Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki bargah mein apni ummat ke liye dua ki. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا farmate hain: “Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Quran-e-Pak mein Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka yeh qawl parha: ‘رَبِّ اِنَّهُنَّ اَضْلَلْنَ كَثِیْرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِۚ-فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِیْ فَاِنَّهٗ مِنِّیْ۔۔۔الآیہ’ Ae mere Rab! In buton ne bahut se logon ko gumrah kar diya hai. Jo meri pairwi karega woh mere raaste par hai.”

blocks.text: Phir Huzoor Pur-Noor صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne Hazrat Isa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ka yeh qawl parha: “اِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَۚ-وَ اِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَاِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُ” Ae Allah! Agar Tu unhein azaab de to yeh tere bande hain aur agar Tu unhein bakhsh de to Tu ghalib, hikmat wala hai.

blocks.text: Phir Nabi-e-Rahmat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne dua ke liye apne dono haath utha diye aur rote hue arz karne lage: “Ae Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ! Meri ummat, meri ummat.” Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: “Ae Jibraeel! Muhammad ke paas jao aur un se poochho, halanke Allah Ta'ala khoob jaanta hai, ke un par itna rona kyun taari hai.” Hazrat Jibraeel عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat mein haazir hue aur pooch kar Allah Ta'ala ki bargah mein jawab arz kar diya. Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام se farmaya: “Ae Jibraeel! Muhammad ke paas jao aur un se keh do ke tumhari ummat ki maghfirat ke maamle mein hum tumhein raazi kar denge aur tumhein ranjida nahin karenge.” (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Iman, Baab: Dua-un-Nabi ﷺ li-ummatihi, safha 130, hadees: 346 (202))

blocks.text: {یَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَ جَهْرَكُمْ: Woh tumhari har posheeda aur zaahir baat jaanta hai.} Imam Ghazali رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Allah Ta'ala tamam maloomaat ka ilm rakhta hai. Zameen ki teh se aasmanon ki bulandi tak jo kuchh hota hai, sab ka ihata farmane wala hai. Us ke ilm se zameen aur aasman ka koi zarra bhi bahar nahin ja sakta. Balki woh sakht andheri raat mein saaf chattaan par chalne wali siyah cheenti ke chalne ki aawaaz ko bhi jaanta hai. Woh hawa mein ek zarre ki harkat bhi jaanta hai. Woh posheeda umoor, dilon ke waswason, khayalon aur chhupi hui baaton ka ilm rakhta hai. Us ka ilm qadeem aur azali hai. Woh hamesha se isi ilm ke saath moosuf raha hai. Us ka ilm naya nahin aur na hi us ki zaat mein aane ki wajah se haasil hua hai.” (Ihya Ulum-id-Deen, Kitaab Qawa'id-ul-Aqaid, Al-Fasl-ul-Awwal fi tarjimati aqeedati Ahl-is-Sunnat fi kalimat-ish-Shahadatain, 1/126)

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْحَقِّ: To beshak unhone haq ko jhutlaya.} Yahan haq se ya to Quran-e-Majeed ki aayaat murad hain, ya Tajdar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ aur Aap ﷺ ke mu'jizaat murad hain. Jab bhi Quran ki aayaat ya Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ke mu'jizaat kafir-e-Makkah ke saamne aate, ya Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ unhein kuchh samjhate, to woh Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko jhutlate. Is par farmaya gaya ke anqareeb un ke paas us cheez ki khabrein aane wali hain jis ka woh mazaaq udaate the. Unhein maloom ho jaayega ke woh kitni azeem khabar thi aur us ka mazaaq udaane ka anjaam kitna khaufnaak hai.
