runs.text: Kafiro ki dunyawi taraqqi Allah Ta'ala ki baargaah mein maqbooliyat ki daleel nahin

blocks.text: Is aayat se maloom hua ke dunyawi khushhaali, maal-o-daulat aur sahuliyato ki kasrat Allah Ta'ala ki raza ki alamat nahin. Warna Qaroon Allah Ta'ala ki baargaah mein bahut maqbool hota. Un logo ko is se sabaq seekhna chahiye jo Musalmano ke muqable mein kafiro ki dunyawi taraqqi, saainsi maharat, bahut si sahuliyat, kasrat se ijaad aur maal-o-daulat ki farawani dekh kar unhein Allah Ta'ala ki baargaah mein maqbool aur Musalmano ko mardood samajhte hain. Woh akhlaaq aur kirdar mein Musalmano ko kafiro ki naqal karne ka mashwara dete hain.

blocks.text: Is aayat mein bataya gaya ke yeh sab bahane hain. Agar kaghaz par likhi hui kitaab bhi utaar di jaati aur woh use apne haatho se chhoo kar aur jaanch kar dekh lete, tab bhi kehte ke un ki nazarbandi kar di gayi hai. Kitaab utarti hui nazar to aayi thi lekin haqeeqat mein kuchh bhi nahin tha. Jis tarah unhone Shaqq-ul-Qamar, yani chaand ke do tukde hone ke mu'jize ko jaadu kaha aur use dekh kar bhi imaan na laaye, isi tarah is par bhi imaan na laate. Jo log zid ki wajah se inkaar karte hain woh aayaat aur mu'jizaat se faayda nahin utha sakte.

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke kafiro ne aise farishte ke utarne ka mutalaba kiya tha jo unhein bhi nazar aaye. Isi mutalabe ka radd kiya gaya hai. Warna Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ par ek nahin, bahut se farishte naazil hote the aur kai martaba insani shakal mein haazir hote the. Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم bhi unhein dekhte the. Kafiro ka mutalaba yeh tha ke farishta apni asli shakal mein aaye aur woh use usi shakal mein dekhein.

blocks.text: Yahan ek sawal hai: Kafiro ne bahut si nishaniyan maangi jo poori bhi hui, jaise chaand ke do tukde hona, lekin is ke baad woh imaan na laaye. Aisi surat mein aayat ke bayan kiye hue hukm ke mutabiq sab ko halaak kar dena chahiye tha, lekin aisa nahin hua. Is ka jawab yeh hai ke nabuwat par daleel banne wali nishani do tarah ki hoti hai: (1) aam nishani, (2) khaas nishani.

blocks.text: Kafiro-Quraish ke paanch sardaar Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko bahut takleef dete aur Aap صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ka mazaaq udaaya karte the: (1) Aas bin Waa'il Sahmi, (2) Aswad bin Muttalib, (3) Aswad bin Abd Yaghus, (4) Haris bin Qais aur in sab ka afsar (5) Waleed bin Mughirah Makhzoomi.

Ek din Tajdar-e-Risalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ Masjid-e-Haraam mein tashreef farma the ke yeh paancho aaye. blocks.text: Isi haal mein Hazrat Jibreel-e-Ameen عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام Huzoor-e-Anwar صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki khidmat mein aaye. Unhone Waleed bin Mughirah ki pindli ki taraf, Aas ke qadmo ki taraf, Aswad bin Muttalib ki aankho ki taraf, Aswad bin Abd Yaghus ke pait ki taraf aur Haris bin Qais ke sar ki taraf ishara karke kaha: Main in ka shar door karunga.

blocks.text: Chand hi arse mein yeh sab halaak ho gaye. Waleed bin Mughirah teer bechne wale ki dukaan ke paas se guzra to us ke tehband mein ek teer ki nok chubh gayi. Takabbur ki wajah se us ne use nikaalne ke liye sar neecha na kiya. Is se us ki pindli mein zakhm hua aur isi mein mar gaya. Aas bin Waa'il ke paao mein kaanta laga jo use nazar na aaya. Us ka paao sooj gaya aur woh bhi mar gaya.

blocks.text: Aswad bin Muttalib ki aankho mein aisa dard hua ke woh deewar mein sar maarta tha aur isi haal mein mar gaya. Woh kehta hua mara: Mujhe Muhammad صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne qatl kiya. Aswad bin Abd Yaghus ko istisqa ki beemari lag gayi. Kalbi ki riwayat mein hai ke use lu lag gayi aur us ka munh itna kaala ho gaya ke ghar walo ne use pehchana nahin aur ghar se nikaal diya. Tum farma do: Zameen mein sair karo, phir dekho ke jhutlane walo ka kaisa anjaam hua?

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {قُلْ سِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ: Tum farma do: Zameen mein sair karo.} Yahan Sarkar-e-Do-Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ko farmaya gaya hai ke ae Habeeb! صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ azaab ka mazaaq udaane walo se farma dein ke jao aur zameen mein sair karke dekho ke jhutlane walo ka kaisa anjaam hua aur unhone kufr-o-takzeeb ka kya phal paaya? Yahan zameen se murad woh jagah hai jahan pichhli qaumo par azaab aaya aur ab tak wahan un ujri hui bastiyo ke asaar maujood hain. Sair ka yeh hukm targheeb ke liye hai, wajib hone ke liye nahin.

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ka khauf aur us ki muhabbat paida karne ka zariya

runs.text: Allah Ta'ala ka khauf aur us ki muhabbat paida karne ka zariya

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke Allah Ta'ala ka khauf paida karne ke liye azaab wali jagah ja kar dekhna behtar hai, kyunki khabar ke muqable mein aankho se dekhi hui cheez ka asar zyada hota hai. Jis tarah azaab ki jagah dekhne se khauf paida hota hai, isi tarah rahmat ki jagah dekhne se ibaadat ki ragbat aur Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki muhabbat paida hoti hai. Is liye Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki rahmat dekhne ke liye buzurgo ke aastane, jahan Allah Ta'ala ki rahmatein barasti hain, safar karke dekhna bhi behtar hai, taake Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki ita'at ka shauq paida ho.

blocks.text: Safar karke mazaraat-e-Auliya par jaana jaaiz hai

runs.text: Safar karke mazaraat-e-Auliya par jaana jaaiz hai

blocks.text: Is aayat se yeh bhi maloom hua ke imaani quwwat haasil karne ke liye safar karna ba'is-e-rahmat hai. Is aayat se un logo ka bhi radd hota hai jo sirf teen masjido ke ilawa kisi aur taraf safar ko mutlaqan najaaiz kehte hain aur is ki daleel mein yeh hadees pesh karte hain: Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se marwi hai, Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne irshad farmaya: “In teen masjido ke siwa kisi ki taraf kaajawe na bandhe jaayen: (1) Masjid-e-Haraam. (2) Rasoolullah صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ki masjid. (3) Masjid-e-Aqsa.” (Bukhari, Kitaab Fazl-us-Salaat fi Masjid-e-Makkah wal-Madinah, Baab Masjid Bait-ul-Maqdis, 1/403, hadees: 1197)

blocks.text: Is hadees ka matlab yeh hai ke in masjido ke ilawa kisi aur masjid ki taraf is liye safar karke jaana ke wahan namaaz ka sawab zyada hai, mana hai, kyunki in ke ilawa sab masjido mein namaaz padhne ka sawab barabar hai. Agar is hadees ka matlab yeh liya jaaye ke in teen masjido ke ilawa kisi aur masjid ki taraf safar karna haraam hai ya in teen masjido ke ilawa kahin aur safar karna jaaiz nahin, to yeh hadees Quran-e-Majeed ki is aayat aur doosri ahadees ke bhi khilaaf hogi. Is matlab ke mutabiq to kisi maqsad ke liye koi safar jaaiz nahin rahega, jaise jihaad, talab-e-ilm, tableegh-e-deen, tijaarat aur sair waghera ke liye safar bhi jaaiz na hoga, aur yeh ummat ke ijma ke khilaaf hai. Is se saabit hua ke safar karke Allah Ta'ala ke mehboob bando ke mazaraat par jaana mana aur haraam nahin, balki jaaiz aur mustahsan hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tum farmao kis ka hai jo kuchh aasmano aur zameen mein hai? Farma do: Allah hi ka hai. Us ne apne zimme-e-karam par rahmat likh li hai. Beshak woh zaroor tumhein Qiyamat ke din jama karega jis mein kuchh shak nahin. Woh jinhone apni jaano ko nuqsan mein daala hua hai to woh imaan nahin laate.

Isi tarah kafiro ko mohlat dena aur unhein saza dene mein jaldi na farmana bhi rahmat mein daakhil hai, kyunki is se unhein tauba aur rujoo ka mauqa milta hai. (Jamal, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 12, 2/322-323)

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat dekh kar gunaho par bebaak nahin hona chahiye

runs.text: Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat dekh kar gunaho par bebaak nahin hona chahiye

blocks.text: Is baat mein koi shak nahin ke Allah Ta'ala sab se zyada Raheem aur sab se badh kar Kareem hai. Us ke rahm-o-karam ke khazano ki koi inteha nahin. Woh chahe to umr bhar ke gunahgaar ko ek pal mein bakhsh de aur us ki saari khataein maaf farma de. Lekin us ki wasee rahmat ko dekh kar aisa nahin hona chahiye ke banda gunaho par bebaak ho jaaye aur us ki na-farmaani ki parwah na kare.

Phir is baat par bharosa karke aamaal se ghaafil ho jaate hain. Un ka khayal hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki ne'mat wasee aur rahmat-o-karam aam hai. Us ki rahmat ke samandar ke muqable mein bando ke gunaho ki kya haisiyat hai? Hum tauheed ko maanne wale aur momin hain aur imaan ke zariye us ki rahmat ke umeedwaar hain.”

blocks.text: Baaz auqaat un ke paas is umeed ki daleel yeh hoti hai ke hamare baap-dada nek log the aur un ka darja buland tha. Kai log apne nasab ki wajah se dhoke ka shikaar hote hain. Haalanke woh khauf-e-Khuda, taqwa aur parhezgaari ke maamle mein apne baap-dada ki seerat ke khilaaf chalte hain. Goya un ka gumaan yeh hai ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek apne baap-dada se bhi zyada mo'azzaz hain. Baap-dada intehaai darje ke taqwa ke bawajood khaufzada rehte the, jabke yeh log intehaai darje ke fisq-o-fujoor ke bawajood be-khauf hain. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki zaat par bahut bada dhoka hai.

blocks.text: Isi tarah Shaitaan buland nasab walo ke dilo mein yeh baat daalta hai ke jo kisi insaan se muhabbat karta hai woh us ki aulaad se bhi muhabbat karta hai. Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare baap-dada se muhabbat ki hai, is liye woh tum se bhi muhabbat karta hai. Is liye tumhein ibaadat karne ki zaroorat nahin. Yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ki zaat par dhoka hai, kyunki Allah Ta'ala farmabardaar ko pasand aur gunahgaar ko na-pasand farmata hai. Jis tarah gunahgaar bete ko bura samajhne ki wajah se us ke farmabardaar baap ko bura nahin samjha jaata, isi tarah farmabardaar baap ki ita'at ki wajah se us ke gunahgaar bete se muhabbat bhi nahin ki jaati. Agar muhabbat baap se bete ki taraf chali jaati to qareeb tha ke nafrat bhi phail jaati.

blocks.text: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke koi bojh uthaane wala doosre ka bojh nahin uthata. Jis shakhs ka yeh khayal ho ke woh apne baap ki parhezgaari ki wajah se najaat paa lega, woh us shakhs ki tarah hai jo yeh samjhe ke baap ke khaane se woh bhi sair ho jaayega, baap ke peene se beta bhi sairaab ho jaayega, baap ke seekhne se beta bhi aalim ban jaayega aur baap Ka'bah Shareef mein pahunch jaaye to us ke wahan pahunchne se yeh bhi wahan pahunch kar Ka'bah Shareef ko dekh lega. blocks.text: Koi Allah Ta'ala ki mashiyyat ke khilaaf kuchh nahin kar sakta. To Allah Ta'ala ke siwa koi ibaadat ka mustahiq kaise ho sakta hai? Yeh shirk ke radd mein dil par asar karne wali daleel hai.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tum farmao: Sab se badi gawaahi kis ki hai? Farma do ke mere aur tumhare darmiyan Allah gawaah hai aur meri taraf is Quran ki wahi ki gayi hai taa-ke main is ke zariye tumhein aur jin ko yeh pahunche unhein daraaun. Kya tum yeh gawaahi dete ho ke Allah ke saath doosre mabood bhi hain? Tum farmao ke main yeh gawaahi nahin deta. Tum farmao ke woh to ek hi mabood hai aur main un se bezaar hoon jinhein tum Allah ka shareek thehraate ho.

blocks.text: Is ki tasdeeq is riwaayat se bhi hoti hai ke Islam qabool karne ke baad Hazrat Umar Farooq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne yeh aayat Hazrat Abdullah bin Salaam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke saamne padh kar Huzoor ﷺ ko pehchanne ki surat poochhi. Unhone farmaya: "Main ne jaise hi Rasoolullah ﷺ ka deedar kiya, main ne Aap ﷺ ko pehchan liya. Balki main ne Aap ﷺ ko apne bete ke muqaable mein zyada jaldi pehchaan liya. Main is baat ki gawaahi de sakta hoon ke Rasoolullah ﷺ sachche Rasool hain, lekin auraton ne kya kiya, main nahin jaanta. Ho sakta hai unhone mere peechhe koi khayaanat ki ho aur yeh beta mera na ho, lekin Rasoolullah ﷺ ke sachche Rasool hone mein mujhe kisi qisam ka shak nahin ho sakta."

blocks.text: Is aayat mein bataya gaya ke phir jab un par woh cheez zaahir ho jaayegi jo woh chhupa rahe the, yani un ka kufr is tarah zaahir hoga ke un ke aaza-o-jawarih un ke kufr aur shirk ki gawaahi denge, to woh duniya mein wapas jaane ki tamanna karenge. Kafir agarche duniya mein lautaye jaane aur imaan laane ki tamanna zahir kar rahe honge, lekin un ki yeh tamanna sachchi nahin hogi. blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ قَالُوْا: Aur unhone kaha tha.} Yeh un kafiron ka qawl hai jo Qiyamat ke munkir the. Is ka waqia yeh tha ke jab Sarwar-e-Kaayenaat ﷺ ne kafiron ke saamne Qiyamat ke ahwaal, Aakhirat ki zindagi, imaan walon aur farmabardaron ke sawaab aur kafiron aur na-farmanon ke azaab ka zikr farmaya to kafir kehne lage: Zindagi to bas duniya ki zindagi hai. Jab hum marne ke baad is duniya se chale jaayenge to hamein dobara zinda nahin kiya jaayega. (Khazin, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 29, 2/11)

blocks.text: Kafiron ka aqeeda hi yeh tha ke zindagi sirf duniya ki zindagi hai aur marne ke baad logon ko dobara nahin uthaya jaayega. Isi aqeede ki wajah se un ki zindagi ghaflat mein guzarti thi. Lekin Musalmanon par bhi afsos hai ke un ka yaqini aqeeda hai ke marne ke baad log uthaye jaayenge aur aamaal ka hisaab dena hoga, is ke bawajood woh ghaflat mein pade hue hain. Yeh bahut afsosnaak haalat hai. Isi ma'ni ke muta'alliq buzurgon ne bahut si baatein irshad farmaayi hain.

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur duniya ki zindagi sirf khel-kood hai aur beshak Aakhirat wala ghar darne walon ke liye behtar hai to kya tum samajhte nahin?

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Aur duniya ki zindagi sirf khel-kood hai aur beshak Aakhirat wala ghar darne walon ke liye behtar hai to kya tum samajhte nahin?

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ مَا الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَاۤ اِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَّ لَهْوٌ: Aur duniya ki zindagi sirf khel-kood hai.} Irshad farmaya ke duniya ki zindagi sirf khel-kood hai. Is ko baqa nahin, yeh bahut jald guzar jaati hai. Mominon se duniya hi mein hone wali nekiyan aur ibaadat agarche duniya mein hoti hain, lekin woh Aakhirat ke aamaal mein se hain.

blocks.text: Mufti Ahmad Yar Khan Naeemi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne is aayat ki tafseer mein bahut pyari baat farmayi: "Duniya ki zindagi woh hai jo nafs ki khwahishat mein guzar jaaye. Jo zindagi Aakhirat ke liye zakhira jama karne mein kharch ho, woh duniya mein zindagi to hai lekin duniya ki zindagi nahin. Is liye Ambiya aur saleheen ki zindagi duniya ki nahin balki deen ki hai. Ghaafil aur aqalmand ki zindagiyon mein bahut bada farq hai." (Noor-ul-Irfan, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 32, safha 208.)

blocks.text: Imam Ghazali رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne is baat ko bahut pyare andaaz mein samjhaya hai. Kimya-e-Sa'adat mein farmate hain: Duniya daaron ke dunyawi kaam mein mashghool ho kar Aakhirat bhula dene ki misaal aisi hai jaise ek giroh kashti mein sawaar hua aur kashti ek jazeere par ja kar ruk gayi. Log is mauqe ko ghanimat samajh kar apni zaroori haajat se farigh hone ke liye jazeere par utar gaye. Mallah ne elaan kiya: "Hum yahan zyada der nahin rukenge. Waqt zaya kiye baghair sirf tahaarat waghera se farigh ho kar jaldi wapas aa jao."

Un mein kuch ne sirf dekhne par iktifa na kiya balki bahut si cheezen apne saath utha laaye. Jab kashti mein jagah tang hui aur in cheezon ko rakhne ki jagah na mili to unhein majbooran apne sar par uthana pada. Phir jab unhone un naseehaton ko bhula diya jo unhein ki gayi thin aur woh kisi tarah naseehat qubool karne ki taraf na aaye, na saamne aane wali museebaton se aur na Ambiya عَلَیْہِمُ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki naseehaton se, to Hum ne un par har cheez, yani sehat-o-salaamati, wasee rozi, aish waghera ke darwaaze khol diye.

Na main ne farishta hone ka da'wa kiya hai ke mera khaana-peena aur nikaah karna tumhare nazdeek aitraaz ban jaye. Jin cheezon ka da'wa hi nahi kiya gaya, un ka sawaal karna be-mahal hai aur aise sawaal ko poora karna mujh par laazim nahi. Mera da'wa to nubuwwat-o-risaalat ka hai. Jab is par zabardast daleelein aur mazboot burhaan qaayam ho chuki hain, to ghair-mutalliq baatein pesh karne ka kya matlab hai?

blocks.text: Allamah Nizaam-ud-Deen Hasan bin Muhammad Naishapoori رَحْمَۃُاللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain: “Irshaad hua ke ae Nabi! Farma do ke main tum se nahi kehta ke mere paas Allah Ta'ala ke khazaane hain. Yahan yeh nahi farmaya gaya ke Allah Ta'ala ke khazaane mere paas nahi, balki yeh farmaya gaya hai ke main tum se yeh nahi kehta ke mere paas Allah Ta'ala ke khazaane hain. Is se maloom hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke khazaane Huzoor-e-Aqdas ﷺ ke paas hain, lekin Huzoor Pur-Noor ﷺ logon se un ki samajh ke mutabiq baat farmate hain. blocks.text: Yaad rakhein ke Qiyamat ke din Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke muqaable mein koi kisi ka himaayati aur sifaarishi nahi hoga. Haan, Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki ijaazat se himaayati aur sifaarishi honge, jaise Ambiya, Auliya, shuhada, sulaha, ulama aur Hajiyon-e-Kiraam. Yeh sab Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke izn aur ijaazat se logon ki himaayat aur sifaarish karenge.

blocks.text: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke in mukhlis aur ghareeb Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ko apni baargaah se door na karo. Woh subah-o-shaam Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ko Us ki raza chaahte hue pukaarte hain. In ghareeb Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ka rizq Aap ﷺ ke zimme nahi ke ghurbat ki wajah se unhein door kar diya jaaye, aur na Aap ﷺ ki zimmedaari un ke hisaab ki hai. Sab ka hisaab Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ke zimme hai. Wahi saari makhlooq ko rizq dene wala hai aur Us ke siwa kisi ke zimme kisi ka hisaab nahi.

blocks.text: Is aayat ka ek doosra ma'ni yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke kaafiron ne ghareeb Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم par ta'n kiya tha ke yeh log ghurbat ki wajah se Aap ﷺ ke paas baithe hain taake yahan khaane-peene ka intezaam ho jaaye. Yeh mukhlis nahi hain. Is par pehle Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ke ikhlaas ka bayan farmaya gaya ke woh Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ki raza chaahte hue din-raat Us ki ibaadat karte hain. Khulasa yeh hai ke woh zaeef aur ghareeb log jo pehle bayan hue, Aap ﷺ ke darbaar mein qurb paane ke mustahiq hain. Unhein door na karna hi durust hai. blocks.text: Ghareebon ke saath achha sulook

runs.text: Ghareebon ke saath achha sulook

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke ameer ya ghareeb hona Haq ka paimaana nahi ban sakta. Pichhli aayat ke sabab-e-nuzool aur is aayat ke dars se bahut se deendar logon aur khud ameeron ko sabaq lena chahiye. Hamare zamane mein bhi yeh rawayya paaya jaata hai ke ameer aaye to us ki ta'zeem ki jaati hai, jabke ghareeb ko haqaarat ki nazar se dekha jaata hai. Ghareeb ka dil dukhaaya jaata hai aur ameer ke aage bichhe jaate hain.

blocks.text: Khud baaz ameer bhi yeh chaahte hain ke un se alag tarah ka sulook kiya jaaye, un ke liye khaas waqt nikaala jaaye aur un ke aane par Maulvi apni saari masroofiyat chhor kar un ke peechhe phirta rahe. Ghareeb aadmi paas baith jaaye to ameer ise apne rutbe ke khilaaf samajhta hai. Use ghareeb ke kapron se boo aati hai, ghareeb ka paas baithna us ki tabiyat kharaab kar deta hai aur ghareeb se haath milaane ko woh apne haath par jaraseem chadh jaana samajhta hai. Yeh sab ghamand aur takabbur ki baatein hain. In se bachna laazim aur zaroori hai.

blocks.text: Ek sahib Imam-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ki khidmat mein aaya karte the aur Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ bhi kabhi kabhi un ke ghar tashreef le jaate the. Ek martaba Aap رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ un ke yahan tashreef farma the ke un ke mohalle ka ek bechara ghareeb Musalman sahn ke kinaare rakhi hui tooti purani chaarpai par jhijhakte hue baithne laga. Ghar ke maalik ne nihayat talkh nazron se us ki taraf dekhna shuru kar diya. Woh sharminda hokar sar jhukaaye uth kar chala gaya.

Kuchh din baad woh sahib Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ke yahan aaye to Aap ne unhein apni chaarpai par jagah di. Woh abhi baithe hi the ke Kareem Bakhsh Hajjam, Aap رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ka khat banaane ke liye aaye. Woh soch rahe the ke kahan baithoon. Aap رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne farmaya: Bhai Kareem Bakhsh! Kyun khade ho? Musalman aapas mein bhai-bhai hain. Phir Aap ne un sahib ke qareeb baithne ka ishaara farmaya. Kareem Bakhsh Hajjam un ke saath baith gaye. Un sahib ko itna gussa aaya jaise saanp phunkare maar raha ho. Woh foran uth kar chale gaye aur phir kabhi na aaye. (Hayat-e-A'la Hazrat, 1/108, mulakhkhasan.)

blocks.text: Hazrat Aa'iz bin Amr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: Hazrat Salman, Hazrat Suhaib aur Hazrat Bilal رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ke saamne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne un ke mizaaj ke khilaaf koi baat keh di. Phir Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ Huzoor-e-Aqdas ﷺ ki baargaah mein haazir hue aur Aap ﷺ ko is ki khabar di. Aap ﷺ ne irshaad farmaya: “Ae Abu Bakr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ! Shayad tum ne unhein naaraaz kar diya. Agar tum ne unhein naaraaz kar diya to apne Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ ko naaraaz kar diya.” Phir Hazrat Abu Bakr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ un ke paas gaye aur kaha: Ae mere bhaiyo! Kya main ne tumhein naaraaz kar diya? Unhone kaha: Nahi, ae bhai! Allah Ta'ala Aap ki maghfirat farmaaye. Aap ﷺ ne irshaad farmaya: “Ae Abu Bakr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ! Shayad tum ne unhein naaraaz kar diya. Agar tum ne unhein naaraaz kar diya to apne Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ ko naaraaz kar diya.” Phir Hazrat Abu Bakr رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ un ke paas gaye aur kaha: Ae mere bhaiyo! Kya main ne tumhein naaraaz kar diya? Unhone kaha: Nahi, ae bhai! Allah Ta'ala Aap ki maghfirat farmaaye. (Muslim, Kitaab Faza'il-us-Sahaabah رضی اللہ تعالی عنہم, Baab min Faza'il Salmaan wa Suhaib wa Bilaal, safha 1359, hadees: 170 (2504).)

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Aur isi tarah hum aayaat ko tafseel se bayan farmate hain aur is liye ke mujrim logon ka raasta wazeh ho jaaye.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰیٰتِ: Aur isi tarah hum aayaat ko tafseel se bayan farmate hain.} Yani ae Habeeb ﷺ! Jis tarah hum ne is surah mein apni wahdaaniyat ki daleelein tafseel ke saath bayan ki hain, isi tarah hum apni hujjatein aur daleelein bhi tafseel se bayan farmate hain. Quran-e-Majeed mein hum ita'at guzaar logon ke ausaaf, gunaah ke baad tauba karne walon ki sifaat aur gunaah par ade rehne walon ki khubiyan bayan karte hain, taake Haq zaahir ho aur us par amal kiya jaaye. Aur hum yeh cheezein is liye bayan karte hain ke mujrim logon ka raasta aur un ka tareeqa wazeh ho jaaye aur us se bacha ja sake. (Khaazin, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 55, 2/20; Rooh-ul-Bayaan, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 55, 3/39, multaqatan.)

runs.text: Aakhirat ki kaamyaabi tak pahunchane wale raaste par chalne ki targheeb

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke aadmi ko chahiye ke woh falaah aur kaamyaabi ke raaste par chale aur wahan pahunche jahan nek log pahunche. Is ka behtareen raasta yeh hai ke foran apne guzre hue gunahon se tauba aur istighfaar kare aur aainda nek aamaal kare.

runs.text: Is se maloom hua ke aadmi ko chahiye ke woh falaah aur kaamyaabi ke raaste par chale aur wahan pahunche jahan nek log pahunche. Is ka behtareen raasta yeh hai ke foran apne guzre hue gunahon se tauba aur istighfaar kare aur aainda nek aamaal kare.

blocks.text: Imam Muhammad Ghazali رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: “Zindagi ka har lamha, balki har saans ek anmol moti hai jis ka koi badal nahi. Woh tumhein hamesha ki sa'aadat tak pahuncha sakta hai aur hamesha ki badbakhti se bacha sakta hai. Is se zyada anmol moti aur kya ho sakta hai? Agar tum ise ghaflat mein zaya kar doge to khula nuqsaan uthaaoge, aur agar ise gunaah mein lagaoge to saaf taur par halaak ho jaaoge. Agar tum is museebat par nahi rote to yeh tumhari jaahaalat hai, aur jaahaalat ki museebat sab museebaton se badh kar hai. Afsoos! Log ghaflat ki neend soye hue hain. Jab maut aayegi to woh jaag jaayenge. Us waqt har muflis ko apni muflisi aur har museebat-zadah ko apni museebat ka ilm ho jaayega, lekin us waqt iska azaala nahi ho sakega.” (Ihya Ulum-id-Deen, Kitaab-ut-Taubah, Ar-Rukn-ul-Awwal fi Nafs-it-Taubah, Bayan Anna Wujub-ut-Taubah Aam fil Ashkhaas..., 4/15.)

blocks.text: Is aayat mein pehle neend laane aur us ke baad bedaar karne ka bayan hua. Is mein Qiyamat qayam hone aur maut ke baad dobara zinda kiye jaane par roshan daleel hai. Jo Rab roz sone ke waqt tum par ek tarah ki maut waarid karta hai, jis se tumhare hawaas aur un ke zaahiri kaam, jaise dekhna, sunna, bolna, chalna-phirna aur pakarna, sab ruk jaate hain, phir bedari ke waqt wahi Rab tamaam azaa ko un ke tasarrufaat de deta hai aur woh dekhna, sunna, bolna aur chalna-phirna shuru kar dete hain, to woh Rab makhlooq ko haqeeqi maut ke baad zindagi ke tasarrufaat ata karne par bhi qaadir hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Ata bin Abi Rabaah رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Tum se pehle log fazool kalaam ko naapasand karte the. Woh log Kitaabullah, Sunnat-e-Rasool, neki ki dawat dene, buraai se rokne aur apni aisi haajat jis ke baghair koi chaara na ho, ke ilawa har kalaam ko fazool samajhte the. Kya tum is baat ka inkaar karte ho ke tumhare daahne-baayen do muhafiz farishte Kiraaman Kaatibeen baithe hain?

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:
Koi baat woh zabaan se nahi nikaalta magar Us ke paas ek muhafiz tayyar baitha hota hai.

blocks.text: Kya tumhein is baat se haya nahi aati ke tumhara naama-e-a'maal jab khola jaayega to woh din bhar ki baaton se bhara hoga aur un mein aksar woh baatein hongi jin ka na tumhare deen se koi ta'alluq hoga na duniya se? Ek Sahabi رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: Mere saath koi shakhs baat karta hai. Use jawaab dena shadeed pyaas ke waqt thande paani se zyada meri khwahish hoti hai, lekin main is khauf se use jawaab nahi deta ke kahin yeh fazool kalaam na ho jaaye. (Ihya Ulum-id-Deen, Kitaab Aafaat-ul-Lisaan, Bayaan Azeem Khatar-ul-Lisaan wa Fazilat-us-Samt, Al-Aafat-us-Saaniyah: Fazool-ul-Kalaam, 3/141.) [1]

blocks.text: {تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا: Hamare farishte us ki rooh qabz karte hain.} In farishton se muraad ya to tanha Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام hain, is surat mein jama ka lafz ta'zeem ke liye hai, ya Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام aur woh farishte muraad hain jo un ke madadgaar hain. Jab kisi ki maut ka waqt aata hai to Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se apne madadgaaron ko us ki rooh qabz karne ka hukm dete hain. Jab rooh halq tak pahunchti hai to khud qabz farmate hain. (Khaazin, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 61, 2/23.) In sab farishton ke baare mein farmaya gaya ke woh koi kotahi nahi karte. Yani hukm ki ta'meel mein un se kotahi nahi hoti, un ke amal mein susti aur taakhir raah nahi paati, balki woh apne faraaiz theek waqt par ada karte hain.

runs.text: Hisaab hone se pehle apna muhaasaba kar lo

blocks.text: Allama Ismaeel Haqqi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ is aayat ke tehat farmate hain: Jab marne ke baad dobara zinda kiya jaana aur a'maal ka hisaab hona hai, aur Allah Ta'ala tamaam makhlooq se un ke a'maal ka hisaab lega, to aqalmand insaan par laazim hai ke hisaab ke maamle mein poochh-gachh hone se pehle hi apne nafs ka muhaasaba kar le. Insaan Aakhirat ki raah mein taajir hai. Us ki umr us ka maal-o-mata hai. Us ka nafa apni zindagi ko ibaadat aur nek a'maal mein kharch karna hai, aur us ka nuqsaan gunaahon aur ma'aasi mein zindagi guzaarna hai. Us ka nafs is tijaarat mein us ka shareek hai. Nafs neki aur buraai dono kar sakta hai, lekin neki ke muqaable mein gunaahon aur nafsaanee khwahishon ki taraf zyada ma'il hota hai, is liye us ka muhaasaba karna intehaai zaroori hai. (Rooh-ul-Bayaan, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 62, 3/46.) [1]

blocks.text: Imam Muhammad Ghazali رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Insaan ko chahiye ke raat sote waqt ek ghadi muqarrar kare taake woh apne nafs se is din ka saara hisaab le. Jis tarah tijaarat mein shareek shakhs se hisaab lete waqt nihayat ehtiyaat aur mubalagha kiya jaata hai, isi tarah apne nafs ka hisaab lete hue bahut ehtiyaat karni chahiye. Nafs bada makkaar aur hilaasaaz hai. Woh apni khwahish ko insaan ke saamne ita'at ki shakl mein pesh karta hai taake insaan use bhi nafa samajh le, halaanki woh nuqsaan hota hai. Insaan ko chahiye ke woh apne nafs se mubaahaat ka bhi hisaab le: Yeh tune kyun kiya? Kis ke liye kiya? Agar is mein koi aib dekhe to apne nafs ko us ka zimmedaar thehraaye.

blocks.text: Lekin afsos hai ke aaj insaan apne nafs se hisaab lene ke liye kitna ghafil hai. Agar insaan har gunaah par apne ghar mein ek patthar rakhta jaaye to thode din mein ghar pattharon se bhar jaaye. Agar Kiraaman Kaatibeen is insaan se likhne ki mazdoori maangte to us ke paas kuchh baaqi na rehta. Agar insaan kabhi ghaflat mein chand baar سُبْحَانَ اللہ padhta hai to tasbeeh haath mein lekar baith jaata hai aur kehta hai ke main ne yeh sau martaba padh liya, halaanki saara din behooda bakwaas karta phirta hai. Woh inhein shumaar nahi karta aur na hi shumaar karne ke liye koi cheez haath mein leta hai taake use maloom ho ke main ne saare din mein kitne gunaah kiye. Is surat-e-haal ke bawajood yeh sochna ke mere nekiyon ka palra bhaari ho jaayega, kitni be-aqli hai! Isi liye Hazrat Umar Farooq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ne farmaya: Apne a'maal tole jaane se pehle khud apne a'maal ka jaaiza le lo.

blocks.text: Apna muhaasaba karne mein Aap رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ki kaifiyat yeh thi ke jab raat hoti to apne paon par durre lagaate aur kehte: Bata, tune aaj kya kiya? Hazrat Anas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmate hain: Main ne Hazrat Umar Farooq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ko ek deewaar ke peechhe yeh kehte suna: Waah waah! Log tujhe Ameer-ul-Momineen kehte hain, lekin Khuda ki qasam! Tu Allah Ta'ala se nahi darta aur Us ke azaab mein mubtala hone ko tayyar rehta hai. (Keemiya-e-Sa'aadat, Rukn Chahaarum, Asl Shashum dar Muhaasaba wa Muraaqaba, Maqaam سوم dar Muhaasabaat, 2/891-892.)

blocks.text: Is aayat se yeh bhi maloom hua ke duniya mein kaafiron ki baaz duaein qabool ho jaati hain. Kaafir museebat mein phans kar najaat ki dua karte the to Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ unhein najaat de deta tha. Shaitaan ne apni darazi-e-umr ki dua ki aur woh qabool hui.

blocks.text: Yaad rahe ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ki Sunnat-e-Jaariyah hai ke Woh apni na-farmaani ki saza mein Musalmanon ko kaafiron se aur kaafiron ko Musalmanon se ladwa deta hai. Isi tarah kaafiron ko kaafiron se aur Musalmanon ko Musalmanon se ladwa deta hai, jaisa ke hamare zamaane mein is ki misaalein dekhi ja sakti hain.

Isi tarah kaafiron ko kaafiron se aur Musalmanon ko Musalmanon se ladwa deta hai, jaisa ke hamare zamaane mein is ki misaalein dekhi ja sakti hain.

blocks.text: Sahih Bukhari ki hadees mein hai ke jab aayat ka yeh hissa naazil hua: “Woh qaadir hai ke tum par tumhare upar se azaab bheje,” to Sarkar-e-Do Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَ اٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ ne farmaya: Main Teri hi panaah maangta hoon. Jab yeh hissa naazil hua: “Ya tumhare paon ke neeche se,” to farmaya: Main Teri hi panaah maangta hoon. Aur jab yeh hissa naazil hua: “Ya tumhein mukhtalif giroh bana kar lada de aur ek ko doosre ki sakhti chakhaye,” to farmaya: Yeh aasaan hai. (Bukhari, Kitaab-ut-Tafseer, Baab Qul Huwal-Qaadiru ala an yab'asa alaikum..., 3/221, hadees: 4628.)

blocks.text: Sahih Muslim ki hadees-e-shareef mein hai ke ek din Rahmat-e-Aalam صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَسَلَّمَ ne Masjid-e-Bani Muawiyah mein do rak'at namaaz ada farmayi aur us ke baad lambi dua ki. Phir Sahaba رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم ki taraf mutawajjah hokar farmaya: Main ne apne Rab عَزَّوَجَلَّ se teen sawaal kiye, un mein se sirf do qabool hue. Ek sawaal yeh tha ke Meri ummat ko qaht-e-aam se halaak na farmaye; yeh qabool hua. Doosra yeh tha ke unhein gharq karke azaab na de; yeh bhi qabool hua. Teesra sawaal yeh tha ke un mein baahmi jang-o-jidaal na ho; yeh qabool nahi hua. (Muslim, Kitaab-ul-Fitan wa Ashraat-us-Saa'ah, Baab Halaak Haazihil-Ummat Ba'zuhum Bi-Ba'z, safha 1544, hadees: 20 (2890).)

blocks.text: Albatta jo Ulama in badmazhabon ka rad karne ke liye jaate hain, woh is hukm mein shaamil nahi. Yaad rahe ke badmazhabon ki mehfil mein jaana aur un ki taqreer sunna najaaiz-o-haraam hai. Yeh apne aap ko badmazhabi aur gumraahi ke saamne pesh karna hai. Un ki taqreerein Quranic aayaat ya ahadees-e-mubarakah par mabni hon, tab bhi achhi baatein chunne ke khayaal se unhein sunna hargiz jaaiz nahi. Aksar aisa hota hai ke gumraah shakhs Quran-o-hadees ki sharh ki aad mein apni badmazhabi ki baat bhi mila deta hai. Sunne wale ke zehan mein woh baat baith jaati hai aur dil mein ghar kar leti hai. Isi wajah se gumraah aur bad-deen ki taqreer sunne wala aam taur par khud bhi gumraah ho jaata hai.

blocks.text: Hamare aslaaf apne imaan ke baare mein bahut ehtiyaat karte the. Aqeedah mein nihayat mazboot hone ke bawajood woh kisi badmazhab ki baat sunna pasand nahi karte the, chahe woh sau baar yaqeen dilaata ke main sirf Quran-o-hadees bayan karunga. A'la Hazrat, Imam-e-Ahl-e-Sunnat, Maulana Shah Imam Ahmad Raza Khan رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ne aslaaf ka amal naqal karte hue farmaya: “Sayyiduna Sa'eed bin Jubair, Abdullah bin Abbas رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُمَا ke shagird, ko raaste mein ek badmazhab mila. Us ne kaha: Main kuchh arz karna chahta hoon. Aap ne farmaya: Main sunna nahi chahta. Us ne arz ki: Sirf ek kalimah. Aap ne apna angutha chhoti ungli ke sire par rakh kar farmaya: ‘وَ لَا نِصْفَ کَلِمَۃٍ’ Aadha lafz bhi nahi. Logon ne poochha: Is ki wajah kya hai? Farmaya: Yeh unhi mein se hai, yani gumraahon mein se hai.”

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur un logon ko chhor do jinhone apne deen ko hansi-mazaaq aur khel bana liya aur jinhein duniya ki zindagi ne dhoke mein daal diya. Aur Quran ke zariye naseehat karo taake koi jaan apne aamaal ki wajah se halaakat ke supurd na kar di jaaye. Allah ke siwa na us ka koi madadgaar hoga aur na koi sifaarshi. Aur agar woh apne badle mein saare muawaze de de to us se na liye jaayenge. Yahi woh log hain jinhein un ke aamaal ki wajah se halaakat ke supurd kar diya gaya. Un ke liye un ke kufr ke sabab khaultay hue paani ka mashroob aur dardnaak azaab hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Abu Ishaq Fazaari رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Ek shakhs aksar hamare paas baitha karta aur apna aadha chehra dhaanp kar rakhta tha. Ek din main ne us se kaha: Tum hamare paas bahut baithte ho aur apna aadha chehra dhaanp kar rakhte ho, is ki wajah batao. Us ne kaha: Main kafan-chor tha. Ek din ek aurat ko dafn kiya gaya. Main us ki qabr par aaya. Jab main ne qabr khod kar kafan kheenchna chaha to us ne apna haath utha kar mere chehre par tamaacha maara. Phir us shakhs ne apna chehra dikhaaya to us par paanch ungliyon ke nishaan the. Main ne poochha: Is ke baad kya hua? Us ne kaha: Main ne us ka kafan chhor diya, qabr band karke us par mitti daal di aur dil mein pakka iraada kar liya ke jab tak zinda rahunga kisi ki qabr nahi khodunga.

blocks.text: Hazrat Abu Ishaq Fazaari رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmate hain: Main ne yeh waaqia Imam Awzaa'i رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ko likh kar bheja. Unhone mujhe likha: Is se poochho ke jin Musalmanon ko dafn kiya gaya tha, kya un ke chehre qiblah ki taraf the? Main ne kafan-chor se poochha to us ne jawaab diya: Un mein se zyada tar logon ke chehre qiblah se phire hue the. Main ne yeh jawaab Imam Awzaa'i رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ ko likh kar bheja. Unhone mujhe ek tehreer bheji jis par teen martaba “اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَاِنَّا اِلَیْہِ رَاجِعُونْ” likha tha aur saath likha tha: “Jis ka chehra qiblah se phira hua tha, us ki wafaat Islam ke deen par nahi hui. Tum Allah Ta'ala se us ke afw, maghfirat aur Us ki raza talab karo.” (Rooh-ul-Bayaan, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 70, 3/51.)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Tum farmao: Kya hum Allah ke siwa us ki ibaadat karein jo na humein nafa de sakta hai aur na humein nuqsaan pahuncha sakta hai? Aur kya Allah ki hidaayat milne ke baad hum ulte paanv phir jaayen, us shakhs ki tarah jise shaitanon ne zameen mein raasta bhula diya ho aur woh hairaan ho? Us ke saathi use raaste ki taraf bula rahe hon ke idhar aao. Tum farmao: Allah ki hidaayat hi hidaayat hai aur humein hukm hai ke hum us ke liye gardan rakh dein jo saare jahaanon ka Paalne wala hai.

blocks.text: {وَ نُرَدُّ عَلٰۤى اَعْقَابِنَا: Aur kya hum ulte paanv phir jaayen.} Is aayat mein Haq aur baatil ki daawat dene walon ki ek misaal bayan ki gayi hai. blocks.text: Us ka anjaam yeh hoga ke agar woh bhooton ki raah par chal pada to halaak ho jaayega, aur agar rafeeqon ki baat maan li to salaamat rahega aur manzil tak pahunch jaayega. Isi tarah jo shakhs Islam ke tareeqe se bhatak kar shaitaan ki raah par chala, Musalman use seedhe raaste ki taraf bulaate hain. Agar woh un ki baat maan le to raah paa jaayega, warna halaak ho jaayega. (Khaazin, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 71, 2/26-27.)

blocks.text: Aayat mein Aazar ke liye “اَبْ” ka lafz zikr kiya gaya hai. Is ka ek ma'ni baap hai aur doosra ma'ni chacha. Yahan is se muraad chacha hai, jaisa ke Qaamoos mein hai: Aazar Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke chacha ka naam hai. (Al-Qaamoos-ul-Muheet, Baab-ur-Ra, Fasl-ul-Hamzah, 1/491, tehat-ul-lafz: al-Aazar.)

blocks.text: Namrood ne khwab dekha ke ek sitara tuloo hua aur us ki roshni ke saamne sooraj aur chaand bilkul be-noor ho gaye. Is se woh bahut dar gaya aur us ne kaahino se is khwab ki taabeer poochhi. Unhone kaha: Is saal tumhari saltanat mein ek beta paida hoga jo tumhari saltanat ke zawaal ka sabab banega aur tumhare deen walon ko us ke haath se halaak karega.

blocks.text: Yeh khabar sunkar woh pareshaan hua. Us ne hukm diya ke jo bachcha paida ho use qatl kar diya jaaye, mard auraton se alag rahen, aur bachon ki nigehbaani ke liye ek mahkama bana diya gaya. Lekin Allah Ta'ala ki taqdeer ko kaun taal sakta hai? Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki walida-e-maajida haamila huin. Kaahino ne Namrood ko yeh bhi bata diya ke woh bachcha un ke pait mein aa gaya hai, lekin Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki walida ki umar kam thi, is liye un ka hamal pehchaana na ja saka.

blocks.text: Chaand ke ma'bood na hone par bhi Aap عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne yahi daleel di ke us ka ek haal se doosre haal ki taraf muntaqil hona fana hone ki daleel hai. blocks.text: Is tarah Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne saabit kar diya ke sitaron mein chhote se bade tak koi bhi Rab hone ki salahiyat nahi rakhta. Un ka ma'bood hona baatil hai. Aap عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ne apni qaum ke shirk se bezaari ka izhaar kar diya aur is ke baad haq deen ka bayan farmaaya jo agli aayaat mein aa raha hai.

blocks.text: Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ke sitare, chaand aur sooraj ke baare mein farmaan logon ko samjhaane ke liye the, apne baare mein nahi the. Is ki bahut wazeh daleel yeh hai ke jab Aap عَلَیْہِ السَّلَام ne sitare, chaand aur sooraj ke baare mein yeh farmaaya to kya Aap ne is se pehle din aur raat ka farq aur sooraj, chaand ke ghuroob hone ko kabhi nahi dekha tha? Aisa hargiz nahi ho sakta. Is se maloom hua ke sooraj, chaand aur sitare ke hawale se Aap ka kalaam sirf qaum ko samjhaane ke liye tha. Is baat ka zyada sareeh bayan aayat number 83 mein bhi maujood hai.

blocks.text: Haq deen ke mazboot hone ki surat

blocks.text: Is se maloom hua ke haq deen ka qiyaam aur mazbooti us waqt hi ho sakti hai jab tamaam baatil deeno se bezaari ho aur haq deen par mazbooti ho. Deen ke maamle mein dheela-pan dikhaane, sab ko apni apni jagah durust maanne aur sab mazaahib mein ittehaad paida karne ki koshish se haq deen mazboot nahi ho sakta.

blocks.text: Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmaate hain: Jab yeh aayat-e-kareema naazil hui to Sahaba-e-Kiraam رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُم bahut pareshaan hue. Unhone Rasoolullah ﷺ ki baargaah mein arz ki: Hum mein se aisa kaun hai jo apni jaan par zulm nahi karta? Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ ne irshaad farmaaya: Is se yeh muraad nahi, balki is se shirk muraad hai. Kya tum ne Hazrat Luqman رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ki woh naseehat nahi suni jo unhone apne bete se kahi thi: Ae mere bete! Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ ka kisi ko shareek na banaana, beshak shirk bada zulm hai. (Bukhari, Kitaab Ahadees-ul-Anbiya, Baab Qaulillah Ta'ala: Wa Laqad Aataina Luqmanal-Hikmata..., 2/451, hadees: 3429.)

Aayat mein jin buzurgon ke naam bayan hue, woh sab Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki aulaad mein se the aur sab Nabi hue.

Is ki tafseer mein Abu Hayyan Muhammad bin Yusuf Andalusi رَحْمَۃُ اللہِ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ farmaate hain: Hazrat Ibrahim عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام kyunki Hazrat Nooh عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام ki aulaad mein se hain, is liye sharf-e-nubuwwat ka in dono ki aulaad mein hona durust hua. (Al-Bahr-ul-Muheet, Al-Hadeed, tehat-ul-aayat: 26, 8/226.) blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur Yahudiyon ne Allah ki qadr na ki jaisi us ki qadr karne ka haq tha jab unhone kaha: Allah ne kisi insaan par koi cheez nahi utaari. Tum farmaao: Woh kitaab kis ne utaari thi jise Moosa le kar aaye the? Noor aur logon ke liye hidaayat thi, jis ke tumne alag alag kaaghaz bana liye the, kuch zaahir karte ho aur bahut kuch chhupa lete ho aur tumhein woh sikhaya jaata hai jo na tumhein maloom tha aur na tumhare baap dada ko. Tum kaho: “Allah.” Phir unhein un ki behoodagi mein khelte hue chhor do.

runs.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan:

Aur Yahudiyon ne Allah ki qadr na ki jaisi us ki qadr karne ka haq tha jab unhone kaha: Allah ne kisi insaan par koi cheez nahi utaari. Tum farmaao: Woh kitaab kis ne utaari thi jise Moosa le kar aaye the? Noor aur logon ke liye hidaayat thi, jis ke tumne alag alag kaaghaz bana liye the, kuch zaahir karte ho aur bahut kuch chhupa lete ho aur tumhein woh sikhaya jaata hai jo na tumhein maloom tha aur na tumhare baap dada ko. Tum kaho: “Allah.” Phir unhein un ki behoodagi mein khelte hue chhor do.

blocks.text: Easy Roman Urdu: {وَ مَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ: Aur unhone Allah ki qadr na ki jaisi us ki qadr karne ka haq tha.} Is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat apne sab se bade aalim Maalik bin Saif ko saath le kar Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّم se behas karne aayi. Tajdaar-e-Risaalat صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّم ne us se farmaya: Main tujhe us Parwardigaar ki qasam deta hoon jis ne Hazrat Moosa عَلَیْہِ الصَّلٰوۃُ وَالسَّلَام par Taurat naazil farmaayi, kya Taurat mein tumne yeh dekha hai: “Allah Ta'ala ko mota aalim na-pasand hai?” Us ne kaha: “Haan, yeh Taurat mein hai.” Huzoor-e-Aqdas صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّم ne farmaya: “Tu mota aalim hi to hai.” Woh gusse mein aa gaya aur kehne laga ke Allah Ta'ala ne kisi aadmi par kuch nahi utaara. Is par yeh aayat naazil hui. Woh lajawab ho gaya, Yahudiyon ne use jhidka aur us ke ohde se hata diya. (Tafseer Baghawi, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 91, 2/94; Madaarik, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 91, s. 331-332, multaqatan.)

blocks.text: Tarjumah-e-Kanz-ul-Irfan: Aur us se barh kar zaalim kaun? Jo Allah par jhoot baandhe ya kahe: Meri taraf wahi ki gayi, haalanke us ki taraf kisi shay ki wahi nahi bheji gayi, aur jo kahe: Main bhi abhi aisa utaar doonga jaisa Allah ne utaara hai. Aur agar tum dekho jab zaalim maut ki sakhtiyon mein hote hain aur farishte haath phailaate hue kehte hain: Apni jaanein nikaalo. Aaj tumhein zillat ka azaab diya jaayega us ke badle jo tum Allah par na-haq baatein kehte the aur us ki aayaat se takabbur karte the.

Yeh jhoota shakhs Sayyiduna Abu Bakr Siddiq رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke zamana-e-khilaafat mein Hazrat Wahshi رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ ke haath se maara gaya. (Khaazin, Al-Anam, tehat-ul-aayat: 93, 2/37.)

blocks.text: Is mein farmaya gaya ke us se barh kar zaalim kaun jo Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ par jhoot baandhe, nubuwwat ka jhoota da'wa kare aur kahe ke meri taraf wahi ki gayi, haalanke us ki taraf kisi shay ki wahi nahi bheji gayi. Yeh aayat Mirza Qaadiyani ka bhi saaf radd karti hai, kyunki us ne bhi apni taraf wahi aane ka da'wa kiya tha. Aaj kal Qaadiyani log mukhtalif tareeqon se logon ko dhoka dete hain. Koi kehta hai ke Mirza Ghulam Ahmad ne nubuwwat ka nahi balki mujaddid hone ka da'wa kiya, aur koi kehta hai ke us ne mutlaq nubuwwat-o-risaalat ka da'wa nahi kiya balki khaas qisam ki nubuwwat ka da'wa kiya. Haalanke us ki kitaabon mein mutlaq nubuwwat-o-risaalat ka da'wa maujood hai. Zilli aur burozi nubuwwat ka da'wa bhi nubuwwat hi ka da'wa hai aur bilkul kufr hai. Is liye kisi Musalman ko un ke dhoke mein nahi aana chahiye.

runs.text: Maut ke waqt Musalman aur kaafir ke haalaat

blocks.text: Is aayat mein kaafir ki maut ke waqt ka haal bayan hua. Hadees-e-Paak mein Musalman aur kaafir dono ke haalaat bayan hue hain. Hazrat Abu Hurairah رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ se riwaayat hai ke Nabi-e-Akram صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّم ne irshaad farmaaya: Jab Musalman ki maut qareeb hoti hai to rahmat ke farishte safed reshmi kapre le kar aate hain aur kehte hain: Ae rooh! Allah Ta'ala tum se raazi hai, is haal mein khushi khushi apne Parwardigaar ki taraf nikal, jo tum se naaraaz nahi. Phir rooh achhi khushboo wale mushk ki tarah nikalti hai. Farishte use aasmaan ke darwaaze par le jaate hain aur kehte hain: Yeh zameen se aane wali kitni achhi khushboo hai. Phir use Musalmanon ki roohon ke paas le jaate hain. Woh rooh us shakhs se bhi zyada khush hoti hain jo kisi door gaye hue shakhs ke lautne par hota hai. Woh poochti hain ke duniya mein falan shakhs kaise kaam karta hai. Phir kehti hain: Abhi use chhor do, yeh duniya ke gham mein hai. Woh rooh poochti hai: Kya woh tumhare paas nahi tha? Roohain kehti hain: Agar woh duniya se aa gaya aur hamare paas nahi hai to woh Jahannam mein gaya hoga.

blocks.text: Hazrat Muslim bin Yasaar رَضِیَ اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَنْہُ farmaate hain ke Nabi-e-Kareem صَلَّی اللہُ تَعَالٰی عَلَیْہِ وَاٰلِہٖ وَسَلَّم yeh dua maanga karte the: “اَللّٰہُمَّ فَالِقَ الْاِصْبَاحِ وَجَاعِلَ اللَّیْلِ سَکَنًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا، اِقْضِ عَنِّی الدَّیْنَ وَاغْنِنِی مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وََ مَتِّعْنِی بِسَمْعِیْ وَبَصَرِیْ وَقُوَّتِیْ فِیْ سَبِیْلِکَ” Ae Allah عَزَّوَجَلَّ! Ae tareeki ko cheer kar subah nikaalne wale, raat ko aaraam ka zariya banaane wale aur Suraj-o-Chaand ko auqaat ke hisaab ka zariya banaane wale! Mera qarz ada farma de, mujhe mohtaaji se be-niyaaz farma de aur meri samaat, basaarat aur quwwat se apni raah mein faaidah uthaane wala bana de. (Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaibah, Kitaab-ud-Dua, Man kaana yad'u bil-ghina, 7/27, hadees: 3.)

blocks.text: Jo Rab-e-Azeem عَزَّوَجَلَّ ek paani se itni qism ki sabziyaan paida karne par qaadir hai, woh ek soor ki phoonk se saare aalam ko maarne aur zinda karne par bhi qaadir hai. Is liye Qiyamat haq hai.
